[31m+ function _nextPowerOf2(num) {[39m

[31m+   return Math.max(nextPow2, 4);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async update(force = false) {[39m
[31m+     if (this.#updating) {[39m
[31m+       await this.#updating.promise;[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!force && !this.isStale) {[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.#abort?.abort();[39m
[31m+     this.#abort = new AbortController();[39m
[31m+     this.#ctx.abort = this.#abort.signal;[39m
[31m+     this.#updating = new Deferred();[39m
[31m+     let result;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       result = await this.params.fetcher(this.#ctx);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (this.params.onError) {[39m
[31m+         this.params.onError(e, this.#ctx);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         console.error(e);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.#updating.resolve();[39m
[31m+       this.#updating = void 0;[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.#updating.resolve();[39m
[31m+     this.#updating = void 0;[39m
[31m+     this.setData(result.data, result.expiresIn);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * get the resource value, refreshing it if needed[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * note: this method still *might* return `null` if the resource wasn't ever cached yet,[39m
[31m+    * and the underlying call to `fetcher` failed[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async get() {[39m
[31m+     if (this.params.swr === true && this.#ctx.current !== null) {[39m
[31m+       const validator = this.params.swrValidator;[39m
[31m+       if (!validator || validator(this.#ctx)) {[39m
[31m+         this.#ctx.isBackground = true;[39m
[31m+         this.update(true).catch(() => {[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         return this.#ctx.current;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.#ctx.isBackground = false;[39m
[31m+     await this.update();[39m
[31m+     return this.#ctx.current;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * get the cached resource value immediately (if any)[39m
[31m+    * note that it may be stale, which you should check separately[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   getCached() {[39m
[31m+     return this.#ctx.current;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   destroy() {[39m
[31m+     if (this.#timeout) clearTimeoutWrap(this.#timeout);[39m
[31m+     this.onUpdated.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.#abort?.abort();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ var ErrorInfo = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(item, index, error) {[39m
[31m+     this.item = item;[39m
[31m+     this.index = index;[39m
[31m+     this.error = error;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ var AggregateError = class extends Error {[39m
[31m+   constructor(errors) {[39m
[31m+     super(`AggregateError: ${errors.length} errors`);[39m
[31m+     this.errors = errors;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ async function asyncPool(iterable, executor, options = {}) {[39m
[31m+   const {[39m
[31m+     limit = 16,[39m
[31m+     signal,[39m
[31m+     onError[39m
[31m+   } = options;[39m
[31m+   if (limit <= 0) throw new Error("Pool limit must be a positive integer");[39m
[31m+   const iteratorFactory = iterable[Symbol.asyncIterator] ?? iterable[Symbol.iterator];[39m
[31m+   if (iteratorFactory === void 0) throw new Error("`iterable` must be an iterable!");[39m
[31m+   const iterator = iteratorFactory.call(iterable);[39m
[31m+   let idx = 0;[39m
[31m+   let errored = false;[39m
[31m+   let ended = false;[39m
[31m+   const errors = [];[39m
[31m+   if (signal) {[39m
[31m+     if (signal.aborted) {[39m
[31m+       throw signal.reason;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async function worker() {[39m
[31m+     while (true) {[39m
[31m+       if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason;[39m
[31m+       if (errored || ended) break;[39m
[31m+       const result = await iterator.next();[39m
[31m+       if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason;[39m
[31m+       if (result.done) {[39m
[31m+         ended = true;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (errored) break;[39m
[31m+       const thisIdx = idx++;[39m
[31m+       const item = result.value;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         await executor(item, thisIdx);[39m
[31m+       } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+         const action = onError?.(item, thisIdx, err) ?? "throw";[39m
[31m+         if (action === "ignore") {[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (action === "collect") {[39m
[31m+           errors.push(new ErrorInfo(item, thisIdx, err));[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (action === "throw") {[39m
[31m+           errored = true;[39m
[31m+           throw err;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: limit }, worker));[39m
[31m+   if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason;[39m
[31m+   if (errors.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     throw new AggregateError(errors);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function parallelMap(iterable, executor, options = {}) {[39m
[31m+   const result = [];[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(iterable)) {[39m
[31m+     result.length = iterable.length;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   await asyncPool(iterable, async (item, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const res = await executor(item, index);[39m
[31m+     result[index] = res;[39m
[31m+   }, options);[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function bitLength(n) {[39m
[31m+   if (n === 0n) return 0;[39m
[31m+   const i = (n.toString(16).length - 1) * 4;[39m
[31m+   return i + 32 - Math.clz32(Number(n >> BigInt(i)));[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function twoMultiplicity(n) {[39m
[31m+   if (n === 0n) return 0n;[39m
[31m+   let m3 = 0n;[39m
[31m+   let pow = 1n;[39m
[31m+   while (true) {[39m
[31m+     if ((n & pow) !== 0n) return m3;[39m
[31m+     m3 += 1n;[39m
[31m+     pow <<= 1n;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function euclideanGcd(a, b) {[39m
[31m+   while (b !== 0n) {[39m
[31m+     const t = b;[39m
[31m+     b = a % b;[39m
[31m+     a = t;[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ function modPowBinary(base, exp, mod) {[39m
[31m+   base %= mod;[39m
[31m+   let result = 1n;[39m
[31m+   while (exp > 0n) {[39m
[31m+     if (exp % 2n === 1n) {[39m
[31m+       result = result * base % mod;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     exp >>= 1n;[39m
[31m+     base = base ** 2n % mod;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function eGcd(a, b) {[39m
[31m+   let x = 0n;[39m
[31m+   let y = 1n;[39m
[31m+   let u = 1n;[39m
[31m+   let v = 0n;[39m
[31m+   while (a !== 0n) {[39m
[31m+     const q = b / a;[39m
[31m+     const r = b % a;[39m
[31m+     const m3 = x - u * q;[39m
[31m+     const n = y - v * q;[39m
[31m+     b = a;[39m
[31m+     a = r;[39m
[31m+     x = u;[39m
[31m+     y = v;[39m
[31m+     u = m3;[39m
[31m+     v = n;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return [b, x, y];[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function toZn(a, n) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof a === "number") a = BigInt(a);[39m
[31m+   if (typeof n === "number") n = BigInt(n);[39m
[31m+   if (n <= 0n) {[39m
[31m+     throw new RangeError("n must be > 0");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const aZn = a % n;[39m
[31m+   return aZn < 0n ? aZn + n : aZn;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function modInv(a, n) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ function toBytes(value, length = 0, le = false) {[39m
[31m+   const bits = bitLength(value);[39m
[31m+   const bytes2 = Math.ceil(bits / 8);[39m
[31m+   if (length !== 0 && bytes2 > length) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error("Value out of bounds");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (length === 0) length = bytes2;[39m
[31m+   const buf = new ArrayBuffer(length);[39m
[31m+   const u82 = new Uint8Array(buf);[39m
[31m+   const unaligned = length % 8;[39m
[31m+   const dv = new DataView(buf, 0, length - unaligned);[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < dv.byteLength; i += 8) {[39m
[31m+     dv.setBigUint64(i, value & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFn, true);[39m
[31m+     value >>= 64n;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (unaligned > 0) {[39m
[31m+     for (let i = length - unaligned; i < length; i++) {[39m

[31m+       value >>= 8n;[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!le) u82.reverse();[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   let finished = false;[39m
[31m+   const run = function(...args) {[39m
[31m+     if (finished) return Promise.resolve();[39m

[31m+     return runningPromise;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     run,[39m
[31m+     finished: () => finished,[39m
[31m+     wait: () => runningPromise,[39m
[31m+     reset: () => {[39m
[31m+       finished = false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m

[31m+ function fromInt(value, unsigned) {[39m
[31m+   var obj, cachedObj, cache;[39m
[31m+   if (unsigned) {[39m
[31m+     value >>>= 0;[39m
[31m+     if (cache = 0 <= value && value < 256) {[39m
[31m+       cachedObj = UINT_CACHE[value];[39m
[31m+       if (cachedObj) return cachedObj;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     obj = fromBits(value, 0, true);[39m
[31m+     if (cache) UINT_CACHE[value] = obj;[39m
[31m+     return obj;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     value |= 0;[39m
[31m+     if (cache = -128 <= value && value < 128) {[39m

[31m+       if (cachedObj) return cachedObj;[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     return obj;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function fromNumber(value, unsigned) {[39m
[31m+   if (isNaN(value)) return unsigned ? UZERO : ZERO;[39m
[31m+   if (unsigned) {[39m
[31m+     if (value < 0) return UZERO;[39m

[31m+   } else {[39m

[31m+ function fromString(str, unsigned, radix) {[39m
[31m+   if (str.length === 0) throw Error("empty string");[39m
[31m+   if (typeof unsigned === "number") {[39m
[31m+     radix = unsigned;[39m
[31m+     unsigned = false;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     unsigned = !!unsigned;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (str === "NaN" || str === "Infinity" || str === "+Infinity" || str === "-Infinity")[39m
[31m+     return unsigned ? UZERO : ZERO;[39m
[31m+   radix = radix || 10;[39m
[31m+   if (radix < 2 || 36 < radix) throw RangeError("radix");[39m
[31m+   var p;[39m
[31m+   if ((p = str.indexOf("-")) > 0) throw Error("interior hyphen");[39m
[31m+   else if (p === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return fromString(str.substring(1), unsigned, radix).neg();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   var radixToPower = fromNumber(pow_dbl(radix, 8));[39m
[31m+   var result = ZERO;[39m
[31m+   for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i += 8) {[39m
[31m+     var size = Math.min(8, str.length - i), value = parseInt(str.substring(i, i + size), radix);[39m
[31m+     if (size < 8) {[39m
[31m+       var power = fromNumber(pow_dbl(radix, size));[39m
[31m+       result = result.mul(power).add(fromNumber(value));[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       result = result.mul(radixToPower);[39m
[31m+       result = result.add(fromNumber(value));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   result.unsigned = unsigned;[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ LongPrototype.divide = function divide(divisor) {[39m

[31m+ var KV_MAIN = "dc_main";[39m
[31m+ var KV_MEDIA = "dc_media";[39m
[31m+ var DefaultDcsService = class extends BaseService {[39m
[31m+   constructor(_kv, opts) {[39m
[31m+     super(opts);[39m
[31m+     this._kv = _kv;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _cached;[39m
[31m+   async store(dcs) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._cached) {[39m
[31m+       if (this._cached.main === dcs.main && this._cached.media === dcs.media) {[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._cached = dcs;[39m
[31m+     const { main: main2, media } = dcs;[39m
[31m+     const mainData = serializeBasicDcOption(main2);[39m
[31m+     await this._kv.set(KV_MAIN, mainData);[39m
[31m+     if (media !== main2) {[39m
[31m+       const mediaData = serializeBasicDcOption(media);[39m
[31m+       await this._kv.set(KV_MEDIA, mediaData);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async fetch() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._cached) return this._cached;[39m
[31m+     const [mainData, mediaData] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+       this._kv.get(KV_MAIN),[39m
[31m+       this._kv.get(KV_MEDIA)[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+     if (!mainData) return null;[39m
[31m+     const main2 = parseBasicDcOption(mainData);[39m
[31m+     if (!main2) return null;[39m
[31m+     const dcs = { main: main2, media: main2 };[39m
[31m+     if (mediaData) {[39m
[31m+       const media = parseBasicDcOption(mediaData);[39m
[31m+       if (media) {[39m
[31m+         dcs.media = media;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._cached = dcs;[39m
[31m+     return dcs;[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ var MtTypeAssertionError = class extends MtcuteError {[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Context at which the error occurred.[39m
[31m+    * Usually a user-friendly string containing name[39m
[31m+    * of the high-level API method, name of the TL[39m
[31m+    * RPC method, and path of the entity,[39m
[31m+    * like this: `signIn (@ auth.signIn -> user)`[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   context;[39m
[31m+   /** Expected TL type */[39m
[31m+   expected;[39m
[31m+   /** Actual TL type */[39m
[31m+   actual;[39m
[31m+   constructor(context, expected, actual) {[39m
[31m+     super(`Type assertion error at ${context}: expected ${expected}, but got ${actual}`);[39m
[31m+     this.context = context;[39m
[31m+     this.expected = expected;[39m
[31m+     this.actual = actual;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ var MtTimeoutError = class extends MtcuteError {[39m

[31m+     this.timeout = timeout2;[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/type-assertions.js[39m
[31m+ function isPresent(t) {[39m
[31m+   return t !== void 0 && t !== null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function hasValueAtKey(k, v) {[39m
[31m+   return function(a) {[39m
[31m+     return a[k] === v;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function assertTypeIs(context, obj, expected) {[39m
[31m+   if (obj._ !== expected) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtTypeAssertionError(context, expected, obj._);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function assertTypeIsNot(context, obj, expectedNot) {[39m
[31m+   if (obj._ === expectedNot) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtTypeAssertionError(context, `not ${expectedNot}`, obj._);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function mtpAssertTypeIs(context, obj, expected) {[39m
[31m+   if (obj._ !== expected) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtTypeAssertionError(context, expected, obj._);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function assertTrue(context, cond) {[39m
[31m+   if (!cond) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtTypeAssertionError(context, "true", "false");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   return typeof obj === "object" && obj !== null && obj._ === "mt_rpc_error";[39m

[31m+ var DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL = 2;[39m
[31m+ var FORMATTER_RE = /%[a-z]/gi;[39m
[31m+ var Logger = class _Logger {[39m
[31m+   constructor(mgr, tag, parent = mgr) {[39m
[31m+     this.mgr = mgr;[39m
[31m+     this.tag = tag;[39m
[31m+     this.parent = parent;[39m
[31m+     let hash = 0;[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < tag.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+       hash = (hash << 5) - hash + tag.charCodeAt(i);[39m
[31m+       hash |= 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.color = Math.abs(hash) % 6;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   color;[39m
[31m+   prefix = "";[39m
[31m+   getPrefix() {[39m
[31m+     let s = "";[39m
[31m+     let obj = this;[39m
[31m+     while (obj) {[39m
[31m+       if (obj.prefix) s = obj.prefix + s;[39m
[31m+       obj = obj.parent;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return s;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   log(level, fmt, ...args) {[39m
[31m+     if (level > this.mgr.level) return;[39m
[31m+     if (!this.mgr["_filter"](this.tag)) return;[39m
[31m+     if (fmt.includes("%h") || fmt.includes("%b") || fmt.includes("%j") || fmt.includes("%J") || fmt.includes("%l") || fmt.includes("%L") || fmt.includes("%e")) {[39m
[31m+       let idx = 0;[39m
[31m+       fmt = fmt.replace(FORMATTER_RE, (m3) => {[39m
[31m+         if (m3 === "%h" || m3 === "%b" || m3 === "%j" || m3 === "%J" || m3 === "%l" || m3 === "%L" || m3 === "%e") {[39m
[31m+           let val = args[idx];[39m
[31m+           args.splice(idx, 1);[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%h") {[39m
[31m+             if (ArrayBuffer.isView(val)) return hex_exports.encode(val);[39m
[31m+             if (typeof val === "number" || typeof val === "bigint") return val.toString(16);[39m
[31m+             return String(val);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%b") return String(Boolean(val));[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%j" || m3 === "%J") {[39m
[31m+             if (m3 === "%J") {[39m
[31m+               val = [...val];[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             return JSON.stringify(val, (k, v) => {[39m
[31m+               if (ArrayBuffer.isView(v) || typeof v === "object" && v.type === "Buffer" && Array.isArray(v.data)) {[39m
[31m+                 let str = v.data ? Buffer.from(v.data).toString("hex") : hex_exports.encode(v);[39m
[31m+                 if (str.length > 300) {[39m
[31m+                   str = `${str.slice(0, 300)}...`;[39m
[31m+                 }[39m
[31m+                 return str;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               return v;[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%l") return String(val);[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%L") {[39m
[31m+             if (!Array.isArray(val)) return "n/a";[39m
[31m+             return `[${val.map(String).join(", ")}]`;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (m3 === "%e") {[39m
[31m+             if (isTlRpcError(val)) {[39m
[31m+               return `${val.errorCode} ${val.errorMessage}`;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             if (RpcError.is(val)) {[39m
[31m+               return `${val.code} ${val.text}`;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             return val && typeof val === "object" ? val.stack || val.message : String(val);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         idx++;[39m
[31m+         return m3;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.mgr.handler(this.color, level, this.tag, this.getPrefix() + fmt, args);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   error = this.log.bind(this, LogManager.ERROR);[39m
[31m+   warn = this.log.bind(this, LogManager.WARN);[39m
[31m+   info = this.log.bind(this, LogManager.INFO);[39m
[31m+   debug = this.log.bind(this, LogManager.DEBUG);[39m
[31m+   verbose = this.log.bind(this, LogManager.VERBOSE);[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Create a {@link Logger} with the given tag[39m
[31m+    * from the same {@link LogManager} as the current[39m

[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param tag  Logger tag[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   create(tag) {[39m

[31m+     let timeout2;[39m

[31m+ var ConfigManager = class extends AsyncResource {[39m
[31m+   constructor(update) {[39m
[31m+     super({[39m
[31m+       fetcher: async () => {[39m
[31m+         const res = await update();[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           data: res,[39m
[31m+           expiresIn: res.expires * 1e3 - Date.now()[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       autoReload: true[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async findOption(params) {[39m
[31m+     if (this.isStale) await this.update();[39m
[31m+     const data = this.getCached();[39m
[31m+     const options = data.dcOptions.filter((opt) => {[39m
[31m+       if (opt.tcpoOnly) return false;[39m
[31m+       if (opt.ipv6 && !params.allowIpv6) return false;[39m
[31m+       if (opt.mediaOnly && !params.allowMedia) return false;[39m
[31m+       if (opt.cdn && !params.cdn) return false;[39m
[31m+       return opt.id === params.dcId;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (params.preferMedia && params.preferIpv6) {[39m
[31m+       const r = options.find((opt) => opt.mediaOnly && opt.ipv6);[39m
[31m+       if (r) return r;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (params.preferMedia) {[39m
[31m+       const r = options.find((opt) => opt.mediaOnly);[39m
[31m+       if (r) return r;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (params.preferIpv6) {[39m
[31m+       const r = options.find((opt) => opt.ipv6);[39m
[31m+       if (r) return r;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return options[0];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ function nextPowerOfTwo(n) {[39m
[31m+   n--;[39m
[31m+   n |= n >> 1;[39m
[31m+   n |= n >> 2;[39m
[31m+   n |= n >> 4;[39m
[31m+   n |= n >> 8;[39m
[31m+   n |= n >> 16;[39m
[31m+   return n + 1;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function isByobCapableStream(stream) {[39m

[31m+     const reader = stream.getReader({ mode: "byob" });[39m
[31m+     reader.releaseLock();[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+     if (e instanceof TypeError) {[39m
[31m+       return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     throw e;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@fuman/io/read/adapters.js[39m
[31m+ function webReadableToFuman(readable) {[39m
[31m+   if (isByobCapableStream(readable)) {[39m
[31m+     const reader2 = readable.getReader({ mode: "byob" });[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       async read(into) {[39m
[31m+         const temp = new Uint8Array(into.length);[39m
[31m+         const { value, done } = await reader2.read(temp);[39m
[31m+         if (done) return 0;[39m
[31m+         into.set(value);[39m
[31m+         return value.byteLength;[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       close() {[39m
[31m+         reader2.cancel().catch(() => {[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const reader = readable.getReader();[39m
[31m+   const buf = Bytes.alloc();[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     async read(into) {[39m
[31m+       if (buf.available === 0) {[39m
[31m+         const { value, done } = await reader.read();[39m
[31m+         if (done) return 0;[39m
[31m+         buf.writeSync(value.byteLength).set(value);[39m
[31m+         buf.disposeWriteSync();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const read = Math.min(into.length, buf.available);[39m
[31m+       into.set(buf.readSync(read), 0);[39m
[31m+       buf.reclaim();[39m
[31m+       return read;[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@fuman/net/ip/v4.js[39m
[31m+ function parseV4(input) {[39m
[31m+   const parts = u8_exports.alloc(4);[39m
[31m+   const octets = input.split(".");[39m
[31m+   const octetsCount = octets.length;[39m
[31m+   if (octetsCount === 1) {[39m
[31m+     const num = Number(octets[0]);[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isNaN(num) || num < 0 || num > 4294967295) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Invalid IPv4 address: ${input}`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     parts[0] = num >> 24 & 255;[39m
[31m+     parts[1] = num >> 16 & 255;[39m
[31m+     parts[2] = num >> 8 & 255;[39m
[31m+     parts[3] = num & 255;[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       type: "ipv4",[39m
[31m+       parts[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (octetsCount > 4) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error(`Invalid IPv4 address: ${input}`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let pos = 0;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < octetsCount; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const part = Number(octets[i]);[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isNaN(part) || part < 0 || part > 255) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Invalid IPv4 address: ${input}`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     parts[pos] = part;[39m
[31m+     if (octetsCount === 2 && pos === 0) {[39m
[31m+       pos += 2;[39m
[31m+     } else if (octetsCount === 3 && pos === 1) {[39m
[31m+       pos += 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     pos += 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     type: "ipv4",[39m
[31m+     parts[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function stringifyV4(ip) {[39m
[31m+   if (ip.parts.length !== 4) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error("Invalid IPv4 address");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return ip.parts.join(".");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function normalizeV4(input) {[39m
[31m+   return stringifyV4(parseV4(input));[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@fuman/net/ip/v6.js[39m
[31m+ var IPV6_PARTS = 8;[39m
[31m+ function parseV6(string) {[39m
[31m+   const parts = new Uint16Array(8);[39m
[31m+   let parsedParts = 0;[39m
[31m+   let afterDoubleColon;[39m
[31m+   let zoneId;[39m
[31m+   let currentPartStart = 0;[39m
[31m+   let ipv4Part = false;[39m
[31m+   let hadSquareBracket = false;[39m
[31m+   let pos = 0;[39m
[31m+   function addPart(str, part) {[39m
[31m+     if (str.length > 4 || Number.isNaN(part) || part < 0 || part > 65535) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 part: ${str} (in ${string})`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (afterDoubleColon) {[39m
[31m+       afterDoubleColon.push(part);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       parts[parsedParts] = part;[39m
[31m+       parsedParts += 1;[39m
[31m+       if (parsedParts > IPV6_PARTS) {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (too many parts): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   function handleCurrentPart() {[39m
[31m+     if (currentPartStart === pos) return;[39m
[31m+     const str = string.slice(currentPartStart, pos);[39m
[31m+     if (ipv4Part) {[39m
[31m+       const ipv4 = str.split(".");[39m
[31m+       if (ipv4.length !== 4) {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Invalid IPv4 part: ${str} (in ${string})`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       addPart("", Number.parseInt(ipv4[0], 10) << 8 | Number.parseInt(ipv4[1], 10));[39m
[31m+       addPart("", Number.parseInt(ipv4[2], 10) << 8 | Number.parseInt(ipv4[3], 10));[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const part = Number.parseInt(str, 16);[39m
[31m+     addPart(str, part);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   while (pos < string.length) {[39m
[31m+     const c = string[pos];[39m
[31m+     if (c === "%") {[39m
[31m+       handleCurrentPart();[39m
[31m+       pos += 1;[39m
[31m+       zoneId = string.slice(pos);[39m
[31m+       if (zoneId[zoneId.length - 1] === "]") {[39m
[31m+         zoneId = zoneId.slice(0, -1);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     } else if (c === "[") {[39m
[31m+       hadSquareBracket = true;[39m
[31m+       currentPartStart = pos + 1;[39m
[31m+     } else if (c === "]") {[39m
[31m+       if (!hadSquareBracket || pos !== string.length - 1 && string[pos + 1] !== "%") {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (unexpected closing bracket): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       handleCurrentPart();[39m
[31m+       currentPartStart = pos + 1;[39m
[31m+     } else if (c === ":") {[39m
[31m+       if (ipv4Part) {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (colon after IPv4 part): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (pos !== 0) {[39m
[31m+         handleCurrentPart();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (string[pos + 1] === ":") {[39m
[31m+         if (afterDoubleColon) {[39m
[31m+           throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (multiple double-colons): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         afterDoubleColon = [];[39m
[31m+         pos += 1;[39m
[31m+       } else if (pos === 0) {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (colon at the beginning): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       currentPartStart = pos + 1;[39m
[31m+     } else if (c === ".") {[39m
[31m+       ipv4Part = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     pos += 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!hadSquareBracket && zoneId === void 0) {[39m
[31m+     handleCurrentPart();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (afterDoubleColon) {[39m
[31m+     const missing = IPV6_PARTS - parsedParts - afterDoubleColon.length;[39m
[31m+     if (missing < 0) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (too many parts): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < missing; i++) {[39m
[31m+       parts[parsedParts + i] = 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < afterDoubleColon.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+       parts[parsedParts + missing + i] = afterDoubleColon[i];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } else if (parsedParts < IPV6_PARTS) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 address (too few parts): ${string}`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     type: "ipv6",[39m
[31m+     parts,[39m
[31m+     zoneId[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function stringifyV6(parsed, options) {[39m
[31m+   const {[39m
[31m+     zeroCompression = true,[39m
[31m+     fixedLength = false[39m
[31m+   } = options || {};[39m
[31m+   let result = "";[39m
[31m+   let compressStart = -1;[39m
[31m+   let compressEnd = 0;[39m
[31m+   if (zeroCompression) {[39m
[31m+     let maxLength = 0;[39m
[31m+     let maxStart = -1;[39m
[31m+     let start2 = -1;[39m
[31m+     let length = 0;[39m
[31m+     for (let i2 = 0; i2 < parsed.parts.length; i2++) {[39m
[31m+       if (parsed.parts[i2] === 0) {[39m
[31m+         if (start2 === -1) {[39m
[31m+           start2 = i2;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         length++;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         if (length > maxLength) {[39m
[31m+           maxLength = length;[39m
[31m+           maxStart = start2;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         start2 = -1;[39m
[31m+         length = 0;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (length > maxLength) {[39m
[31m+       maxLength = length;[39m
[31m+       maxStart = start2;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (maxLength > 1) {[39m
[31m+       compressStart = maxStart;[39m
[31m+       compressEnd = maxStart + maxLength;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let i = 0;[39m
[31m+   let writeColon = false;[39m
[31m+   while (i < parsed.parts.length) {[39m
[31m+     const part = parsed.parts[i];[39m
[31m+     if (part < 0 || part > 65535) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Invalid IPv6 part: ${part.toString(16)}`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (i === compressStart) {[39m
[31m+       result += "::";[39m
[31m+       i = compressEnd;[39m
[31m+       writeColon = false;[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (writeColon) result += ":";[39m
[31m+     else writeColon = true;[39m
[31m+     if (fixedLength) {[39m
[31m+       if (part < 16) result += "000";[39m
[31m+       else if (part < 256) result += "00";[39m
[31m+       else if (part < 4096) result += "0";[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     result += part.toString(16);[39m
[31m+     i += 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (parsed.zoneId != null) {[39m
[31m+     result += `%${parsed.zoneId}`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   "updates.getChannelDifference"[39m

[31m+ var SILENTLY_SLEEP_THRESHOLD = 5;[39m
[31m+ function floodWaiter(options) {[39m
[31m+   const {[39m
[31m+     maxWait = 1e4,[39m

[31m+     const numRetries = ctx.params?.maxRetryCount ?? maxRetries;[39m
[31m+     if (storedWaitUntil !== void 0) {[39m

[31m+       if (delta <= minStoredWait) {[39m

[31m+         await sleepWithAbort(delta, combineAbortSignals(ctx.manager.teardownSignal, ctx.params?.abortSignal));[39m
[31m+         storage.delete(method);[39m

[31m+         };[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let lastError;[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i <= numRetries; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const res = await next(ctx);[39m
[31m+       if (!isTlRpcError(res)) {[39m
[31m+         return res;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       lastError = res;[39m
[31m+       const err = res.errorMessage;[39m
[31m+       if (err.startsWith("FLOOD_WAIT_") || err.startsWith("SLOWMODE_WAIT_") || err.startsWith("FLOOD_TEST_PHONE_WAIT_") || err.startsWith("FLOOD_PREMIUM_WAIT_")) {[39m
[31m+         let seconds = Number(err.slice(err.lastIndexOf("_") + 1));[39m
[31m+         if (Number.isNaN(seconds)) {[39m

[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (seconds === 0) {[39m
[31m+           seconds = 1;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         const ms = seconds * 1e3;[39m
[31m+         if (ms <= floodSleepThreshold) {[39m
[31m+           if (onBeforeWait) {[39m
[31m+             onBeforeWait(ctx, seconds);[39m
[31m+           } else if (!(seconds < SILENTLY_SLEEP_THRESHOLD && SILENTLY_SLEEP_METHODS.has(method))) {[39m
[31m+             ctx.manager._log.warn("%s resulted in a flood wait, will retry in %d seconds", method, seconds);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           await sleepWithAbort([39m
[31m+             ms,[39m
[31m+             combineAbortSignals(ctx.manager.teardownSignal, ctx.params?.abortSignal)[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return lastError;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/resource-limiter.js[39m
[31m+ var ResourceLimiter = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(max3) {[39m
[31m+     this.max = max3;[39m
[31m+     this._available = max3;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _available;[39m
[31m+   _waiters = [];[39m
[31m+   setMax(max3) {[39m
[31m+     this._available += max3 - this.max;[39m
[31m+     this.max = max3;[39m
[31m+     this._pump();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   tryAcquire(bytes2) {[39m
[31m+     if (bytes2 > this.max) bytes2 = this.max;[39m
[31m+     if (!this._waiters.length && this._available >= bytes2) {[39m
[31m+       this._available -= bytes2;[39m
[31m+       return true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   acquire(bytes2, signal) {[39m
[31m+     if (this.tryAcquire(bytes2)) return Promise.resolve();[39m
[31m+     if (bytes2 > this.max) bytes2 = this.max;[39m
[31m+     const deferred = new Deferred();[39m
[31m+     const waiter = { need: bytes2, deferred };[39m
[31m+     this._waiters.push(waiter);[39m
[31m+     if (signal) {[39m
[31m+       const onAbort = () => {[39m
[31m+         const idx = this._waiters.indexOf(waiter);[39m
[31m+         if (idx >= 0) this._waiters.splice(idx, 1);[39m
[31m+         deferred.reject(signal.reason);[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });[39m
[31m+       const removeListener = signal.removeEventListener.bind(signal, "abort", onAbort);[39m
[31m+       deferred.promise.then(removeListener, removeListener);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return deferred.promise;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   release(bytes2) {[39m
[31m+     if (bytes2 > this.max) bytes2 = this.max;[39m
[31m+     this._available += bytes2;[39m
[31m+     this._pump();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _pump() {[39m
[31m+     while (this._waiters.length && this._waiters[0].need <= this._available) {[39m
[31m+       const waiter = this._waiters.shift();[39m
[31m+       this._available -= waiter.need;[39m
[31m+       waiter.deferred.resolve();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/early-timer.js[39m
[31m+ var EarlyTimer = class {[39m
[31m+   _timeout;[39m
[31m+   _timeoutTs;[39m
[31m+   _handler = () => {[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   constructor() {[39m
[31m+     this.emitNow = this.emitNow.bind(this);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Emit the timer when the event loop is idle[39m
[31m+    * (basically `queueMicrotask()`)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   emitWhenIdle() {[39m
[31m+     timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._timeout);[39m
[31m+     this._timeoutTs = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     queueMicrotask(this.emitNow);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Emit the timer before the next given milliseconds[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Emit the timer before the given time[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param ts  timestamp in ms relative to `performance.timeOrigin`[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   emitBefore(ts) {[39m

[31m+       this.reset();[39m
[31m+       const diff = ts - performance.now();[39m
[31m+       this._timeout = timers_exports.setTimeout(this.emitNow, Math.max(diff, 0));[39m
[31m+       this._timeoutTs = ts;[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Emit the timer right now[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   emitNow() {[39m
[31m+     this.reset();[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m

[31m+    */[39m

[31m+     timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._timeout);[39m
[31m+     this._timeoutTs = void 0;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Set timeout handler[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   onTimeout(handler) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ function millerRabin(crypto, n, rounds = 20) {[39m
[31m+   if (n < 4n) return n > 1n;[39m
[31m+   if (n % 2n === 0n || n < 0n) return false;[39m
[31m+   const nBits = bundle_exports.bitLength(n);[39m
[31m+   const nSub = n - 1n;[39m
[31m+   const r = bundle_exports.twoMultiplicity(nSub);[39m
[31m+   const d = nSub >> r;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {[39m
[31m+     let base;[39m
[31m+     do {[39m
[31m+       base = randomBigIntBits(crypto, nBits);[39m
[31m+     } while (base <= 1n || base >= nSub);[39m
[31m+     let x = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(base, d, n);[39m
[31m+     if (x === 1n || x === nSub) continue;[39m
[31m+     let i2 = 0n;[39m
[31m+     let y;[39m
[31m+     while (i2 < r) {[39m
[31m+       y = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(x, 2n, n);[39m
[31m+       if (x === 1n) return false;[39m
[31m+       if (x === nSub) break;[39m
[31m+       i2 += 1n;[39m
[31m+       x = y;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (i2 === r) return false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return true;[39m

[31m+ function checkDhPrime(crypto, log, dhPrime, g) {[39m

[31m+   if (!checkedPrime) {[39m

[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: dh_prime is not in the 2048-bit range");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!millerRabin(crypto, dhPrime)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: dh_prime is not prime");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!millerRabin(crypto, (dhPrime - 1n) / 2n)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: dh_prime is not a safe prime - (dh_prime-1)/2 is not prime");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     log.debug("dh_prime is probably prime");[39m
[31m+     checkedPrime = {[39m
[31m+       prime: dhPrime,[39m
[31m+       generators: [][39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     checkedPrimesCache.push(checkedPrime);[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     log.debug("dh_prime is probably prime (cached)");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const generatorChecked = checkedPrime.generators.includes(g);[39m
[31m+   if (generatorChecked) {[39m
[31m+     log.debug("g = %d is already checked for dh_prime", g);[39m
[31m+     return;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   switch (g) {[39m
[31m+     case 2:[39m
[31m+       if (dhPrime % 8n !== 7n) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: ivalid g - dh_prime mod 8 != 7");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case 3:[39m
[31m+       if (dhPrime % 3n !== 2n) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: ivalid g - dh_prime mod 3 != 2");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case 4:[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case 5: {[39m
[31m+       const mod = dhPrime % 5n;[39m
[31m+       if (mod !== 1n && mod !== 4n) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: ivalid g - dh_prime mod 5 != 1 && dh_prime mod 5 != 4");[39m
[31m+       }[39m

[31m+   for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+     const aesIv = u8_exports.alloc(32);[39m
[31m+     const aesKey = crypto.randomBytes(32);[39m
[31m+     const dataWithHash = u8_exports.concat2(data, crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat2(aesKey, data)));[39m
[31m+     dataWithHash.subarray(0, 192).reverse();[39m
[31m+     const aes = crypto.createAesIge(aesKey, aesIv);[39m
[31m+     const encrypted = aes.encrypt(dataWithHash);[39m
[31m+     const encryptedHash = crypto.sha256(encrypted);[39m
[31m+     u8_exports.xorInPlace(aesKey, encryptedHash);[39m
[31m+     const decryptedData = u8_exports.concat2(aesKey, encrypted);[39m
[31m+     const decryptedDataBigint = bundle_exports.fromBytes(decryptedData);[39m
[31m+     if (decryptedDataBigint >= keyModulus) {[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const encryptedBigint = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(decryptedDataBigint, keyExponent, keyModulus);[39m
[31m+     return bundle_exports.toBytes(encryptedBigint, 256);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function rsaEncrypt(data, crypto, key) {[39m
[31m+   const toEncrypt = u8_exports.concat3([39m
[31m+     crypto.sha1(data),[39m
[31m+     data,[39m
[31m+     // sha1 is always 20 bytes, so we're left with 255 - 20 - x padding[39m
[31m+     crypto.randomBytes(235 - data.length)[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const encryptedBigInt = bundle_exports.modPowBinary([39m
[31m+     bundle_exports.fromBytes(toEncrypt),[39m
[31m+     BigInt(`0x${key.exponent}`),[39m
[31m+     BigInt(`0x${key.modulus}`)[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   return bundle_exports.toBytes(encryptedBigInt);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function doAuthorization(connection, crypto, expiresIn) {[39m
[31m+   const session2 = connection["_session"];[39m
[31m+   const readerMap = session2._readerMap;[39m
[31m+   const writerMap = session2._writerMap;[39m
[31m+   const log = connection.log.create("auth");[39m
[31m+   function sendPlainMessage(message2) {[39m
[31m+     const length = TlSerializationCounter.countNeededBytes(writerMap, message2);[39m
[31m+     const writer = TlBinaryWriter.alloc(writerMap, length + 20);[39m
[31m+     const messageId = session2.getMessageId();[39m
[31m+     log.verbose("[PLAIN] >>> %j", message2);[39m
[31m+     writer.long(long_default.ZERO);[39m
[31m+     writer.long(messageId);[39m
[31m+     writer.uint(length);[39m
[31m+     writer.object(message2);[39m
[31m+     return connection.send(writer.result());[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async function readNext() {[39m
[31m+     const res = TlBinaryReader.deserializeObject([39m
[31m+       readerMap,[39m
[31m+       await connection.waitForUnencryptedMessage(),[39m
[31m+       20[39m
[31m+       // skip mtproto header[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     log.verbose("[PLAIN] <<< %j", res);[39m
[31m+     return res;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (expiresIn) log.prefix = "[PFS] ";[39m
[31m+   const nonce = crypto.randomBytes(16);[39m
[31m+   log.debug("starting PQ handshake (temp = %b), nonce = %h", expiresIn, nonce);[39m
[31m+   await sendPlainMessage({ _: "mt_req_pq_multi", nonce });[39m
[31m+   const resPq = await readNext();[39m
[31m+   mtpAssertTypeIs("auth step 1", resPq, "mt_resPQ");[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(resPq.nonce, nonce)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 1: invalid nonce from server");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const serverKeys = resPq.serverPublicKeyFingerprints.map((it) => it.toUnsigned().toString(16));[39m
[31m+   log.debug("received PQ, keys: %j", serverKeys);[39m
[31m+   const publicKey = findKeyByFingerprints(serverKeys);[39m
[31m+   if (!publicKey) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError([39m
[31m+       `Step 2: Could not find server public key with any of these fingerprints: ${serverKeys.join(", ")}`[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   log.debug("found server key, fp = %s, old = %s", publicKey.fingerprint, publicKey.old);[39m
[31m+   if (millerRabin(crypto, bundle_exports.fromBytes(resPq.pq))) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 2: pq is prime");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const [p, q] = await crypto.factorizePQ(resPq.pq);[39m
[31m+   log.debug("factorized PQ: PQ = %h, P = %h, Q = %h", resPq.pq, p, q);[39m
[31m+   const newNonce = crypto.randomBytes(32);[39m
[31m+   let dcId = connection.params.dc.id;[39m
[31m+   if (connection.params.testMode) dcId += 1e4;[39m
[31m+   if (connection.params.dc.mediaOnly) dcId = -dcId;[39m
[31m+   const _pqInnerData = {[39m
[31m+     _: expiresIn ? "mt_p_q_inner_data_temp_dc" : "mt_p_q_inner_data_dc",[39m
[31m+     pq: resPq.pq,[39m
[31m+     p,[39m
[31m+     q,[39m
[31m+     nonce,[39m
[31m+     newNonce,[39m
[31m+     serverNonce: resPq.serverNonce,[39m
[31m+     dc: dcId,[39m
[31m+     expiresIn[39m
[31m+     // whatever[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   const pqInnerData = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(writerMap, _pqInnerData);[39m
[31m+   const encryptedData = publicKey.old ? rsaEncrypt(pqInnerData, crypto, publicKey) : rsaPad(pqInnerData, crypto, publicKey);[39m
[31m+   log.debug("requesting DH params");[39m
[31m+   await sendPlainMessage({[39m
[31m+     _: "mt_req_DH_params",[39m
[31m+     nonce,[39m
[31m+     serverNonce: resPq.serverNonce,[39m
[31m+     p,[39m
[31m+     q,[39m
[31m+     publicKeyFingerprint: long_default.fromString(publicKey.fingerprint, true, 16),[39m
[31m+     encryptedData[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   const serverDhParams = await readNext();[39m
[31m+   mtpAssertTypeIs("auth step 2", serverDhParams, "mt_server_DH_params_ok");[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(serverDhParams.nonce, nonce)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 2: invalid nonce from server");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(serverDhParams.serverNonce, resPq.serverNonce)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 2: invalid server nonce from server");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   log.debug("server DH ok");[39m
[31m+   if (serverDhParams.encryptedAnswer.length % 16 !== 0) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 2: AES block size is invalid");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const [key, iv] = generateKeyAndIvFromNonce(crypto, resPq.serverNonce, newNonce);[39m
[31m+   const ige = crypto.createAesIge(key, iv);[39m
[31m+   const plainTextAnswer = ige.decrypt(serverDhParams.encryptedAnswer);[39m
[31m+   const innerDataHash = plainTextAnswer.subarray(0, 20);[39m
[31m+   const serverDhInnerReader = new TlBinaryReader(readerMap, plainTextAnswer, 20);[39m
[31m+   const serverDhInner = serverDhInnerReader.object();[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(innerDataHash, crypto.sha1(plainTextAnswer.subarray(20, serverDhInnerReader.pos)))) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("Step 3: invalid inner data hash");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   mtpAssertTypeIs("auth step 3", serverDhInner, "mt_server_DH_inner_data");[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(serverDhInner.nonce, nonce)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error("Step 3: invalid nonce from server");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!typed_exports.equal(serverDhInner.serverNonce, resPq.serverNonce)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error("Step 3: invalid server nonce from server");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const dhPrime = bundle_exports.fromBytes(serverDhInner.dhPrime);[39m
[31m+   const timeOffset = serverDhInner.serverTime - Math.floor(performance.now() / 1e3);[39m
[31m+   session2.updateTimeOffset(timeOffset, true);[39m
[31m+   const g = BigInt(serverDhInner.g);[39m
[31m+   const gA = bundle_exports.fromBytes(serverDhInner.gA);[39m
[31m+   checkDhPrime(crypto, log, dhPrime, serverDhInner.g);[39m
[31m+   let retryId = long_default.ZERO;[39m
[31m+   const serverSalt = u8_exports.xor(newNonce.subarray(0, 8), resPq.serverNonce.subarray(0, 8));[39m
[31m+   for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+     const b = bundle_exports.fromBytes(crypto.randomBytes(256));[39m
[31m+     const gB = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(g, b, dhPrime);[39m
[31m+     const authKey = bundle_exports.toBytes(bundle_exports.modPowBinary(gA, b, dhPrime));[39m
[31m+     const authKeyAuxHash = crypto.sha1(authKey).subarray(0, 8);[39m
[31m+     if (g <= 1 || g >= dhPrime - 1n) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("g is not within (1, dh_prime - 1)");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (gA <= 1 || gA >= dhPrime - 1n) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("g_a is not within (1, dh_prime - 1)");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (gB <= 1 || gB >= dhPrime - 1n) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("g_b is not within (1, dh_prime - 1)");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (gA <= DH_SAFETY_RANGE || gA >= dhPrime - DH_SAFETY_RANGE) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("g_a is not within (2^{2048-64}, dh_prime - 2^{2048-64})");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (gB <= DH_SAFETY_RANGE || gB >= dhPrime - DH_SAFETY_RANGE) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("g_b is not within (2^{2048-64}, dh_prime - 2^{2048-64})");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const gB_ = bundle_exports.toBytes(gB, 0);[39m
[31m+     const clientDhInner = {[39m
[31m+       _: "mt_client_DH_inner_data",[39m
[31m+       nonce,[39m
[31m+       serverNonce: resPq.serverNonce,[39m
[31m+       retryId,[39m
[31m+       gB: gB_[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     let innerLength = TlSerializationCounter.countNeededBytes(writerMap, clientDhInner) + 20;[39m
[31m+     const innerPaddingLength = innerLength % 16;[39m
[31m+     if (innerPaddingLength > 0) innerLength += 16 - innerPaddingLength;[39m
[31m+     const clientDhInnerWriter = TlBinaryWriter.alloc(writerMap, innerLength);[39m
[31m+     clientDhInnerWriter.pos = 20;[39m
[31m+     clientDhInnerWriter.object(clientDhInner);[39m
[31m+     const clientDhInnerHash = crypto.sha1(clientDhInnerWriter.uint8View.subarray(20, clientDhInnerWriter.pos));[39m
[31m+     clientDhInnerWriter.pos = 0;[39m
[31m+     clientDhInnerWriter.raw(clientDhInnerHash);[39m
[31m+     log.debug("sending client DH (timeOffset = %d)", timeOffset);[39m
[31m+     const clientDhEncrypted = ige.encrypt(clientDhInnerWriter.uint8View);[39m
[31m+     await sendPlainMessage({[39m
[31m+       _: "mt_set_client_DH_params",[39m
[31m+       nonce,[39m
[31m+       serverNonce: resPq.serverNonce,[39m
[31m+       encryptedData: clientDhEncrypted[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     const dhGen = await readNext();[39m
[31m+     if (!isAnySet_client_DH_params_answer(dhGen)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtTypeAssertionError("auth step 4", "set_client_DH_params_answer", dhGen._);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!typed_exports.equal(dhGen.nonce, nonce)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 4: invalid nonce from server");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!typed_exports.equal(dhGen.serverNonce, resPq.serverNonce)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 4: invalid server nonce from server");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     log.debug("DH result: %s", dhGen._);[39m
[31m+     if (dhGen._ === "mt_dh_gen_fail") {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtTypeAssertionError("auth step 4", "!mt_dh_gen_fail", dhGen._);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (dhGen._ === "mt_dh_gen_retry") {[39m
[31m+       const expectedHash2 = crypto.sha1(u8_exports.concat3(newNonce, [2], authKeyAuxHash));[39m
[31m+       if (!typed_exports.equal(expectedHash2.subarray(4, 20), dhGen.newNonceHash2)) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtSecurityError("Step 4: invalid retry nonce hash from server");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       retryId = long_default.fromBytesLE(authKeyAuxHash);[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (dhGen._ !== "mt_dh_gen_ok") throw new Error("unreachable");[39m
[31m+     const expectedHash = crypto.sha1(u8_exports.concat3(newNonce, [1], authKeyAuxHash));[39m
[31m+     if (!typed_exports.equal(expectedHash.subarray(4, 20), dhGen.newNonceHash1)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtSecurityError("Step 4: invalid nonce hash from server");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     log.info("authorization successful");[39m
[31m+     const dv = typed_exports.toDataView(serverSalt);[39m
[31m+     return [authKey, new long_default(dv.getInt32(0, true), dv.getInt32(4, true)), timeOffset];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/sorted-array.js[39m
[31m+ var SortedArray = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(array = [], comparator) {[39m
[31m+     this.comparator = comparator;[39m
[31m+     this.raw = array.sort(comparator);[39m
[31m+     this.comparator = comparator;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   raw;[39m
[31m+   get length() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.length;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   insert(item) {[39m
[31m+     if (Array.isArray(item)) {[39m
[31m+       let ind = -1;[39m
[31m+       item.forEach((it) => {[39m
[31m+         ind = this.insert(it);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       return ind;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this.raw.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       this.raw.push(item);[39m
[31m+       return 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let lo = 0;[39m
[31m+     let hi = this.raw.length;[39m
[31m+     while (lo < hi) {[39m
[31m+       const mid = Math.floor((lo + hi) / 2);[39m
[31m+       if (this.comparator(this.raw[mid], item) > 0) {[39m
[31m+         hi = mid;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         lo = mid + 1;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.raw.splice(lo, 0, item);[39m
[31m+     return lo;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   // closest: return the closest value (right-hand side)[39m
[31m+   // meaning that raw[idx - 1] <= item <= raw[idx][39m
[31m+   // in other words, smallest idx such that raw[idx] >= item[39m
[31m+   index(item, closest = false) {[39m
[31m+     let lo = 0;[39m
[31m+     let hi = this.raw.length;[39m
[31m+     while (lo < hi) {[39m
[31m+       const mid = Math.floor((lo + hi) / 2);[39m
[31m+       const cmp = this.comparator(this.raw[mid], item);[39m
[31m+       if (cmp === 0) {[39m
[31m+         return mid;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (cmp > 0) {[39m
[31m+         hi = mid;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         lo = mid + 1;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return closest ? lo : -1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   remove(item) {[39m
[31m+     const idx = this.raw.indexOf(item);[39m
[31m+     if (idx === -1) return;[39m
[31m+     this.raw.splice(idx, 1);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   removeIndex(idx) {[39m
[31m+     this.raw.splice(idx, 1);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   includes(item) {[39m
[31m+     return this.index(item) !== -1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   find(item) {[39m
[31m+     const ind = this.index(item);[39m
[31m+     return ind === -1 ? null : this.raw[ind];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   clear() {[39m
[31m+     this.raw.length = 0;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   popFront() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.shift();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/auth-key.js[39m
[31m+ var AuthKey = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(_crypto, log, _readerMap) {[39m
[31m+     this._crypto = _crypto;[39m
[31m+     this.log = log;[39m
[31m+     this._readerMap = _readerMap;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ready = false;[39m
[31m+   key;[39m
[31m+   id;[39m
[31m+   clientSalt;[39m
[31m+   serverSalt;[39m
[31m+   match(keyId) {[39m
[31m+     return this.ready && typed_exports.equal(keyId, this.id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setup(authKey) {[39m
[31m+     if (!authKey) return this.reset();[39m
[31m+     this.ready = true;[39m
[31m+     this.key = authKey;[39m
[31m+     this.clientSalt = authKey.subarray(88, 120);[39m
[31m+     this.serverSalt = authKey.subarray(96, 128);[39m
[31m+     this.id = this._crypto.sha1(authKey).subarray(-8);[39m
[31m+     this.log.verbose("auth key set up, id = %h", this.id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   encryptMessage(message2, serverSalt, sessionId) {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.ready) throw new MtcuteError("Keys are not set up!");[39m
[31m+     let padding = (16 + message2.length + 12) % 16;[39m
[31m+     padding = 12 + (padding ? 16 - padding : 0);[39m
[31m+     const buf = u8_exports.alloc(16 + message2.length + padding);[39m
[31m+     const dv = typed_exports.toDataView(buf);[39m
[31m+     dv.setInt32(0, serverSalt.low, true);[39m
[31m+     dv.setInt32(4, serverSalt.high, true);[39m
[31m+     dv.setInt32(8, sessionId.low, true);[39m
[31m+     dv.setInt32(12, sessionId.high, true);[39m
[31m+     buf.set(message2, 16);[39m
[31m+     this._crypto.randomFill(buf.subarray(16 + message2.length, 16 + message2.length + padding));[39m
[31m+     const messageKey = this._crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat2(this.clientSalt, buf)).subarray(8, 24);[39m
[31m+     const ige = createAesIgeForMessage(this._crypto, this.key, messageKey, true);[39m
[31m+     const encryptedData = ige.encrypt(buf);[39m
[31m+     return u8_exports.concat3(this.id, messageKey, encryptedData);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   decryptMessage(data, sessionId, callback) {[39m
[31m+     const messageKey = data.subarray(8, 24);[39m
[31m+     let encryptedData = data.subarray(24);[39m
[31m+     const mod16 = encryptedData.byteLength % 16;[39m
[31m+     if (mod16 !== 0) {[39m
[31m+       encryptedData = encryptedData.subarray(0, encryptedData.byteLength - mod16);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const ige = createAesIgeForMessage(this._crypto, this.key, messageKey, false);[39m
[31m+     const innerData = ige.decrypt(encryptedData);[39m
[31m+     const msgKeySource = this._crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat2(this.serverSalt, innerData));[39m
[31m+     const expectedMessageKey = msgKeySource.subarray(8, 24);[39m
[31m+     if (!typed_exports.equal(messageKey, expectedMessageKey)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received message with invalid messageKey = %h (expected %h)", messageKey, expectedMessageKey);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const innerReader = new TlBinaryReader(this._readerMap, innerData);[39m
[31m+     innerReader.seek(8);[39m
[31m+     const sessionId_ = innerReader.long();[39m
[31m+     const messageId = innerReader.long(true);[39m
[31m+     if (sessionId_.neq(sessionId)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("ignoring message with invalid sessionId = %h", sessionId_);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const seqNo = innerReader.uint();[39m
[31m+     const length = innerReader.uint();[39m
[31m+     if (length > innerData.length - 32) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("ignoring message with invalid length: %d > %d", length, innerData.length - 32);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (length % 4 !== 0) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("ignoring message with invalid length: %d is not a multiple of 4", length);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const paddingSize = innerData.length - length - 32;[39m
[31m+     if (paddingSize < 12 || paddingSize > 1024) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("ignoring message with invalid padding size: %d", paddingSize);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     callback(messageId, seqNo, innerReader);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   copyFrom(authKey) {[39m
[31m+     this.ready = authKey.ready;[39m

[31m+ var MessageIdStore = class {[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/flood-control.js[39m
[31m+ var FloodControl = class {[39m
[31m+   _rules;[39m
[31m+   _maxWindow;[39m
[31m+   _events = [];[39m
[31m+   constructor(rules) {[39m
[31m+     if (rules.length === 0) throw new Error("FloodControl needs at least one rule");[39m
[31m+     this._rules = rules;[39m
[31m+     this._maxWindow = rules.reduce((m3, r) => Math.max(m3, r.windowMs), 0);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /** Earliest absolute perf-now ms at which a new event is permitted. */[39m
[31m+   getWakeupAt(now) {[39m
[31m+     let wakeup = 0;[39m
[31m+     for (const { count, windowMs } of this._rules) {[39m
[31m+       const cutoff = now - windowMs;[39m
[31m+       let inWindow = 0;[39m
[31m+       let oldestInWindowIdx = -1;[39m
[31m+       for (let i = this._events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {[39m
[31m+         if (this._events[i] <= cutoff) break;[39m
[31m+         inWindow++;[39m
[31m+         oldestInWindowIdx = i;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (inWindow >= count) {[39m
[31m+         const t = this._events[oldestInWindowIdx] + windowMs;[39m
[31m+         if (t > wakeup) wakeup = t;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return wakeup;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   addEvent(now) {[39m
[31m+     this._events.push(now);[39m
[31m+     this._prune(now);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _prune(now) {[39m
[31m+     const cutoff = now - this._maxWindow;[39m
[31m+     let i = 0;[39m
[31m+     while (i < this._events.length && this._events[i] < cutoff) i++;[39m
[31m+     if (i > 0) this._events.splice(0, i);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   reset() {[39m
[31m+     this._events = [];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ var DEFAULT_SANITY_LIMITS = [[39m
[31m+   { count: 5, windowMs: 1e4 }[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+ var DEFAULT_FLOOD_LIMITS = [[39m
[31m+   { count: 1, windowMs: 1e3 },[39m
[31m+   { count: 4, windowMs: 2e3 },[39m
[31m+   { count: 8, windowMs: 3e3 }[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+ var DEFAULT_MTPROTO_ERROR_LIMITS = [[39m
[31m+   { count: 1, windowMs: 1e3 },[39m
[31m+   { count: 4, windowMs: 2e3 },[39m
[31m+   { count: 8, windowMs: 3e3 }[39m
[31m+ ];[39m
[31m+ var ConnectionFloodController = class {[39m
[31m+   sanity;[39m
[31m+   flood;[39m
[31m+   mtprotoError;[39m
[31m+   _log;[39m
[31m+   constructor(limits = {}) {[39m
[31m+     this.sanity = new FloodControl(limits.sanity ?? DEFAULT_SANITY_LIMITS);[39m
[31m+     this.flood = new FloodControl(limits.flood ?? DEFAULT_FLOOD_LIMITS);[39m
[31m+     this.mtprotoError = new FloodControl(limits.mtprotoError ?? DEFAULT_MTPROTO_ERROR_LIMITS);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setLogger(log) {[39m
[31m+     this._log = log;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Notify a network-up transition.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * TDLib clears sanity + online-regime flood + backoff on[39m
[31m+    * `ConnectionCreator::on_network(true)`. We don't model the online regime,[39m
[31m+    * and our transport layer owns its own reconnect backoff, so only the[39m
[31m+    * sanity limiter is reset here.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   notifyNetworkUp() {[39m
[31m+     this._log?.debug("network up, resetting sanity limiter");[39m
[31m+     this.sanity.reset();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /** Record an MTProto-level error (transport 429; per TDLib, other codes don't tick this). */[39m
[31m+   addMtprotoError(now = performance.now()) {[39m
[31m+     this._log?.debug("recording mtproto error");[39m
[31m+     this.mtprotoError.addEvent(now);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /** Earliest perf-now ms at which a new connection attempt is permitted. */[39m
[31m+   getWakeupAt(now) {[39m
[31m+     return Math.max([39m
[31m+       this.sanity.getWakeupAt(now),[39m
[31m+       this.flood.getWakeupAt(now),[39m
[31m+       this.mtprotoError.getWakeupAt(now)[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Block until a connection attempt is permitted under all applicable[39m
[31m+    * limiters, then record the attempt. Concurrent waiters serialize fairly[39m
[31m+    * because the first to wake records its event before the next checks state.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * If `signal` aborts, the pending timer is cleared and the promise rejects[39m
[31m+    * with the signal's reason.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async wait(signal) {[39m
[31m+     let waited = false;[39m
[31m+     while (true) {[39m
[31m+       signal?.throwIfAborted();[39m
[31m+       const now = performance.now();[39m
[31m+       const wakeup = this.getWakeupAt(now);[39m
[31m+       if (wakeup <= now) {[39m
[31m+         this.sanity.addEvent(now);[39m
[31m+         this.flood.addEvent(now);[39m
[31m+         if (waited) this._log?.debug("admitted connect after waiting");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const delay = wakeup - now;[39m
[31m+       this._log?.debug("connect throttled (waiting %dms)", Math.round(delay));[39m
[31m+       waited = true;[39m
[31m+       await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {[39m
[31m+         const handle = timers_exports.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+           signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);[39m
[31m+           resolve();[39m
[31m+         }, delay);[39m
[31m+         const onAbort = () => {[39m
[31m+           timers_exports.clearTimeout(handle);[39m
[31m+           reject(signal.reason);[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /** Reset all internal state. Mainly for tests. */[39m
[31m+   reset() {[39m
[31m+     this.sanity.reset();[39m
[31m+     this.flood.reset();[39m
[31m+     this.mtprotoError.reset();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     this._updateLogPrefix();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _uid = nextConnectionUid++;[39m
[31m+   params;[39m
[31m+   _sendOnceConnected = [];[39m
[31m+   _codec;[39m
[31m+   _fuman;[39m
[31m+   // reconnection[39m
[31m+   _disconnectedManually = false;[39m
[31m+   // inactivity timeout[39m
[31m+   _inactivityTimeout = null;[39m
[31m+   _inactive = true;[39m
[31m+   _destroyed = false;[39m
[31m+   _usable = false;[39m
[31m+   // each connection slot throttles its own connect attempts, mirroring[39m
[31m+   // TDLib's per-SessionProxy flood control. a fresh controller has empty[39m
[31m+   // limiters, so the first connect always passes immediately.[39m
[31m+   _floodControl;[39m
[31m+   // aborts a pending flood-control wait when the connection is being[39m
[31m+   // closed (manually or for good) — otherwise close() would block until[39m
[31m+   // the wait expires, and the connect would still proceed afterwards[39m
[31m+   _connectAbort;[39m
[31m+   onWait = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onUsable = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onError = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   _updateLogPrefix() {[39m
[31m+     const uidPrefix = `[UID ${this._uid}] `;[39m
[31m+     if (this._fuman.isConnected) {[39m
[31m+       const dc = this.params.dc;[39m
[31m+       const prettifiedIp = bundle_exports2.prettify(dc.ipAddress, { encloseIpv6: true });[39m
[31m+       this.log.prefix = `${uidPrefix}[DC ${dc.id} @ ${prettifiedIp}:${dc.port}] `;[39m
[31m+     } else if (this._fuman.isConnecting) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.prefix = `${uidPrefix}[connecting] `;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this.log.prefix = `${uidPrefix}[disconnected] `;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   get isConnected() {[39m
[31m+     return this._fuman.isConnected;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _writer;[39m
[31m+   _mtproxyInfo;[39m
[31m+   async _onOpen(conn) {[39m
[31m+     this._updateLogPrefix();[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("connected");[39m
[31m+     const tag = await this._codec.tag();[39m
[31m+     if (tag) {[39m
[31m+       await conn.write(tag);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._mtproxyInfo = conn.getMtproxyInfo?.();[39m
[31m+     const reader = new FramedReader(conn, this._codec);[39m
[31m+     this._writer = new FramedWriter(conn, this._codec);[39m
[31m+     while (this._sendOnceConnected.length) {[39m
[31m+       const data = this._sendOnceConnected.shift();[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         await this._writer.write(data);[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         this._sendOnceConnected.unshift(data);[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._rescheduleInactivity();[39m
[31m+     this.onUsable.emit();[39m
[31m+     this.onConnected();[39m
[31m+     while (true) {[39m
[31m+       const msg = await reader.read();[39m
[31m+       if (msg) {[39m
[31m+         this.onMessage(msg);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onClose() {[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("connection closed");[39m
[31m+     this._updateLogPrefix();[39m
[31m+     this._writer = void 0;[39m
[31m+     this._codec.reset();[39m
[31m+     this.onClosed();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onError(err) {[39m
[31m+     this._updateLogPrefix();[39m
[31m+     if (!(err instanceof ConnectionClosedError)) {[39m
[31m+       this.handleError(err);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return "reconnect";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async changeTransport(transport) {[39m
[31m+     this._connectAbort?.abort();[39m
[31m+     await this._fuman.close();[39m
[31m+     this._codec = transport.packetCodec(this.params.dc);[39m
[31m+     this._codec.setup?.(this.params.crypto, this.log);[39m
[31m+     await this._fuman.changeTransport(transport.connect.bind(transport));[39m
[31m+     this._fuman.connect(this.params.dc);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   connect() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._destroyed) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("tried to connect a destroyed connection, ignoring");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._fuman.connect(this.params.dc);[39m
[31m+     this._inactive = false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   reconnect() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._destroyed) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("tried to reconnect a destroyed connection, ignoring");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._disconnectedManually) {[39m
[31m+       this._disconnectedManually = false;[39m
[31m+       this.connect();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._fuman.reconnect(true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async disconnectManual() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactivityTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._disconnectedManually = true;[39m
[31m+     this._connectAbort?.abort();[39m
[31m+     await this._fuman.close();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async destroy() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactivityTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._destroyed = true;[39m
[31m+     this._connectAbort?.abort();[39m
[31m+     await this._fuman.close();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _rescheduleInactivity() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.params.inactivityTimeout) return;[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactivityTimeout) timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+     this._inactivityTimeout = timers_exports.setTimeout(this._onInactivityTimeout, this.params.inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onInactivityTimeout() {[39m
[31m+     this.log.info("disconnected because of inactivity for %d", this.params.inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+     this._inactive = true;[39m
[31m+     this._inactivityTimeout = null;[39m
[31m+     this._connectAbort?.abort();[39m
[31m+     Promise.resolve(this._fuman.close()).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("error closing transport: %e", err);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setInactivityTimeout(timeout2) {[39m
[31m+     this.params.inactivityTimeout = timeout2;[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactivityTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._inactivityTimeout);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (timeout2) {[39m
[31m+       this._rescheduleInactivity();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async send(data) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactive) {[39m
[31m+       this.connect();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._writer) {[39m
[31m+       this._rescheduleInactivity();[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         await this._writer.write(data);[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (!(e instanceof ConnectionClosedError)) {[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("encountered an error while sending, reconnecting: %e", e);[39m
[31m+           this._writer = void 0;[39m
[31m+           this._fuman.reconnect(true);[39m
[31m+           this._sendOnceConnected.push(data);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this._sendOnceConnected.push(data);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+     super(`Transport error: ${code}`);[39m
[31m+     this.code = code;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/session-connection.js[39m

[31m+ var TEMP_AUTH_KEY_REFRESH_MARGIN = 3600;[39m
[31m+ var TEMP_AUTH_KEY_REFRESH_JITTER = 600;[39m
[31m+ var GET_STATE_INTERVAL = 1500;[39m
[31m+ var GET_STATE_TIMEOUT = 2500;[39m
[31m+ var GZIP_PACKED_ID = 812830625;[39m
[31m+ var MSG_CONTAINER_ID = 1945237724;[39m
[31m+ var RPC_RESULT_ID = 4082920705;[39m
[31m+ var RPC_ERROR_ID = 558156313;[39m
[31m+ var INVOKE_AFTER_MSG_ID = 3416209197;[39m

[31m+ var SessionConnection = class extends PersistentConnection2 {[39m

[31m+   // waitForMessage[39m
[31m+   _pendingWaitForUnencrypted = [];[39m

[31m+   _writerMap;[39m
[31m+   _crypto;[39m
[31m+   _salts;[39m

[31m+   onTmpKeyChange = new Emitter();[39m

[31m+   onAuthBegin = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onUpdate = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onFutureSalts = new Emitter();[39m

[31m+   constructor(params, log) {[39m
[31m+     super(params, log.create("conn"));[39m

[31m+       params.crypto,[39m
[31m+       log.create("session"),[39m
[31m+       params.readerMap,[39m
[31m+       params.writerMap,[39m
[31m+       params.salts[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.onTimeout(this._flush.bind(this));[39m
[31m+     this._pingInterval = params.pingInterval;[39m
[31m+     this._readerMap = params.readerMap;[39m
[31m+     this._writerMap = params.writerMap;[39m
[31m+     this._crypto = params.crypto;[39m
[31m+     this._salts = params.salts;[39m
