[31m+   _online;[39m
[31m+   _active = false;[39m
[31m+   getAuthKey(temp = false) {[39m
[31m+     const key = temp ? this._session._authKeyTemp : this._session._authKey;[39m
[31m+     if (!key.ready) return null;[39m
[31m+     return key.key;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setUsePfs(usePfs) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._usePfs === usePfs) return;[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("use pfs changed to %s", usePfs);[39m
[31m+     this._usePfs = usePfs;[39m
[31m+     if (!usePfs) {[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPending = false;[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPendingInBackground = false;[39m
[31m+       this._session._authKeyTemp.reset();[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._pfsUpdateTimeout);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._resetSession("use pfs changed");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   onClosed() {[39m
[31m+     Object.values(this._pendingWaitForUnencrypted).forEach(([prom, timeout2]) => {[39m
[31m+       prom.reject(new MtcuteError("Connection closed"));[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(timeout2);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     for (const msgId of this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.keys()) {[39m
[31m+       this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "connection loss", true);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (const rpc of this._session.getStateSchedule.raw) {[39m
[31m+       rpc.getState = 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.onDisconnect.emit();[39m
[31m+     this.reset();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async destroy() {[39m
[31m+     await super.destroy();[39m
[31m+     this.reset(true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   destroyAuthKey() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session._authKey.ready || this._needDestroyAuthKey) return;[39m
[31m+     this._needDestroyAuthKey = true;[39m
[31m+     this._sentDestroyAuthKey = false;[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.emitNow();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   reset(forever = false) {[39m
[31m+     this._session.initConnectionCalled = false;[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.reset();[39m
[31m+     this._salts.isFetching = false;[39m
[31m+     this._session.resetLastPing(true);[39m
[31m+     for (const timeout2 of this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.values()) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(timeout2);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.clear();[39m
[31m+     if (this._needDestroyAuthKey) this._sentDestroyAuthKey = false;[39m
[31m+     if (forever) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._pfsUpdateTimeout);[39m
[31m+       this.onDisconnect.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onKeyChange.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onTmpKeyChange.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onRequestAuth.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onAuthBegin.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onUpdate.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onFutureSalts.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onWait.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onUsable.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onError.clear();[39m
[31m+       this.onError.add((err) => {[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("caught error after destroying: %s", err);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       this._session.reset();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   onConnected() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session._authKey.ready) {[39m
[31m+       if (!this.params.isMainConnection) {[39m
[31m+         this.log.info("no auth key, waiting for main connection");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.log.info("no perm auth key, authorizing...");[39m
[31m+       this._authorize();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._usePfs && !this._session._authKeyTemp.ready) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.info("no temp auth key but using pfs, authorizing");[39m
[31m+       this._authorizePfs();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.info("auth keys are already available");[39m
[31m+     this.onConnectionUsable();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   handleError(error) {[39m
[31m+     if (error instanceof TransportError) {[39m
[31m+       if (error.code === 404) {[39m
[31m+         if (this._usePfs) {[39m
[31m+           if (!this._isPfsBindingPending && this._session._authKeyTemp.ready) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.debug("transport error 404, reauthorizing pfs");[39m
[31m+             this._session._authKeyTemp.reset();[39m
[31m+             this._authorizePfs();[39m
[31m+             this._onAllFailed("temp key expired, binding started");[39m
[31m+             return;[39m
[31m+           } else if (this._isPfsBindingPending) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.debug("transport error 404, pfs binding in progress");[39m
[31m+             this._onAllFailed("temp key expired, binding pending");[39m
[31m+             return;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (!this._triedReconnectingOn404) {[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("transport error 404. trying to reconnect");[39m
[31m+           this._triedReconnectingOn404 = true;[39m
[31m+           this._resetSession("-404 reconnect");[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("transport error 404, reauthorizing");[39m
[31m+         this.onError.emit(error);[39m
[31m+         this._session.resetAuthKey();[39m
[31m+         this._resetSession("-404 reconnect + reauth");[39m
[31m+         this.onKeyChange.emit(null);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.log.error("transport error %d", error.code);[39m
[31m+       this._onAllFailed(`transport error ${error.code}`);[39m
[31m+       if (error.code === 429) {[39m
[31m+         this._floodControl?.addMtprotoError();[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.onError.emit(error);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   onConnectionUsable() {[39m
[31m+     this._session.lastActivityTime = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     this._active = false;[39m
[31m+     if (this.params.withUpdates) {[39m
[31m+       this.sendRpc({ _: "updates.getState" }).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+         if (this._destroyed || RpcError.is(err, "AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED")) return;[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("failed to send updates.getState: %e", err);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.emitBeforeNext(1e3);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _authorize() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.authorizationPending) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.info("_authorize(): authorization already in progress");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!this.params.isMainConnection) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("_authorize(): non-main connection, requesting...");[39m
[31m+       this.onRequestAuth.emit();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._session.authorizationPending = true;[39m
[31m+     this.onAuthBegin.emit();[39m
[31m+     doAuthorization(this, this._crypto).then(([authKey, serverSalt, timeOffset]) => {[39m
[31m+       this._session._authKey.setup(authKey);[39m
[31m+       this._salts.currentSalt = serverSalt;[39m
[31m+       this._session.updateTimeOffset(timeOffset, true);[39m
[31m+       this._session.authorizationPending = false;[39m
[31m+       this.onKeyChange.emit(authKey);[39m
[31m+       if (this._usePfs) {[39m
[31m+         return this._authorizePfs();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.onConnectionUsable();[39m
[31m+     }).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+       this._session.authorizationPending = false;[39m
[31m+       if (this._destroyed) return;[39m
[31m+       this.log.error("Authorization error: %e", err);[39m
[31m+       this.handleError(err);[39m
[31m+       this.reconnect();[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _authorizePfs(background = false) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._isPfsBindingPending) return;[39m
[31m+     if (this._pfsUpdateTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._pfsUpdateTimeout);[39m
[31m+       this._pfsUpdateTimeout = void 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._isPfsBindingPendingInBackground) {[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPendingInBackground = false;[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPending = true;[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (background) {[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPendingInBackground = true;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this._isPfsBindingPending = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     doAuthorization(this, this._crypto, TEMP_AUTH_KEY_EXPIRY).then(async ([tempAuthKey, tempServerSalt]) => {[39m
[31m+       if (!this._usePfs) {[39m
[31m+         this.log.info("pfs has been disabled while generating temp key");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const tempKey = this._session._authKeyTempSecondary;[39m
[31m+       tempKey.setup(tempAuthKey);[39m
[31m+       const msgId = this._session.getMessageId();[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug([39m
[31m+         "binding temp_auth_key (%h) to perm_auth_key (%h), msg_id = %l...",[39m
[31m+         tempKey.id,[39m
[31m+         this._session._authKey.id,[39m
[31m+         msgId[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       const inner = {[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_bind_auth_key_inner",[39m
[31m+         nonce: randomLong(),[39m
[31m+         tempAuthKeyId: longFromBuffer(tempKey.id),[39m

[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         removeFromLongArray(this._session.queuedResendReq, msgId);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "bind":[39m
[31m+       case "cancel":[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       // do nothing, wait for the result[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         if (!inContainer) {[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("received unexpected ack for %s query %l", msg._, msgId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onAllFailed(reason) {[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("all messages failed because of %s", reason);[39m
[31m+     for (const msgId of this._session.pendingMessages.keys()) {[39m
[31m+       const info = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+       switch (info._) {[39m
[31m+         case "container":[39m
[31m+         case "state":[39m
[31m+         case "resend":[39m
[31m+         case "ping":[39m
[31m+           this.log.debug("forgetting about %s message %l", info._, msgId);[39m
[31m+           this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msgId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         default:[39m
[31m+           this._onMessageFailed(msgId, reason, true);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onMessageFailed(msgId, reason, inContainer = false) {[39m
[31m+     const msgInfo = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+     if (!msgInfo) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("unknown message %l failed because of %s", msgId, reason);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     switch (msgInfo._) {[39m
[31m+       case "container":[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("container %l (size = %d) failed because of %s", msgId, msgInfo.msgIds.length, reason);[39m
[31m+         msgInfo.msgIds.forEach((msgId2) => this._onMessageFailed(msgId2, reason, true));[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "ping":[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("ping (msg_id = %l) failed because of %s", msgId, reason);[39m
[31m+         this._session.resetLastPing(true);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "rpc": {[39m
[31m+         const rpc = msgInfo.rpc;[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("rpc query %l (%s) failed because of %s", msgId, rpc.method, reason);[39m
[31m+         this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msgId);[39m
[31m+         rpc.msgId = void 0;[39m
[31m+         this._enqueueRpc(rpc, true);[39m
[31m+         if (!inContainer && rpc.containerId && this._session.pendingMessages.has(rpc.containerId)) {[39m
[31m+           this._onMessageFailed(rpc.containerId, reason);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         removeFromLongArray(this._session.queuedStateReq, msgId);[39m
[31m+         removeFromLongArray(this._session.queuedResendReq, msgId);[39m
[31m+         this._session.getStateSchedule.remove(rpc);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "resend":[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug([39m
[31m+           "resend request %l (size = %d) failed because of %s",[39m
[31m+           msgId,[39m
[31m+           msgInfo.msgIds.length,[39m
[31m+           reason[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         this._session.queuedResendReq.unshift(...msgInfo.msgIds);[39m
[31m+         this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "state": {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug([39m
[31m+           "state request %l (size = %d) failed because of %s",[39m
[31m+           msgId,[39m
[31m+           msgInfo.msgIds.length,[39m
[31m+           reason[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         const timer = this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+         if (timer) {[39m
[31m+           timers_exports.clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+           this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.delete(msgId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         const stillPending = msgInfo.msgIds.filter((id) => this._session.pendingMessages.has(id));[39m
[31m+         if (stillPending.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           this._session.queuedStateReq.unshift(...stillPending);[39m
[31m+           this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "bind":[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("temp key binding request %l failed because of %s, retrying", msgId, reason);[39m
[31m+         msgInfo.promise.reject(new Error(reason));[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "future_salts":[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("future_salts request %l failed because of %s, will retry", msgId, reason);[39m
[31m+         this._salts.isFetching = false;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msgId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _registerOutgoingMsgId(msgId) {[39m
[31m+     this._session.recentOutgoingMsgIds.add(msgId);[39m
[31m+     return msgId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onPong({ msgId, pingId }) {[39m
[31m+     const info = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+     if (!info) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received pong to unknown ping (msg_id %l, ping_id %l)", msgId, pingId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (info._ !== "ping") {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received pong to %s query, not ping (msg_id %l, ping_id %l)", info._, msgId, pingId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (info.pingId.neq(pingId)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received pong to %l, but expected ping_id = %l (got %l)", msgId, info.pingId, pingId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const rtt = performance.now() - this._session.lastPingTime;[39m
[31m+     this._session.lastPingRtt = rtt;[39m
[31m+     if (info.containerId.neq(msgId)) {[39m
[31m+       this._onMessageAcked(info.containerId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("received pong: msg_id %l, ping_id %l, rtt = %dms", msgId, pingId, rtt);[39m
[31m+     this._session.resetLastPing();[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.emitBefore(this._session.lastPingTime + this._pingMustDelay());[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onBadServerSalt(msg) {[39m
[31m+     this._salts.currentSalt = msg.newServerSalt;[39m
[31m+     this._onMessageFailed(msg.badMsgId, "bad_server_salt");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onBadMsgNotification(msgId, msg) {[39m
[31m+     switch (msg.errorCode) {[39m
[31m+       case 17: {[39m
[31m+         const serverTime = msgId.high >>> 0;[39m
[31m+         const timeOffset = serverTime - Math.floor(performance.now() / 1e3);[39m
[31m+         this._session.updateTimeOffset(timeOffset, true);[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn([39m
[31m+           "msg_id too high, server time: %d, corrected offset to %d, resetting session",[39m
[31m+           serverTime,[39m
[31m+           timeOffset[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         this._resetSession("msg_id too high");[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case 16:[39m
[31m+       case 20: {[39m
[31m+         if (msg.errorCode !== 20) {[39m
[31m+           const serverTime = msgId.high >>> 0;[39m
[31m+           const timeOffset = serverTime - Math.floor(performance.now() / 1e3);[39m
[31m+           this._session.updateTimeOffset(timeOffset);[39m
[31m+           this.log.debug("server time: %d, corrected offset to %d", serverTime, timeOffset);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         this._onMessageFailed(msg.badMsgId, `bad_msg_notification ${msg.errorCode}`);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         this.log.error([39m
[31m+           "received bad_msg_notification for msg_id = %l, code = %d. session will be reset",[39m
[31m+           msg.badMsgId,[39m
[31m+           msg.errorCode[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         this._resetSession("bad_msg_notification");[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onNewSessionCreated({ firstMsgId, serverSalt, uniqueId }) {[39m
[31m+     if (uniqueId.eq(this._session.lastSessionCreatedUid)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("received new_session_created with the same uid = %l, ignoring", uniqueId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session.lastSessionCreatedUid.isZero() && !this.params.disableUpdates) {[39m
[31m+       this.onUpdate.emit({ _: "updatesTooLong" });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._salts.currentSalt = serverSalt;[39m
[31m+     this._triedReconnectingOn404 = false;[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("received new_session_created, uid = %l, first msg_id = %l", uniqueId, firstMsgId);[39m
[31m+     for (const msgId of this._session.pendingMessages.keys()) {[39m
[31m+       const val = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+       if (val._ === "bind") {[39m
[31m+         if (msgId.lt(firstMsgId)) {[39m
[31m+           this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "received in wrong session");[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         continue;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (val._ === "container") {[39m
[31m+         if (msgId.lt(firstMsgId)) {[39m
[31m+           this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msgId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         continue;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const containerId = val._ === "rpc" ? val.rpc.containerId || msgId : val.containerId;[39m
[31m+       if (containerId.lt(firstMsgId)) {[39m
[31m+         this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "new_session_created", true);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onMessageInfo(msgId, status, answerMsgId) {[39m
[31m+     if (!msgId.isZero()) {[39m
[31m+       const info = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+       if (!info) {[39m
[31m+         if (!this._session.recentOutgoingMsgIds.has(msgId)) {[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("received message info about unknown message %l", msgId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       switch (status & 7) {[39m
[31m+         case 1:[39m
[31m+         case 2:[39m
[31m+         case 3:[39m
[31m+           return this._onMessageFailed(msgId, `message info state ${status}`);[39m
[31m+         case 0:[39m
[31m+           if (!answerMsgId.isZero()) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.warn([39m
[31m+               "received message info with status = 0: msg_id = %l, status = %d, ans_id = %l",[39m
[31m+               msgId,[39m
[31m+               status,[39m
[31m+               answerMsgId[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+             return this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "message info state = 0 with unexpected ans_id");[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         // fallthrough[39m
[31m+         case 4:[39m
[31m+           this._onMessageAcked(msgId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!answerMsgId.isZero() && !this._session.recentIncomingMsgIds.has(answerMsgId)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("received message info for %l, but answer (%l) was not received yet", msgId, answerMsgId);[39m
[31m+       this._session.queuedResendReq.push(answerMsgId);[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (answerMsgId.isZero()) {[39m
[31m+       if (status & 64 && this._session.pendingMessages.has(msgId)) {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("received message info for %l: response is generated, but we have not received it yet! (status = %d)", msgId, status);[39m
[31m+         this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "response not received");[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("received message info for %l: message is still pending (status = %d)", msgId, status);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("received message info for %l, and answer (%l) was already received", msgId, answerMsgId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onMessagesInfo(msgIds, info) {[39m
[31m+     if (msgIds.length !== info.length) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("messages state info was invalid: msg_ids.length !== info.length");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < msgIds.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+       this._onMessageInfo(msgIds[i], info[i], long_default.ZERO);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onMsgsStateInfo(msg) {[39m
[31m+     const info = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     let timer;[39m
[31m+     if (timer = this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.get(msg.reqMsgId)) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.delete(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!info) {[39m
[31m+       const msgIdsFromRecents = this._session.recentStateRequests.get(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+       if (msgIdsFromRecents) {[39m
[31m+         this._session.recentStateRequests.delete(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+         this._onMessagesInfo(msgIdsFromRecents, msg.info);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received msgs_state_info to unknown request %l", msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (info._ !== "state") {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received msgs_state_info to %s query %l", info._, msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("received msgs_state_info for %l", msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     this._onMessagesInfo(info.msgIds, msg.info);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onFutureSalts(msg) {[39m
[31m+     const info = this._session.pendingMessages.get(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     if (!info) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received future_salts to unknown request %l", msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (info._ !== "future_salts") {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("received future_salts to %s query %l", info._, msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._session.pendingMessages.delete(msg.reqMsgId);[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("received future_salts: %d salts", msg.salts.length);[39m
[31m+     this._salts.isFetching = false;[39m
[31m+     this._salts.setFutureSalts(msg.salts.slice());[39m
[31m+     this.onFutureSalts.emit(msg.salts);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _enqueueRpc(rpc, force) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.enqueueRpc(rpc, force)) {[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _resetSession(reason = "session reset") {[39m
[31m+     this._queuedDestroySession.push(this._session._sessionId);[39m
[31m+     this._session.resetState(true);[39m
[31m+     this._onAllFailed(reason);[39m
[31m+     this.reconnect();[39m
[31m+     this._flushTimer.reset();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _sendAck(msgId) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedAcks.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitBeforeNext(3e4);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._session.queuedAcks.push(msgId);[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedAcks.length >= 100) {[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   sendRpc(request, timeout2, abortSignal, chainId) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._destroyed) {[39m
[31m+       return Promise.reject(new MtcuteError("Connection destroyed"));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._usable && this.params.inactivityTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       this._rescheduleInactivity();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const method = request._;[39m
[31m+     let obj = request;[39m
[31m+     let initConn = false;[39m
[31m+     if (this.params.disableUpdates) {[39m
[31m+       obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "invokeWithoutUpdates",[39m
[31m+         query: obj[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session.initConnectionCalled) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("wrapping %s with initConnection, layer: %d", method, this.params.layer);[39m
[31m+       obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "invokeWithLayer",[39m
[31m+         layer: this.params.layer,[39m
[31m+         query: {[39m
[31m+           ...this.params.initConnection,[39m
[31m+           proxy: this._mtproxyInfo,[39m
[31m+           query: obj[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       initConn = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.verbose(">>> %j", obj);[39m
[31m+     let content = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+     if (content.length > 1044404) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError(`Payload is too big (${content.length} > 1044404)`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let shouldGzip = content.length > 128;[39m
[31m+     if (content.length > 16384) {[39m
[31m+       const middle = ~~((content.length - 1024) / 2);[39m
[31m+       const middlePart = content.subarray(middle, middle + 1024);[39m
[31m+       const gzipped = this._crypto.gzip(middlePart, Math.floor(middlePart.length * 0.9));[39m
[31m+       if (!gzipped) shouldGzip = false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (shouldGzip) {[39m
[31m+       const gzipped = this._crypto.gzip(content, Math.floor(content.length * 0.9));[39m
[31m+       if (gzipped) {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("gzipped %s (%db -> %db)", method, content.length, gzipped.length);[39m
[31m+         content = gzipped;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         shouldGzip = false;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const pending = {[39m
[31m+       method,[39m
[31m+       promise: new Deferred(),[39m
[31m+       data: content,[39m
[31m+       // we will need to know size of gzip_packed overhead in _flush()[39m
[31m+       gzipOverhead: shouldGzip ? 4 + TlSerializationCounter.countBytesOverhead(content.length) : 0,[39m
[31m+       initConn,[39m
[31m+       chainId,[39m
[31m+       // setting them as well so jit can optimize stuff[39m
[31m+       invokeAfter: void 0,[39m
[31m+       sent: void 0,[39m
[31m+       done: void 0,[39m
[31m+       getState: void 0,[39m
[31m+       msgId: void 0,[39m
[31m+       seqNo: void 0,[39m
[31m+       containerId: void 0,[39m
[31m+       acked: void 0,[39m
[31m+       cancelled: void 0,[39m
[31m+       timeout: void 0,[39m
[31m+       resetAbortSignal: void 0[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     if (abortSignal?.aborted) {[39m
[31m+       pending.promise.reject(abortSignal.reason);[39m
[31m+       return pending.promise.promise;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (timeout2) {[39m
[31m+       pending.timeout = timers_exports.setTimeout(() => this._cancelRpc(pending, true), timeout2);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (abortSignal) {[39m
[31m+       const cancel = () => this._cancelRpc(pending, false, abortSignal);[39m
[31m+       abortSignal.addEventListener("abort", cancel);[39m
[31m+       pending.resetAbortSignal = () => abortSignal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._enqueueRpc(pending, true);[39m
[31m+     return pending.promise.promise;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   notifyNetworkChanged(online) {[39m
[31m+     this._online = online;[39m
[31m+     if (online) {[39m
[31m+       this._floodControl?.notifyNetworkUp();[39m
[31m+       if (this._inactive) return;[39m
[31m+       this.reconnect();[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this.disconnectManual().catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("error while disconnecting: %e", err);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _cancelRpc(rpc, onTimeout = false, abortSignal) {[39m
[31m+     if (rpc.done) return;[39m
[31m+     if (rpc.cancelled && !onTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtcuteError("RPC was already cancelled");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!onTimeout && rpc.timeout) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(rpc.timeout);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     rpc.resetAbortSignal?.();[39m
[31m+     if (onTimeout) {[39m
[31m+       rpc.promise.resolve({[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_rpc_error",[39m
[31m+         errorCode: 400,[39m
[31m+         errorMessage: "TIMEOUT"[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } else if (abortSignal) {[39m
[31m+       rpc.promise.reject(abortSignal.reason);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     rpc.cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+     if (rpc.msgId) {[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.delete(rpc.msgId);[39m
[31m+       this._session.queuedCancelReq.push(rpc.msgId);[39m
[31m+       this._session.getStateSchedule.remove(rpc);[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this._session.queuedRpc.removeBy((it) => it === rpc);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _onInactivityTimeout() {[39m
[31m+     let hasPendingRpc = false;[39m
[31m+     for (const it of this._session.pendingMessages.values()) {[39m
[31m+       if (it._ === "rpc") {[39m
[31m+         hasPendingRpc = true;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (hasPendingRpc) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("waiting for pending rpc queries to finish before closing connection");[39m
[31m+       this._rescheduleInactivity();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session.hasPendingMessages) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("no pending service messages, closing connection");[39m
[31m+       super._onInactivityTimeout();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._inactivityPendingFlush = true;[39m
[31m+     this._flush();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _handleGetStateTimeout = (msgId) => {[39m
[31m+     const pending = this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.get(msgId);[39m
[31m+     if (!pending) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("get_state timed out for unknown msg_id %l", msgId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._onMessageFailed(msgId, "timeout");[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   // https://github.com/tdlib/td/blob/master/td/mtproto/SessionConnection.h[39m
[31m+   _rtt() {[39m
[31m+     const rtt = this._session.lastPingRtt;[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isNaN(rtt)) return 2e3;[39m
[31m+     return Math.max(2e3, rtt * 1.5 + 1e3);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _readDisconnectDelay() {[39m
[31m+     return this._active ? this._rtt() * 3.5 : 135e3 + this._randomDelay;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _pingDisconnectDelay() {[39m
[31m+     return this._active && this.params.isMainConnection ? this._rtt() * 2.5 : 135e3 + this._randomDelay;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _pingMustDelay() {[39m
[31m+     return this._active ? this._rtt() : this._pingInterval + this._randomDelay;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _isActive() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedRpc.length > 0) return true;[39m
[31m+     for (const msg of this._session.pendingMessages.values()) {[39m
[31m+       if (msg._ === "rpc") return true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _checkTimeouts(now) {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._session.lastPingMsgId.isZero() && now - this._session.lastPingTime > this._pingDisconnectDelay()) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("ping timeout, no pong for %dms", Math.round(now - this._session.lastPingTime));[39m
[31m+       this._resetSession("ping timeout");[39m
[31m+       return true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (now - this._session.lastActivityTime > this._readDisconnectDelay()) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("read timeout, last read was %dms ago", Math.round(now - this._session.lastActivityTime));[39m
[31m+       this._resetSession("read timeout");[39m
[31m+       return true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _flush() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._disconnectedManually || !this._session._authKey.ready || this._isPfsBindingPending) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug([39m
[31m+         "skipping flush, connection is not usable (offline = %b, auth key ready = %b, pfs binding pending = %b)",[39m
[31m+         this._disconnectedManually,[39m
[31m+         this._session._authKey.ready,[39m
[31m+         this._isPfsBindingPending[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const now = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     const active = this._online && this._isActive();[39m
[31m+     if (active && !this._active) {[39m
[31m+       this._session.lastActivityTime = now;[39m
[31m+       this._session.resetLastPing(true);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._active = active;[39m
[31m+     if (this._checkTimeouts(now)) return;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       this._doFlush();[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.error("flush error: %s", e.stack);[39m
[31m+       this._resetSession("flush error");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.hasPendingMessages) {[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitWhenIdle();[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const nextPingTime = this._session.lastPingMsgId.isZero() ? this._session.lastPingTime + this._pingMustDelay() : Infinity;[39m
[31m+       const nextGetScheduleTime = this._session.getStateSchedule.raw[0]?.getState || Infinity;[39m
[31m+       const readDeadline = this._session.lastActivityTime + this._readDisconnectDelay();[39m
[31m+       const pingDeadline = this._session.lastPingMsgId.isZero() ? Infinity : this._session.lastPingTime + this._pingDisconnectDelay();[39m
[31m+       this._flushTimer.emitBefore(Math.min(nextPingTime, nextGetScheduleTime, readDeadline, pingDeadline));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _doFlush() {[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("flushing send queue. queued rpc: %d", this._session.queuedRpc.length);[39m
[31m+     let packetSize = 0;[39m
[31m+     let messageCount = 0;[39m
[31m+     let containerMessageCount = 0;[39m
[31m+     let containerSize = 0;[39m
[31m+     let ackRequest = null;[39m
[31m+     let ackMsgIds = null;[39m
[31m+     let getFutureSaltsRequest = null;[39m
[31m+     let getFutureSaltsMsgId = null;[39m
[31m+     let pingRequest = null;[39m
[31m+     let pingId = null;[39m
[31m+     let pingMsgId = null;[39m
[31m+     let getStateRequest = null;[39m
[31m+     let getStateMsgId = null;[39m
[31m+     let getStateMsgIds = null;[39m
[31m+     let resendRequest = null;[39m
[31m+     let resendMsgId = null;[39m
[31m+     let resendMsgIds = null;[39m
[31m+     let cancelRpcs = null;[39m
[31m+     let destroySessions = null;[39m
[31m+     let destroyAuthKey = false;[39m
[31m+     let rootMsgId = null;[39m
[31m+     const now = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedAcks.length) {[39m
[31m+       let acks = this._session.queuedAcks;[39m
[31m+       if (acks.length > 8192) {[39m
[31m+         this._session.queuedAcks = acks.slice(8192);[39m
[31m+         acks = acks.slice(0, 8192);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         this._session.queuedAcks = [];[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_msgs_ack",[39m
[31m+         msgIds: acks[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       ackMsgIds = obj.msgIds;[39m
[31m+       ackRequest = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+       packetSize += ackRequest.length + 16;[39m
[31m+       messageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.lastPingMsgId.isZero() && now - this._session.lastPingTime > this._pingMustDelay()) {[39m
[31m+       pingId = randomLong();[39m
[31m+       const obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_ping_delay_disconnect",[39m
[31m+         pingId,[39m
[31m+         disconnectDelay: Math.round(this._pingDisconnectDelay() / 1e3) + 2[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       this._session.lastPingTime = now;[39m
[31m+       pingRequest = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+       containerSize += pingRequest.length + 16;[39m
[31m+       containerMessageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       if (this._session.queuedStateReq.length) {[39m
[31m+         let ids = this._session.queuedStateReq;[39m
[31m+         if (ids.length > 8192) {[39m
[31m+           this._session.queuedStateReq = ids.slice(8192);[39m
[31m+           ids = ids.slice(0, 8192);[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           this._session.queuedStateReq = [];[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         getStateMsgIds = ids;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const idx = this._session.getStateSchedule.index({ getState: now }, true);[39m
[31m+       if (idx > 0) {[39m
[31m+         const toGetState = this._session.getStateSchedule.raw.splice(0, idx);[39m
[31m+         if (!getStateMsgIds) getStateMsgIds = [];[39m
[31m+         toGetState.forEach((it) => getStateMsgIds.push(it.msgId));[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (getStateMsgIds) {[39m
[31m+         const obj = {[39m
[31m+           _: "mt_msgs_state_req",[39m
[31m+           msgIds: getStateMsgIds[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         getStateRequest = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+         packetSize += getStateRequest.length + 16;[39m
[31m+         messageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedResendReq.length) {[39m
[31m+       resendMsgIds = this._session.queuedResendReq;[39m
[31m+       if (resendMsgIds.length > 8192) {[39m
[31m+         this._session.queuedResendReq = resendMsgIds.slice(8192);[39m
[31m+         resendMsgIds = resendMsgIds.slice(0, 8192);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         this._session.queuedResendReq = [];[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_msg_resend_req",[39m
[31m+         msgIds: resendMsgIds[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       resendRequest = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+       packetSize += resendRequest.length + 16;[39m
[31m+       messageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._session.queuedCancelReq.length) {[39m
[31m+       containerMessageCount += this._session.queuedCancelReq.length;[39m
[31m+       containerSize += this._session.queuedCancelReq.length * 28;[39m
[31m+       cancelRpcs = this._session.queuedCancelReq;[39m
[31m+       this._session.queuedCancelReq = [];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._queuedDestroySession.length) {[39m
[31m+       containerMessageCount += this._queuedDestroySession.length;[39m
[31m+       containerSize += this._queuedDestroySession.length * 28;[39m
[31m+       destroySessions = this._queuedDestroySession;[39m
[31m+       this._queuedDestroySession = [];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._needDestroyAuthKey && !this._sentDestroyAuthKey) {[39m
[31m+       destroyAuthKey = true;[39m
[31m+       containerMessageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       containerSize += 20;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._salts.shouldFetchSalts()) {[39m
[31m+       const obj = {[39m
[31m+         _: "mt_get_future_salts",[39m
[31m+         num: 64[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       getFutureSaltsRequest = TlBinaryWriter.serializeObject(this._writerMap, obj);[39m
[31m+       containerSize += getFutureSaltsRequest.length + 16;[39m
[31m+       containerMessageCount += 1;[39m
[31m+       this._salts.isFetching = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let forceContainer = false;[39m
[31m+     const rpcToSend = [];[39m
[31m+     while (this._session.queuedRpc.length && containerSize < 32768 && containerMessageCount < 1020) {[39m
[31m+       const msg = this._session.queuedRpc.popFront();[39m
[31m+       if (msg.cancelled) continue;[39m
[31m+       rpcToSend.push(msg);[39m
[31m+       containerSize += msg.data.length + 16;[39m
[31m+       if (msg.gzipOverhead) containerSize += msg.gzipOverhead;[39m
[31m+       if (msg.chainId) {[39m
[31m+         containerSize += INVOKE_AFTER_MSG_SIZE;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (msg.msgId) forceContainer = true;[39m
[31m+       if (msg.method === "upload.getFile") break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     packetSize += containerSize;[39m
[31m+     messageCount += containerMessageCount + rpcToSend.length;[39m
[31m+     if (!messageCount) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("flush did not happen: nothing to flush");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const useContainer = forceContainer || messageCount > 1;[39m
[31m+     if (useContainer) packetSize += 24;[39m
[31m+     const writer = TlBinaryWriter.alloc(this._writerMap, packetSize);[39m
[31m+     if (useContainer) {[39m
[31m+       writer.pos += 16;[39m
[31m+       writer.uint(MSG_CONTAINER_ID);[39m
[31m+       writer.uint(messageCount);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const otherPendings = [];[39m
[31m+     if (ackRequest) {[39m
[31m+       this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, ackRequest));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (pingRequest) {[39m
[31m+       pingMsgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, pingRequest));[39m
[31m+       this._session.lastPingMsgId = pingMsgId;[39m
[31m+       const pingPending = {[39m
[31m+         _: "ping",[39m
[31m+         pingId,[39m
[31m+         containerId: pingMsgId[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.set(pingMsgId, pingPending);[39m
[31m+       otherPendings.push(pingPending);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (getStateRequest) {[39m
[31m+       getStateMsgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, getStateRequest));[39m
[31m+       const getStatePending = {[39m
[31m+         _: "state",[39m
[31m+         msgIds: getStateMsgIds,[39m
[31m+         containerId: getStateMsgId[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.set(getStateMsgId, getStatePending);[39m
[31m+       this._session.recentStateRequests.set(getStateMsgId, getStatePending.msgIds);[39m
[31m+       otherPendings.push(getStatePending);[39m
[31m+       const timeout2 = timers_exports.setTimeout(this._handleGetStateTimeout, GET_STATE_TIMEOUT, getStateMsgId);[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingGetStateTimeouts.set(getStateMsgId, timeout2);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (resendRequest) {[39m
[31m+       resendMsgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, resendRequest));[39m
[31m+       const resendPending = {[39m
[31m+         _: "resend",[39m
[31m+         msgIds: resendMsgIds,[39m
[31m+         containerId: resendMsgId[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.set(resendMsgId, resendPending);[39m
[31m+       otherPendings.push(resendPending);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (cancelRpcs) {[39m
[31m+       cancelRpcs.forEach((msgId) => {[39m
[31m+         const cancelMsgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId([39m
[31m+           this._session.writeMessage(writer, {[39m
[31m+             _: "mt_rpc_drop_answer",[39m
[31m+             reqMsgId: msgId[39m
[31m+           })[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         const pending = {[39m
[31m+           _: "cancel",[39m
[31m+           msgId,[39m
[31m+           containerId: cancelMsgId[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         this._session.pendingMessages.set(cancelMsgId, pending);[39m
[31m+         otherPendings.push(pending);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (destroySessions) {[39m
[31m+       destroySessions.forEach((sessionId) => {[39m
[31m+         const msgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId([39m
[31m+           this._session.writeMessage(writer, {[39m
[31m+             _: "mt_destroy_session",[39m
[31m+             sessionId[39m
[31m+           })[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         const pending = {[39m
[31m+           _: "destroy_session",[39m
[31m+           sessionId,[39m
[31m+           containerId: msgId[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         this._session.pendingMessages.set(msgId, pending);[39m
[31m+         otherPendings.push(pending);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (destroyAuthKey) {[39m
[31m+       this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, { _: "mt_destroy_auth_key" }));[39m
[31m+       this._sentDestroyAuthKey = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (getFutureSaltsRequest) {[39m
[31m+       getFutureSaltsMsgId = this._registerOutgoingMsgId(this._session.writeMessage(writer, getFutureSaltsRequest));[39m
[31m+       const pending = {[39m
[31m+         _: "future_salts",[39m
[31m+         containerId: getFutureSaltsMsgId[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.set(getFutureSaltsMsgId, pending);[39m
[31m+       otherPendings.push(pending);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const getStateTime = now + GET_STATE_INTERVAL;[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < rpcToSend.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const msg = rpcToSend[i];[39m
[31m+       if (!msg.msgId) {[39m
[31m+         const msgId = this._session.getMessageId();[39m
[31m+         const seqNo = this._session.getSeqNo();[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("%s: msg_id assigned %l, seqno: %d", msg.method, msgId, seqNo);[39m
[31m+         msg.msgId = msgId;[39m
[31m+         msg.seqNo = seqNo;[39m
[31m+         this._session.pendingMessages.set(msgId, {[39m
[31m+           _: "rpc",[39m
[31m+           rpc: msg[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         if (msg.chainId) {[39m
[31m+           msg.invokeAfter = this._session.addToChain(msg.chainId, msgId);[39m
[31m+           this.log.debug("chain %s: invoke %l after %l", msg.chainId, msg.msgId, msg.invokeAfter);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("%s: msg_id already assigned, reusing %l, seqno: %d", msg.method, msg.msgId, msg.seqNo);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (msg.getState) {[39m
[31m+         this._session.getStateSchedule.remove(msg);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       msg.getState = getStateTime;[39m
[31m+       this._session.getStateSchedule.insert(msg);[39m
[31m+       if (rootMsgId === null) rootMsgId = msg.msgId;[39m
[31m+       writer.long(this._registerOutgoingMsgId(msg.msgId));[39m
[31m+       writer.uint(msg.seqNo);[39m
[31m+       const invokeAfterSize = msg.invokeAfter ? INVOKE_AFTER_MSG_SIZE : 0;[39m
[31m+       const writeInvokeAfter = () => {[39m
[31m+         if (!msg.invokeAfter) return;[39m
[31m+         writer.uint(INVOKE_AFTER_MSG_ID);[39m
[31m+         writer.long(msg.invokeAfter);[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       if (msg.gzipOverhead) {[39m
[31m+         writer.uint(msg.data.length + msg.gzipOverhead + invokeAfterSize);[39m
[31m+         writeInvokeAfter();[39m
[31m+         writer.uint(GZIP_PACKED_ID);[39m
[31m+         writer.bytes(msg.data);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         writer.uint(msg.data.length + invokeAfterSize);[39m
[31m+         writeInvokeAfter();[39m
[31m+         writer.raw(msg.data);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       msg.sent = true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (useContainer) {[39m
[31m+       packetSize = writer.pos;[39m
[31m+       const containerId = this._session.getMessageId();[39m
[31m+       const seqNo = this._session.getSeqNo(false);[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("container: msg_id assigned %l, seqno: %d", containerId, seqNo);[39m
[31m+       writer.pos = 0;[39m
[31m+       rootMsgId = containerId;[39m
[31m+       writer.long(this._registerOutgoingMsgId(containerId));[39m
[31m+       writer.uint(seqNo);[39m
[31m+       writer.uint(packetSize - 16);[39m
[31m+       writer.pos = packetSize;[39m
[31m+       const msgIds = [];[39m
[31m+       for (let i = 0; i < rpcToSend.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+         const msg = rpcToSend[i];[39m
[31m+         msg.containerId = containerId;[39m
[31m+         msgIds.push(msg.msgId);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (otherPendings.length) {[39m
[31m+         otherPendings.forEach((msg) => {[39m
[31m+           msgIds.push(msg.containerId);[39m
[31m+           msg.containerId = containerId;[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this._session.pendingMessages.set(containerId, {[39m
[31m+         _: "container",[39m
[31m+         msgIds[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const result = writer.result();[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug([39m
[31m+       "sending %d messages: size = %db, acks = %L, ping = %b (msg_id = %l), state_req = %L (msg_id = %l), resend = %L (msg_id = %l), cancels = %L (msg_id = %l), salts_req = %b (msg_id = %l), rpc = %s, container = %b, root msg_id = %l",[39m
[31m+       messageCount,[39m
[31m+       packetSize,[39m
[31m+       ackMsgIds,[39m
[31m+       pingRequest,[39m
[31m+       pingMsgId,[39m
[31m+       getStateMsgIds,[39m
[31m+       getStateMsgId,[39m
[31m+       resendMsgIds,[39m
[31m+       resendMsgId,[39m
[31m+       cancelRpcs,[39m
[31m+       cancelRpcs,[39m
[31m+       getFutureSaltsRequest,[39m
[31m+       getFutureSaltsMsgId,[39m
[31m+       rpcToSend.map((it) => it.method),[39m
[31m+       useContainer,[39m
[31m+       rootMsgId[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const enc = this._session.encryptMessage(result);[39m
[31m+     const promise = this.send(enc);[39m
[31m+     if (this._inactivityPendingFlush && !this._session.hasPendingMessages) {[39m
[31m+       void promise.then(() => {[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("pending messages sent, closing connection");[39m
[31m+         this._flushTimer.reset();[39m
[31m+         this._inactivityPendingFlush = false;[39m
[31m+         super._onInactivityTimeout();[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/multi-session-connection.js[39m
[31m+ var MultiSessionConnection = class _MultiSessionConnection {[39m
[31m+   constructor(params, _count, log, logPrefix = "") {[39m
[31m+     this.params = params;[39m
[31m+     this._count = _count;[39m
[31m+     this._log = log.create("multi");[39m
[31m+     if (logPrefix) this._log.prefix = `[${logPrefix}] `;[39m
[31m+     this._enforcePfs = _count > 1 && params.isMainConnection;[39m
[31m+     this._updateConnections();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   static _pickConnection(loads, ready) {[39m
[31m+     let min3 = Infinity;[39m
[31m+     let minIdx = 0;[39m
[31m+     let foundReady = false;[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < loads.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const isReady = ready[i];[39m
[31m+       if (foundReady && !isReady) continue;[39m
[31m+       if (isReady && !foundReady) {[39m
[31m+         foundReady = true;[39m
[31m+         min3 = Infinity;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (loads[i] < min3) {[39m
[31m+         min3 = loads[i];[39m
[31m+         minIdx = i;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return minIdx;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _log;[39m
[31m+   _enforcePfs = false;[39m
[31m+   // NB: dont forget to update .reset()[39m
[31m+   onRequestKeys = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onError = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onUpdate = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onKeyChange = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onTmpKeyChange = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onFutureSalts = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onAuthBegin = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onUsable = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onWait = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onRequestAuth = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   _connections = [];[39m
[31m+   setCount(count, connect = this.params.isMainConnection) {[39m
[31m+     this._count = count;[39m
[31m+     this._updateConnections(connect);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   getCount() {[39m
[31m+     return this._count;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _updateConnections(connect = false) {[39m
[31m+     if (this._connections.length === this._count) return;[39m
[31m+     this._log.debug("updating connections count: %d -> %d", this._connections.length, this._count);[39m
[31m+     const newEnforcePfs = this._count > 1 && this.params.isMainConnection;[39m
[31m+     const enforcePfsChanged = newEnforcePfs !== this._enforcePfs;[39m
[31m+     if (enforcePfsChanged) {[39m
[31m+       this._log.debug("enforcePfs changed: %s -> %s", this._enforcePfs, newEnforcePfs);[39m
[31m+       this._enforcePfs = newEnforcePfs;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._connections.length > this._count) {[39m
[31m+       for (let i = this._connections.length - 1; i >= this._count; i--) {[39m
[31m+         this._connections[i].destroy().catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+           this._log.warn("error destroying connection: %e", err);[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this._connections.splice(this._count);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (enforcePfsChanged) {[39m
[31m+       const promise = new Deferred();[39m
[31m+       this.onRequestKeys.emit(promise);[39m
[31m+       promise.promise.then(() => {[39m
[31m+         this._connections.forEach((conn) => {[39m
[31m+           conn.setUsePfs(this.params.usePfs || this._enforcePfs);[39m
[31m+           if (connect) conn.connect();[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+         this.onError.emit(unknownToError(err));[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (let i = this._connections.length; i < this._count; i++) {[39m
[31m+       const conn = new SessionConnection([39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           ...this.params,[39m
[31m+           usePfs: this.params.usePfs || this._enforcePfs,[39m
[31m+           isMainConnection: this.params.isMainConnection && i === 0,[39m
[31m+           withUpdates: this.params.isMainConnection && this.params.isMainDcConnection && !this.params.disableUpdates[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         this._log[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       if (this.params.isMainConnection && this.params.isMainDcConnection) {[39m
[31m+         conn.onUpdate.add((update) => this.onUpdate.emit(update));[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       conn.onError.add((err) => this.onError.emit(err));[39m
[31m+       conn.onKeyChange.add((key) => {[39m
[31m+         this.onKeyChange.emit([i, key]);[39m
[31m+         for (const conn_ of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+           if (conn_ === conn) continue;[39m
[31m+           conn_.onConnected();[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       conn.onTmpKeyChange.add([39m
[31m+         (event) => this.onTmpKeyChange.emit(event === null ? [i, null, 0] : [i, event[0], event[1]])[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       conn.onFutureSalts.add((salts) => this.onFutureSalts.emit(salts));[39m
[31m+       conn.onAuthBegin.add(() => {[39m
[31m+         this._log.debug("received auth-begin from connection %d", i);[39m
[31m+         this.onAuthBegin.emit(i);[39m
[31m+         this._connections.forEach((conn_) => {[39m
[31m+           conn_._session._authKeyTemp.reset();[39m
[31m+           if (conn_ !== conn) conn_.reconnect();[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       conn.onUsable.add(() => this.onUsable.emit(i));[39m
[31m+       conn.onWait.add(() => this.onWait.emit(i));[39m
[31m+       conn.onRequestAuth.add(() => this.onRequestAuth.emit(i));[39m
[31m+       this._connections.push(conn);[39m
[31m+       if (this._authKey !== null) conn._session._authKey.setup(this._authKey);[39m
[31m+       if (connect && !enforcePfsChanged) conn.connect();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _destroyed = false;[39m
[31m+   async destroy() {[39m
[31m+     await Promise.all(this._connections.map((conn) => conn.destroy()));[39m
[31m+     this.onRequestKeys.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onError.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onUpdate.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onKeyChange.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onTmpKeyChange.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onFutureSalts.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onAuthBegin.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onUsable.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onWait.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.onRequestAuth.clear();[39m
[31m+     this._destroyed = true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   sendRpc(request, timeout2, abortSignal, chainId) {[39m
[31m+     const loads = this._connections.map((c) => c._session.queuedRpc.length + c._session.pendingMessages.size);[39m
[31m+     const ready = this._connections.map((c) => c.isConnected);[39m
[31m+     return this._connections[_MultiSessionConnection._pickConnection(loads, ready)].sendRpc([39m
[31m+       request,[39m
[31m+       timeout2,[39m
[31m+       abortSignal,[39m
[31m+       chainId[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   connect() {[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       conn.connect();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   ensureConnected() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._connections[0].isConnected) return;[39m
[31m+     this.connect();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   get isConnected() {[39m
[31m+     return this._connections.some((conn) => conn.isConnected);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   destroyAuthKey() {[39m
[31m+     const conn = this._connections.find((c) => c.isConnected) ?? this._connections[0];[39m
[31m+     conn?.destroyAuthKey();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _authKey = null;[39m
[31m+   setAuthKey(authKey) {[39m
[31m+     this._authKey = authKey;[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       conn._session._authKey.setup(authKey);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setTempAuthKey(authKey, idx) {[39m
[31m+     this._connections[idx]?._session._authKeyTemp.setup(authKey);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   resetAuthKeys() {[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       conn._session.reset(true);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.notifyKeyChange();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setInactivityTimeout(timeout2) {[39m
[31m+     this._log.debug("setting inactivity timeout to %s", timeout2);[39m
[31m+     this.params.inactivityTimeout = timeout2;[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       conn.setInactivityTimeout(timeout2);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   notifyKeyChange() {[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       const session2 = conn._session;[39m
[31m+       if (this.params.usePfs && !session2._authKeyTemp.ready) {[39m
[31m+         this._log.debug("temp auth key needed but not ready, ignoring key change");[39m
[31m+         continue;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (session2.queuedRpc.length) {[39m
[31m+         this._log.debug("notifying key change on the connection due to queued rpc");[39m
[31m+         this._connections.forEach((conn2) => conn2.onConnected());[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   notifyNetworkChanged(connected) {[39m
[31m+     for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+       conn.notifyNetworkChanged(connected);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   requestAuth() {[39m
[31m+     this._connections[0]._authorize();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   resetSessions() {[39m
[31m+     if (this.params.isMainConnection) {[39m
[31m+       for (const conn of this._connections) {[39m
[31m+         conn._resetSession();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       this._connections[0]._resetSession();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async changeTransport(factory) {[39m
[31m+     await Promise.all(this._connections.map((conn) => conn.changeTransport(factory)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   getPoolSize() {[39m
[31m+     return this._connections.length;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/server-salt.js[39m
[31m+ var ServerSaltManager = class {[39m
[31m+   _futureSalts = [];[39m
[31m+   currentSalt = long_default.ZERO;[39m
[31m+   isFetching = false;[39m
[31m+   _getServerTime = () => Date.now() / 1e3;[39m
[31m+   setTimeSource(fn) {[39m
[31m+     this._getServerTime = fn;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   shouldFetchSalts() {[39m
[31m+     return !this.isFetching && !this.currentSalt.isZero() && this._futureSalts.length < 2;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   setFutureSalts(salts) {[39m
[31m+     this._futureSalts = salts;[39m
[31m+     const now = this._getServerTime();[39m
[31m+     while (salts.length > 0 && salts[0].validSince <= now) {[39m
[31m+       this.currentSalt = salts[0].salt;[39m
[31m+       this._futureSalts.shift();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._futureSalts.length) {[39m
[31m+       this._scheduleReplace(this._futureSalts[0]);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _timer;[39m
[31m+   _scheduleReplace(salt) {[39m
[31m+     this._timer = timers_exports.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+       this.currentSalt = salt.salt;[39m
[31m+       this._replaceAndScheduleNext();[39m
[31m+     }, (salt.validSince - this._getServerTime()) * 1e3);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _replaceAndScheduleNext() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._timer) timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._timer);[39m
[31m+     const now = this._getServerTime();[39m
[31m+     while (this._futureSalts.length !== 0) {[39m
[31m+       const salt = this._futureSalts[0];[39m
[31m+       if (salt.validSince > now) break;[39m
[31m+       this.currentSalt = salt.salt;[39m
[31m+       this._futureSalts.shift();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this._futureSalts.length) {[39m
[31m+       this._scheduleReplace(this._futureSalts[0]);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   destroy() {[39m
[31m+     timers_exports.clearTimeout(this._timer);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/network/network-manager.js[39m
[31m+ var defaultConnectionCountDelegate = (kind, dcId, isPremium) => {[39m
[31m+   switch (kind) {[39m
[31m+     case "main":[39m
[31m+       return 0;[39m
[31m+     case "upload":[39m
[31m+       return isPremium || dcId !== 2 && dcId !== 4 ? 8 : 4;[39m
[31m+     case "download":[39m
[31m+       return isPremium ? 8 : 2;[39m
[31m+     case "downloadSmall":[39m
[31m+       return 2;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ var DcConnectionManager = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(manager, dcId, _dcs, isPrimary = false) {[39m
[31m+     this.manager = manager;[39m
[31m+     this.dcId = dcId;[39m
[31m+     this._dcs = _dcs;[39m
[31m+     this.isPrimary = isPrimary;[39m
[31m+     this._log = this.manager._log.create("dc-manager");[39m
[31m+     this._log.prefix = `[DC ${dcId}] `;[39m
[31m+     const managerParams = this.manager.params;[39m
[31m+     const baseConnectionParams = () => ({[39m
[31m+       crypto: managerParams.crypto,[39m
[31m+       initConnection: this.manager._initConnectionParams,[39m
[31m+       transport: this.manager._transport,[39m
[31m+       dc: this._dcs.media,[39m
[31m+       testMode: managerParams.testMode,[39m
[31m+       reconnectionStrategy: this.manager._reconnectionStrategy,[39m
[31m+       layer: managerParams.layer,[39m
[31m+       disableUpdates: managerParams.disableUpdates,[39m
[31m+       readerMap: managerParams.readerMap,[39m
[31m+       writerMap: managerParams.writerMap,[39m
[31m+       usePfs: managerParams.usePfs,[39m
[31m+       isMainConnection: false,[39m
[31m+       isMainDcConnection: this.isPrimary,[39m
[31m+       inactivityTimeout: managerParams.inactivityTimeout ?? 6e4,[39m
[31m+       // NB: we need a separate salts manager for each pfs connection, because server salts are auth_key-bound[39m
[31m+       salts: managerParams.usePfs ? new ServerSaltManager() : this._salts,[39m
[31m+       platform: managerParams.platform,[39m
[31m+       pingInterval: managerParams.pingInterval ?? 6e4,[39m
[31m+       floodControl: managerParams.floodControl === false ? void 0 : managerParams.floodControl ?? {}[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     const mainParams = baseConnectionParams();[39m
[31m+     mainParams.isMainConnection = true;[39m
[31m+     mainParams.dc = _dcs.main;[39m
[31m+     if (isPrimary) {[39m
[31m+       mainParams.inactivityTimeout = void 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let mainCount;[39m
[31m+     if (this.isPrimary) {[39m
[31m+       mainCount = this._mainCountOverride;[39m
[31m+       if (mainCount === 0) {[39m
[31m+         mainCount = this.manager.config.getCached()?.tmpSessions ?? 1;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       mainCount = 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.main = new MultiSessionConnection(mainParams, mainCount, this._log, "MAIN");[39m
[31m+     this.upload = new MultiSessionConnection([39m
[31m+       baseConnectionParams(),[39m
[31m+       this.manager._connectionCount("upload", this.dcId, managerParams.isPremium),[39m
[31m+       this._log,[39m
[31m+       "UPLOAD"[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     this.download = new MultiSessionConnection([39m
[31m+       baseConnectionParams(),[39m
[31m+       this.manager._connectionCount("download", this.dcId, managerParams.isPremium),[39m
[31m+       this._log,[39m
[31m+       "DOWNLOAD"[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     this.downloadSmall = new MultiSessionConnection([39m
[31m+       baseConnectionParams(),[39m
[31m+       this.manager._connectionCount("downloadSmall", this.dcId, managerParams.isPremium),[39m
[31m+       this._log,[39m
[31m+       "DOWNLOAD_SMALL"[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     this._setupMulti("main");[39m
[31m+     this._setupMulti("upload");[39m
[31m+     this._setupMulti("download");[39m
[31m+     this._setupMulti("downloadSmall");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _salts = new ServerSaltManager();[39m
[31m+   _log;[39m
[31m+   /** Main connection pool */[39m
[31m+   main;[39m
[31m+   /** Upload connection pool */[39m
[31m+   upload;[39m
[31m+   /** Download connection pool */[39m
[31m+   download;[39m
[31m+   /** Download connection pool (for small files) */[39m
[31m+   downloadSmall;[39m
[31m+   get _mainCountOverride() {[39m
[31m+     return this.manager.params.connectionCount?.("main", this.dcId, this.manager.params.isPremium) ?? 0;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _setupMulti(kind) {[39m
[31m+     const connection = this[kind];[39m
[31m+     connection.onKeyChange.add(([idx, key]) => {[39m
[31m+       if (kind !== "main" && key !== null) {[39m
[31m+         this.manager._log.warn("got key-change from non-main connection, ignoring");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.manager._log.debug("key change (empty=%b) for dc %d from connection %d", key === null, this.dcId, idx);[39m
[31m+       this.upload.setAuthKey(key);[39m
[31m+       this.download.setAuthKey(key);[39m
[31m+       this.downloadSmall.setAuthKey(key);[39m
[31m+       Promise.resolve(this.manager._storage.provider.authKeys.set(this.dcId, key)).then(() => {[39m
[31m+         this.upload.notifyKeyChange();[39m
[31m+         this.download.notifyKeyChange();[39m
[31m+         this.downloadSmall.notifyKeyChange();[39m
[31m+       }).catch((e) => {[39m
[31m+         this.manager._log.warn("failed to save auth key for dc %d: %e", this.dcId, e);[39m
[31m+         this.manager.params.emitError(e);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     connection.onTmpKeyChange.add(([idx, key, expires]) => {[39m
[31m+       if (kind !== "main") {[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.manager._log.debug("temp key change for dc %d from connection %d", this.dcId, idx);[39m
[31m+       Promise.resolve(this.manager._storage.provider.authKeys.setTemp(this.dcId, idx, key, expires * 1e3)).catch((e) => {[39m
[31m+         this.manager._log.warn("failed to save temp auth key %d for dc %d: %e", idx, this.dcId, e);[39m
[31m+         this.manager.params.emitError(e);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     connection.onFutureSalts.add((salts) => {[39m

[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           this._log.info("received %s, migrating to dc %d", err, newDc);[39m
[31m+           await this.changePrimaryDc(newDc);[39m
[31m+           manager = this._primaryDc;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         multi = manager[kind];[39m
[31m+         res = await multi.sendRpc(message2, params?.timeout, params?.abortSignal, params?.chainId);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else if (err === "AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED") {[39m
[31m+       this._log.debug("exported auth key error, trying re-exporting..");[39m
[31m+       await this._exportAuthTo(manager);[39m
[31m+       res = await multi.sendRpc(message2, params?.timeout, params?.abortSignal, params?.chainId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return res;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   async changeTransport(transport) {[39m
[31m+     for (const dc of this._dcConnections.values()) {[39m
[31m+       await dc.main.changeTransport(transport);[39m
[31m+       await dc.upload.changeTransport(transport);[39m
[31m+       await dc.download.changeTransport(transport);[39m
[31m+       await dc.downloadSmall.changeTransport(transport);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   getPoolSize(kind, dcId) {[39m
[31m+     const dc = dcId ? this._dcConnections.get(dcId) : this._primaryDc;[39m
[31m+     if (!dc) {[39m
[31m+       if (!this._primaryDc) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtcuteError("Not connected to any DC");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return this._connectionCount(kind, dcId ?? this._primaryDc.dcId, this.params.isPremium);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return dc[kind].getPoolSize();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   getPrimaryDcId() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._primaryDc) throw new MtcuteError("Not connected to any DC");[39m
[31m+     return this._primaryDc.dcId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async disconnect() {[39m
[31m+     this._teardownAbort.abort();[39m
[31m+     this._primaryDc = void 0;[39m
[31m+     for (const dc of this._dcConnections.values()) {[39m
[31m+       await dc.destroy();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._dcConnections.clear();[39m
[31m+     this._resetOnNetworkChange?.();[39m
[31m+     this._resetOnNetworkChange = void 0;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async destroy() {[39m
[31m+     this._destroyed = true;[39m
[31m+     await this.disconnect();[39m
[31m+     this.config.onUpdated.remove(this._onConfigChanged);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   getMtprotoMessageId() {[39m
[31m+     return this._primaryDc.main._connections[0]._session.getMessageId();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async recreateDc(dcId) {[39m
[31m+     this._log.debug("recreating dc %d", dcId);[39m
[31m+     const existing = this._dcConnections.get(dcId);[39m
[31m+     if (existing) {[39m
[31m+       await existing.destroy();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._dcConnections.delete(dcId);[39m
[31m+     if (dcId === this._primaryDc?.dcId) {[39m
[31m+       const oldPrimaryDc = this._primaryDc;[39m
[31m+       this._primaryDc = void 0;[39m
[31m+       this._primaryDcRecreationPromise = new Deferred();[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const newDefaultDcs = {[39m
[31m+           main: asNonNull(await this.config.findOption({[39m
[31m+             dcId,[39m
[31m+             allowIpv6: this.params.useIpv6[39m
[31m+           })),[39m
[31m+           media: asNonNull(await this.config.findOption({[39m
[31m+             dcId,[39m
[31m+             allowIpv6: this.params.useIpv6,[39m
[31m+             allowMedia: true,[39m
[31m+             preferMedia: true[39m
[31m+           }))[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         await this._storage.dcs.store(newDefaultDcs);[39m
[31m+         await this.connect(newDefaultDcs);[39m
[31m+         this._primaryDcRecreationPromise.resolve();[39m
[31m+         this._primaryDcRecreationPromise = void 0;[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         this._primaryDc = oldPrimaryDc;[39m
[31m+         this._primaryDcRecreationPromise?.resolve();[39m
[31m+         this._primaryDcRecreationPromise = void 0;[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/tl-json.js[39m
[31m+ function tlJsonToJson(obj) {[39m
[31m+   switch (obj._) {[39m
[31m+     case "jsonNull":[39m
[31m+       return null;[39m
[31m+     case "jsonBool":[39m
[31m+     case "jsonNumber":[39m
[31m+     case "jsonString":[39m
[31m+       return obj.value;[39m
[31m+     case "jsonArray":[39m
[31m+       return obj.value.map(tlJsonToJson);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const ret = {};[39m
[31m+   obj.value.forEach((item) => {[39m
[31m+     ret[item.key] = tlJsonToJson(item.value);[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   return ret;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/managers/timers.js[39m
[31m+ var TimersManager = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(_executeRpc) {[39m
[31m+     this._executeRpc = _executeRpc;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _timers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+   _errorHandler;[39m
[31m+   // These methods are async for API parity with worker-backed clients,[39m
[31m+   // where keepalive state is owned by the shared client/worker and accessed over RPC.[39m
[31m+   async exists(key) {[39m
[31m+     return this._timers.has(key);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async upsert(spec) {[39m
[31m+     this.upsertOwned("local", spec);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async cancel(key) {[39m
[31m+     this._cancel(key);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   upsertOwned(ownerId, spec) {[39m
[31m+     this._cancel(spec.key);[39m
[31m+     const timer = new AsyncInterval([39m
[31m+       (abortSignal) => this._executeRpc(spec, abortSignal),[39m
[31m+       spec.interval[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     if (this._errorHandler) {[39m
[31m+       timer.onError(this._errorHandler);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._timers.set(spec.key, {[39m
[31m+       ownerId,[39m
[31m+       timer[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (spec.startNow) timer.startNow();[39m
[31m+     else timer.start();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   clearOwner(ownerId) {[39m
[31m+     for (const [key, timer] of Array.from(this._timers.entries())) {[39m
[31m+       if (timer.ownerId !== ownerId) continue;[39m
[31m+       this._cancel(key);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   onError(handler) {[39m
[31m+     this._errorHandler = handler;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   destroy() {[39m
[31m+     for (const key of Array.from(this._timers.keys())) {[39m
[31m+       this._cancel(key);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _cancel(key) {[39m
[31m+     const timer = this._timers.get(key);[39m
[31m+     if (!timer) return;[39m
[31m+     timer.timer.stop();[39m
[31m+     this._timers.delete(key);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "inputPeerChannelFromMessage",[39m

[31m+ function toInputUser(res, input) {[39m
[31m+   if (isAnyInputUser(res)) return res;[39m
[31m+   switch (res._) {[39m

[31m+       return { _: "inputUserSelf" };[39m

[31m+   throw new MtInvalidPeerTypeError(input ?? res, "user");[39m

[31m+ function toInputChannel(res, input) {[39m
[31m+   if (isAnyInputChannel(res)) return res;[39m
[31m+   switch (res._) {[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerChannel":[39m

[31m+         accessHash: res.accessHash[39m

[31m+         msgId: res.msgId,[39m
[31m+         peer: res.peer[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtInvalidPeerTypeError(input ?? res, "channel");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function isInputPeerUser(obj) {[39m
[31m+   switch (obj._) {[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerUser":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerUserFromMessage":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerSelf":[39m
[31m+       return true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function isInputPeerChannel(obj) {[39m

[31m+ function inputPeerToPeer(inp) {[39m

[31m+ function extractUsernames(obj) {[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/storage/service/current-user.js[39m
[31m+ var KV_CURRENT_USER = "current_user";[39m
[31m+ function serialize(info) {[39m
[31m+   if (!info) return u8_exports.alloc(0);[39m
[31m+   const hasUsernames = info.usernames.length > 0;[39m
[31m+   let usernamesOverhead = hasUsernames ? 4 : 0;[39m
[31m+   for (const username of info.usernames) {[39m
[31m+     usernamesOverhead += TlSerializationCounter.countBytesOverhead(username.length) + username.length;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(16 + usernamesOverhead);[39m
[31m+   writer.int(1);[39m
[31m+   let flags = 0;[39m
[31m+   if (info.isBot) flags |= 1;[39m
[31m+   if (hasUsernames) flags |= 2;[39m
[31m+   if (info.isPremium) flags |= 4;[39m
[31m+   writer.int(flags);[39m
[31m+   writer.int53(info.userId);[39m
[31m+   if (hasUsernames) {[39m
[31m+     writer.int(info.usernames.length);[39m
[31m+     for (const username of info.usernames) {[39m
[31m+       writer.string(username);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return writer.result();[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function parse2(data) {[39m
[31m+   if (data.length === 0) return null;[39m
[31m+   const reader = TlBinaryReader.manual(data);[39m
[31m+   if (reader.int() !== 1) return null;[39m
[31m+   const flags = reader.int();[39m
[31m+   const userId = reader.int53();[39m
[31m+   let usernames = [];[39m
[31m+   if (flags & 2) {[39m
[31m+     const len = reader.int();[39m
[31m+     usernames = new Array(len);[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {[39m
[31m+       usernames[i] = reader.string();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     userId,[39m
[31m+     isBot: (flags & 1) !== 0,[39m
[31m+     isPremium: (flags & 4) !== 0,[39m
[31m+     usernames[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
