[31m+ var ZERO_CHANNEL_ID = -1e12;[39m
[31m+ var MIN_MARKED_CHAT_ID = -999999999999;[39m
[31m+ var MAX_USER_ID = 1099511627775;[39m
[31m+ function toggleChannelIdMark(id) {[39m
[31m+   return ZERO_CHANNEL_ID - id;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function getBarePeerId(peer) {[39m
[31m+   switch (peer._) {[39m
[31m+     case "peerUser":[39m
[31m+       return peer.userId;[39m
[31m+     case "peerChat":[39m
[31m+       return peer.chatId;[39m
[31m+     case "peerChannel":[39m
[31m+       return peer.channelId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function getMarkedPeerId(peer, peerType) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof peer === "number") {[39m
[31m+     switch (peerType) {[39m
[31m+       case "user":[39m
[31m+         return peer;[39m
[31m+       case "chat":[39m
[31m+         return -peer;[39m
[31m+       case "channel":[39m
[31m+         return ZERO_CHANNEL_ID - peer;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Invalid peer type");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   switch (peer._) {[39m
[31m+     case "mtcute.dummyInputPeerMinUser":[39m
[31m+     case "peerUser":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerUser":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerUserFromMessage":[39m
[31m+     case "inputUser":[39m
[31m+     case "inputUserFromMessage":[39m
[31m+       return peer.userId;[39m
[31m+     case "peerChat":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerChat":[39m
[31m+       return -peer.chatId;[39m
[31m+     case "mtcute.dummyInputPeerMinChannel":[39m
[31m+     case "peerChannel":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerChannel":[39m
[31m+     case "inputPeerChannelFromMessage":[39m
[31m+     case "inputChannel":[39m
[31m+     case "inputChannelFromMessage":[39m
[31m+       return ZERO_CHANNEL_ID - peer.channelId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtArgumentError(`Invalid peer: ${peer._}`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function parseMarkedPeerId(id) {[39m
[31m+   if (id < 0) {[39m
[31m+     if (MIN_MARKED_CHAT_ID <= id) {[39m
[31m+       return ["chat", -id];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (id !== ZERO_CHANNEL_ID) {[39m
[31m+       return ["channel", ZERO_CHANNEL_ID - id];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } else if (id > 0 && id <= MAX_USER_ID) {[39m
[31m+     return ["user", id];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtArgumentError(`Invalid marked peer id: ${id}`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function* getAllPeersFrom(obj) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof obj !== "object") return;[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(obj)) {[39m
[31m+     for (const it of obj) {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   switch (obj._) {[39m
[31m+     case "user":[39m
[31m+     case "chat":[39m
[31m+     case "channel":[39m
[31m+     case "chatForbidden":[39m
[31m+     case "channelForbidden":[39m
[31m+     case "community":[39m
[31m+     case "communityForbidden":[39m
[31m+       yield obj;[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("user" in obj && typeof obj.user === "object" && obj.user._ === "user") {[39m
[31m+     yield obj.user;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("chat" in obj && typeof obj.chat === "object") {[39m
[31m+     switch (obj.chat._) {[39m
[31m+       case "chat":[39m
[31m+       case "channel":[39m
[31m+       case "chatForbidden":[39m
[31m+       case "channelForbidden":[39m
[31m+       case "community":[39m
[31m+       case "communityForbidden":[39m
[31m+         yield obj.chat;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("channel" in obj && typeof obj.channel === "object") {[39m
[31m+     switch (obj.channel._) {[39m
[31m+       case "chat":[39m
[31m+       case "channel":[39m
[31m+       case "chatForbidden":[39m
[31m+       case "channelForbidden":[39m
[31m+       case "community":[39m
[31m+       case "communityForbidden":[39m
[31m+         yield obj.channel;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("users" in obj && Array.isArray(obj.users) && obj.users.length) {[39m
[31m+     for (const user of obj.users) {[39m
[31m+       if (typeof user === "object" && user._ === "user") {[39m
[31m+         yield user;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("chats" in obj && Array.isArray(obj.chats) && obj.chats.length) {[39m
[31m+     for (const chat of obj.chats) {[39m
[31m+       if (typeof chat === "object") {[39m
[31m+         switch (chat._) {[39m
[31m+           case "chat":[39m
[31m+           case "channel":[39m
[31m+           case "chatForbidden":[39m
[31m+           case "channelForbidden":[39m
[31m+           case "community":[39m
[31m+           case "communityForbidden":[39m
[31m+             yield chat;[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+     await this._setInt(KV_DATE, date);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async setSeq(seq) {[39m
[31m+     await this._setInt(KV_SEQ, seq);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async getChannelPts(channelId) {[39m
[31m+     const val = await this._kv.get(KV_CHANNEL_PREFIX + channelId);[39m
[31m+     if (!val) return null;[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async setChannelPts(channelId, pts) {[39m
[31m+     const buf = u8_exports.alloc(4);[39m
[31m+     typed_exports.toDataView(buf).setUint32(0, pts, true);[39m
[31m+     await this._kv.set(KV_CHANNEL_PREFIX + channelId, buf);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async setManyChannelPts(cpts) {[39m
[31m+     const promises = [];[39m
[31m+     for (const [channelId, pts] of cpts.entries()) {[39m
[31m+       promises.push(this.setChannelPts(channelId, pts));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     await Promise.all(promises);[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/query-batcher.js[39m
[31m+ function batchedQuery(params) {[39m
[31m+   const { inputKey, outputKey, fetch: fetch2, maxBatchSize = Infinity, maxConcurrent = 1, retrySingleOnError } = params;[39m
[31m+   const symbol = /* @__PURE__ */ Symbol("batchedQueryState");[39m
[31m+   function getState(client_) {[39m
[31m+     const client2 = client_;[39m
[31m+     if (!client2[symbol]) {[39m
[31m+       client2[symbol] = {[39m
[31m+         waiters: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),[39m
[31m+         fetchingKeys: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(),[39m
[31m+         retryQueue: new Deque(),[39m
[31m+         numRunning: 0[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return client2[symbol];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   function addWaiter(client2, waiters, item) {[39m
[31m+     const key = inputKey(item, client2);[39m
[31m+     let arr = waiters.get(key);[39m
[31m+     if (!arr) {[39m
[31m+       arr = [];[39m
[31m+       waiters.set(key, arr);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {[39m
[31m+       arr.push([item, resolve, reject]);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   function popWaiters(waiters, key) {[39m
[31m+     const arr = waiters.get(key);[39m
[31m+     if (!arr) return [];[39m
[31m+     waiters.delete(key);[39m
[31m+     return arr;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   function startLoops(client2, state) {[39m
[31m+     for (let i = state.numRunning; i <= maxConcurrent; i++) {[39m
[31m+       processPending(client2, state);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   function processPending(client2, state) {[39m
[31m+     const { waiters, fetchingKeys, retryQueue } = state;[39m
[31m+     if (state.numRunning >= maxConcurrent) return;[39m
[31m+     const request = [];[39m
[31m+     const requestKeys = [];[39m
[31m+     let isRetryRequest = false;[39m
[31m+     if (retryQueue.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       isRetryRequest = true;[39m
[31m+       const it = retryQueue.popFront();[39m
[31m+       request.push(it);[39m
[31m+       const key = inputKey(it, client2);[39m
[31m+       requestKeys.push(key);[39m
[31m+       fetchingKeys.add(key);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       for (const it of waiters.keys()) {[39m
[31m+         if (fetchingKeys.has(it)) continue;[39m
[31m+         request.push(waiters.get(it)[0][0]);[39m
[31m+         requestKeys.push(it);[39m
[31m+         fetchingKeys.add(it);[39m
[31m+         if (request.length === maxBatchSize) break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (request.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     state.numRunning += 1;[39m
[31m+     fetch2(client2, request).then((res) => {[39m
[31m+       const receivedKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+       for (const it of res) {[39m
[31m+         const key = outputKey(it, client2);[39m
[31m+         receivedKeys.add(key);[39m
[31m+         for (const waiter of popWaiters(waiters, key)) {[39m
[31m+           waiter[1](it);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         fetchingKeys.delete(key);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       for (const key of requestKeys) {[39m
[31m+         if (!receivedKeys.has(key)) {[39m
[31m+           for (const waiter of popWaiters(waiters, key)) {[39m
[31m+             waiter[1](null);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           fetchingKeys.delete(key);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+       if (retrySingleOnError && !isRetryRequest) {[39m
[31m+         const retry = retrySingleOnError(request, err);[39m
[31m+         if (retry === true) {[39m
[31m+           for (const it of request) {[39m
[31m+             retryQueue.pushBack(it);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         } else if (Array.isArray(retry)) {[39m
[31m+           for (const req of retry) {[39m
[31m+             const requestKeysIdx = request.indexOf(req);[39m
[31m+             if (requestKeysIdx < 0) continue;[39m
[31m+             retryQueue.pushBack(req);[39m
[31m+             request.splice(requestKeysIdx, 1);[39m
[31m+             requestKeys.splice(requestKeysIdx, 1);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       for (const key of requestKeys) {[39m
[31m+         for (const waiter of popWaiters(waiters, key)) {[39m
[31m+           waiter[2](err);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         fetchingKeys.delete(key);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }).then(() => {[39m
[31m+       state.numRunning -= 1;[39m
[31m+       if (waiters.size > 0) processPending(client2, state);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return function(client2, item) {[39m
[31m+     const state = getState(client2);[39m
[31m+     const promise = addWaiter(client2, state.waiters, item);[39m
[31m+     startLoops(client2, state);[39m
[31m+     return promise;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+    * Start updates loop.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * You must first call {@link enableUpdatesProcessing} to use this method.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * It is recommended to use this method in callback to {@link start},[39m
[31m+    * or otherwise make sure the user is logged in.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * > **Note**: If you are using {@link UpdatesManagerParams.catchUp} option,[39m
[31m+    * > catching up will be done in background, you can't await it.[39m
[31m+    * > Instead, listen for the `updating` and `connected` connection state events.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async startLoop() {[39m
[31m+     if (this.updatesLoopActive) return;[39m
[31m+     if (!this.catchUpOnStart) {[39m
[31m+       await this._fetchUpdatesState();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.updatesLoopActive = true;[39m
[31m+     this.client.onServerUpdate.add(this.handleUpdate);[39m
[31m+     timers_exports.clearInterval(this.keepAliveInterval);[39m
[31m+     this.keepAliveInterval = timers_exports.setInterval(this._onKeepAlive, KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL);[39m
[31m+     this._loop().catch((err) => this.client.onError.emit(unknownToError(err)));[39m
[31m+     if (this.catchUpOnStart) {[39m
[31m+       this.catchUp();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * **ADVANCED**[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Manually stop updates loop.[39m
[31m+    * Usually done automatically when stopping the client with {@link close}[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   stopLoop() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.updatesLoopActive) return;[39m
[31m+     timers_exports.clearInterval(this.keepAliveInterval);[39m
[31m+     for (const timer of this.channelDiffTimeouts.values()) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.channelDiffTimeouts.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.updatesLoopActive = false;[39m
[31m+     this.client.onServerUpdate.remove(this.handleUpdate);[39m
[31m+     this.pendingUpdateContainers.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.pendingUnorderedUpdates.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.pendingPtsUpdates.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.pendingQtsUpdates.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.pendingPtsUpdatesPostponed.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.noDispatchMsg.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.noDispatchPts.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.noDispatchQts.clear();[39m
[31m+     this.postponedTimer.reset();[39m
[31m+     this.updatesLoopCv.notify();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Catch up with the server by loading missed updates.[39m
[31m+    *.[39m
[31m+    * > **Note**: In case the storage was not properly[39m
[31m+    * > closed the last time, "catching up" might[39m
[31m+    * > result in duplicate updates.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   catchUp() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.updatesLoopActive) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.warn("catch up requested, but updates loop is not active, ignoring");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("catch up requested");[39m
[31m+     this._onCatchingUp(true);[39m
[31m+     this.catchingUp = true;[39m
[31m+     this.handleUpdate(UPDATES_TOO_LONG);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   handleClientUpdate(update, noDispatch = true) {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.updatesLoopActive) return;[39m
[31m+     if (noDispatch && this.noDispatchEnabled) {[39m
[31m+       this._addToNoDispatchIndex(update);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.handleUpdate(update);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   handleUpdate(update) {[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug([39m
[31m+       "received %s, queueing for processing. containers queue size: %d",[39m
[31m+       update._,[39m
[31m+       this.pendingUpdateContainers.length[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     switch (update._) {[39m
[31m+       case "updatesTooLong":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortChatMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShort":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortSentMessage":[39m
[31m+         this.pendingUpdateContainers.insert({[39m
[31m+           upd: update,[39m
[31m+           seqStart: 0,[39m
[31m+           seqEnd: 0[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "updates":[39m
[31m+       case "updatesCombined":[39m
[31m+         this.pendingUpdateContainers.insert({[39m
[31m+           upd: update,[39m
[31m+           seqStart: update._ === "updatesCombined" ? update.seqStart : update.seq,[39m
[31m+           seqEnd: update.seq[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         assertNever();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (this.pendingUpdateContainers.length % WARN_EVERY === 0) {[39m
[31m+       if (this.updatesLoopActive) {[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("%d pending update containers, can't keep up!", this.pendingUpdateContainers.length);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         this.log.warn("%d pending update containers, but the updates loop is not active. did you forget to start it?", this.pendingUpdateContainers.length);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.updatesLoopCv.notify();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * **ADVANCED**[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Notify the updates manager that some channel was "opened".[39m
[31m+    * Channel difference for "opened" channels will be fetched on a regular basis.[39m
[31m+    * This is a low-level method, prefer using {@link openChat} instead.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Channel must be resolve-able with `resolvePeer` method (i.e. be in cache);[39m
[31m+    * base chat PTS must either be passed (e.g. from {@link Dialog}), or cached in storage.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param channelId  Bare ID of the channel[39m
[31m+    * @param pts  PTS of the channel, if known (e.g. from {@link Dialog})[39m
[31m+    * @returns `true` if the channel was opened for the first time, `false` if it is already opened[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   notifyChannelOpened(channelId, pts) {[39m
[31m+     if (this.channelsOpened.has(channelId)) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("channel %d opened again", channelId);[39m
[31m+       this.channelsOpened.set(channelId, this.channelsOpened.get(channelId) + 1);[39m
[31m+       return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.channelsOpened.set(channelId, 1);[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("channel %d opened (pts=%d)", channelId, pts);[39m
[31m+     this._fetchChannelDifferenceViaUpdate(channelId, pts);[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * **ADVANCED**[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Notify the updates manager that some channel was "closed".[39m
[31m+    * Basically the opposite of {@link notifyChannelOpened}.[39m
[31m+    * This is a low-level method, prefer using {@link closeChat} instead.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param channelId  Bare channel ID[39m
[31m+    * @returns `true` if the chat was closed for the last time, `false` otherwise[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   notifyChannelClosed(channelId) {[39m
[31m+     const opened = this.channelsOpened.get(channelId);[39m
[31m+     if (opened === void 0) {[39m
[31m+       return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (opened > 1) {[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug("channel %d closed, but is opened %d more times", channelId, opened - 1);[39m
[31m+       this.channelsOpened.set(channelId, opened - 1);[39m
[31m+       return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.channelsOpened.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+     this.log.debug("channel %d closed", channelId);[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /// /////////////////////////////////////////// IMPLEMENTATION //////////////////////////////////////////////[39m
[31m+   async _fetchUpdatesState() {[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2, lock, log } = this;[39m
[31m+     await lock.acquire();[39m
[31m+     log.debug("fetching initial state");[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       let fetchedState = await client2.call({ _: "updates.getState" });[39m
[31m+       log.debug([39m
[31m+         "updates.getState returned state: pts=%d, qts=%d, date=%d, seq=%d",[39m
[31m+         fetchedState.pts,[39m
[31m+         fetchedState.qts,[39m
[31m+         fetchedState.date,[39m
[31m+         fetchedState.seq[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       const diff = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+         _: "updates.getDifference",[39m
[31m+         pts: fetchedState.pts,[39m
[31m+         qts: fetchedState.qts,[39m
[31m+         date: fetchedState.date[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       switch (diff._) {[39m
[31m+         case "updates.differenceEmpty":[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "updates.differenceTooLong":[39m
[31m+           fetchedState.pts = diff.pts;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "updates.differenceSlice":[39m
[31m+           fetchedState = diff.intermediateState;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "updates.difference":[39m
[31m+           fetchedState = diff.state;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         default:[39m
[31m+           assertNever(diff);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.qts = fetchedState.qts;[39m
[31m+       this.pts = fetchedState.pts;[39m
[31m+       this.date = fetchedState.date;[39m
[31m+       this.seq = fetchedState.seq;[39m
[31m+       log.debug("loaded initial state: pts=%d, qts=%d, date=%d, seq=%d", this.pts, this.qts, this.date, this.seq);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (RpcError.is(e, "AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED")) {[39m
[31m+         lock.release();[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("received AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED, stopping updates loop");[39m
[31m+         this.stopLoop();[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (this.client.isConnected) {[39m
[31m+         log.error("failed to fetch updates state: %s", e);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       lock.release();[39m
[31m+       throw e;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     lock.release();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _loadUpdatesStorage() {[39m
[31m+     const storedState = await this.client.storage.updates.getState();[39m
[31m+     if (storedState) {[39m
[31m+       this.pts = this.oldPts = storedState[0];[39m
[31m+       this.qts = this.oldQts = storedState[1];[39m
[31m+       this.date = this.oldDate = storedState[2];[39m
[31m+       this.seq = this.oldSeq = storedState[3];[39m
[31m+       this.log.debug([39m
[31m+         "loaded stored state: pts=%d, qts=%d, date=%d, seq=%d",[39m
[31m+         storedState[0],[39m
[31m+         storedState[1],[39m
[31m+         storedState[2],[39m
[31m+         storedState[3][39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _saveUpdatesStorage(save = false) {[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2 } = this;[39m
[31m+     if (this.pts !== void 0) {[39m
[31m+       if (this.oldPts === void 0 || this.oldPts !== this.pts) {[39m
[31m+         await client2.storage.updates.setPts(this.pts);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (this.oldQts === void 0 || this.oldQts !== this.qts) {[39m
[31m+         await client2.storage.updates.setQts(this.qts);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (this.oldDate === void 0 || this.oldDate !== this.date) {[39m
[31m+         await client2.storage.updates.setDate(this.date);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (this.oldSeq === void 0 || this.oldSeq !== this.seq) {[39m
[31m+         await client2.storage.updates.setSeq(this.seq);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       this.oldPts = this.pts;[39m
[31m+       this.oldQts = this.qts;[39m
[31m+       this.oldDate = this.date;[39m
[31m+       this.oldSeq = this.seq;[39m
[31m+       await client2.storage.updates.setManyChannelPts(this.cptsMod);[39m
[31m+       this.cptsMod.clear();[39m
[31m+       if (save) {[39m
[31m+         await client2.mt.storage.save();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _addToNoDispatchIndex(updates) {[39m
[31m+     if (!updates) return;[39m
[31m+     const { noDispatchMsg, noDispatchPts, noDispatchQts } = this;[39m
[31m+     const addUpdate = (upd) => {[39m
[31m+       const channelId = extractChannelIdFromUpdate(upd) ?? 0;[39m
[31m+       const pts = "pts" in upd ? upd.pts : void 0;[39m
[31m+       if (pts) {[39m
[31m+         const set = noDispatchPts.get(channelId);[39m
[31m+         if (!set) noDispatchPts.set(channelId, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([pts]));[39m
[31m+         else set.add(pts);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const qts = "qts" in upd ? upd.qts : void 0;[39m
[31m+       if (qts) {[39m
[31m+         noDispatchQts.add(qts);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       switch (upd._) {[39m
[31m+         case "updateNewMessage":[39m
[31m+         case "updateNewChannelMessage":[39m
[31m+         case "updateBotNewBusinessMessage": {[39m
[31m+           const channelId2 = upd.message.peerId?._ === "peerChannel" ? upd.message.peerId.channelId : 0;[39m
[31m+           const set = noDispatchMsg.get(channelId2);[39m
[31m+           if (!set) noDispatchMsg.set(channelId2, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([upd.message.id]));[39m
[31m+           else set.add(upd.message.id);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     switch (updates._) {[39m
[31m+       case "updates":[39m
[31m+       case "updatesCombined":[39m
[31m+         updates.updates.forEach(addUpdate);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortChatMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateShortSentMessage": {[39m
[31m+         let set = noDispatchMsg.get(0);[39m
[31m+         if (!set) noDispatchMsg.set(0, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([updates.id]));[39m
[31m+         else set.add(updates.id);[39m
[31m+         set = noDispatchPts.get(0);[39m
[31m+         if (!set) noDispatchPts.set(0, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([updates.pts]));[39m
[31m+         else set.add(updates.pts);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "updateShort":[39m
[31m+         addUpdate(updates.update);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "updatesTooLong":[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         assertNever();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _fetchMissingPeers(upd, peers, fromDifference = false) {[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2, log } = this;[39m
[31m+     const missing = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+     async function fetchPeer(peer, allowZeroHash = false) {[39m
[31m+       if (!peer) return true;[39m
[31m+       const bare = typeof peer === "number" ? parseMarkedPeerId(peer)[1] : getBarePeerId(peer);[39m
[31m+       const marked = typeof peer === "number" ? peer : getMarkedPeerId(peer);[39m
[31m+       const index = marked > 0 ? peers.users : peers.chats;[39m
[31m+       const fromIndex = index.get(bare);[39m
[31m+       if (fromIndex && !fromIndex.min) return true;[39m
[31m+       if (missing.has(marked)) return false;[39m
[31m+       const cached = await client2.storage.peers.getCompleteById(marked);[39m
[31m+       if (!cached) {[39m
[31m+         if (fromDifference && allowZeroHash && parseMarkedPeerId(marked)[0] === "channel") {[39m
[31m+           log.debug("trying to fetch peer %d with zero access hash", marked);[39m
[31m+           const fetched = await _getChannelsBatched(client2, {[39m
[31m+             _: "inputChannel",[39m
[31m+             channelId: bare,[39m
[31m+             accessHash: long_default.ZERO[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+           if (fetched?._ === "channel" && !fetched.min) {[39m
[31m+             index.set(bare, fetched);[39m
[31m+             return true;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         missing.add(marked);[39m
[31m+         return fromDifference;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       index.set(bare, cached);[39m
[31m+       return true;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     switch (upd._) {[39m
[31m+       case "updateNewMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateNewChannelMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateEditMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateEditChannelMessage": {[39m
[31m+         const msg = upd.message;[39m
[31m+         if (msg._ === "messageEmpty") return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(msg.peerId, true)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(msg.fromId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (msg.replyTo) {[39m
[31m+           if (msg.replyTo._ === "messageReplyHeader" && !await fetchPeer(msg.replyTo.replyToPeerId)) {[39m
[31m+             return missing;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (msg.replyTo._ === "messageReplyStoryHeader" && !await fetchPeer(msg.replyTo.peer)) {[39m
[31m+             return missing;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (msg._ !== "messageService") {[39m
[31m+           if (msg.fwdFrom && (!await fetchPeer(msg.fwdFrom.fromId) || !await fetchPeer(msg.fwdFrom.savedFromPeer, true))) {[39m
[31m+             return missing;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (!await fetchPeer(msg.viaBotId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+           if (!await fetchPeer(msg.guestchatViaFrom)) return missing;[39m
[31m+           if (msg.entities) {[39m
[31m+             for (const ent of msg.entities) {[39m
[31m+               if (ent._ === "messageEntityMentionName") {[39m
[31m+                 if (!await fetchPeer(ent.userId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (msg.richMessage) {[39m
[31m+             const richMessagePeers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+             collectRichMessagePeerIds(msg.richMessage, richMessagePeers);[39m
[31m+             for (const peer of richMessagePeers) {[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(peer)) return missing;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (msg.media) {[39m
[31m+             switch (msg.media._) {[39m
[31m+               case "messageMediaContact":[39m
[31m+                 if (msg.media.userId && !await fetchPeer(msg.media.userId)) {[39m
[31m+                   return missing;[39m
[31m+                 }[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           switch (msg.action._) {[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChatCreate":[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChatAddUser":[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionInviteToGroupCall":[39m
[31m+               for (const user of msg.action.users) {[39m
[31m+                 if (!await fetchPeer(user)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChatJoinedByLink":[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(msg.action.inviterId)) {[39m
[31m+                 return missing;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChatDeleteUser":[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(msg.action.userId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChatMigrateTo":[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(toggleChannelIdMark(msg.action.channelId), true)) {[39m
[31m+                 return missing;[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionChannelMigrateFrom":[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(-msg.action.chatId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+             case "messageActionGeoProximityReached":[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(msg.action.fromId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(msg.action.toId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+               break;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "updateNewEphemeralMessage":[39m
[31m+       case "updateEditEphemeralMessage": {[39m
[31m+         const msg = upd.message;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(msg.peerId, true)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(msg.fromId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(msg.receiverId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case "updateEphemeralBotCallbackQuery":[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(upd.peer, true)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         if (!await fetchPeer(upd.userId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "updateDraftMessage":[39m
[31m+         if ("entities" in upd.draft && upd.draft.entities) {[39m
[31m+           for (const ent of upd.draft.entities) {[39m
[31m+             if (ent._ === "messageEntityMentionName") {[39m
[31m+               if (!await fetchPeer(ent.userId)) return missing;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if ("richMessage" in upd.draft && upd.draft.richMessage) {[39m
[31m+           const richMessagePeers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+           collectRichMessagePeerIds(upd.draft.richMessage, richMessagePeers);[39m
[31m+           for (const peer of richMessagePeers) {[39m
[31m+             if (!await fetchPeer(peer)) return missing;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return missing;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _storeMessageReferences(msg) {[39m
[31m+     if (msg._ === "messageEmpty") return;[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2 } = this;[39m
[31m+     const peerId = msg.peerId;[39m
[31m+     if (peerId._ !== "peerChannel") return;[39m
[31m+     const channelId = toggleChannelIdMark(peerId.channelId);[39m
[31m+     const promises = [];[39m
[31m+     function store(peer) {[39m
[31m+       if (!peer) return;[39m
[31m+       if (Array.isArray(peer)) {[39m
[31m+         peer.forEach(store);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const marked = typeof peer === "number" ? peer : getMarkedPeerId(peer);[39m
[31m+       promises.push(client2.storage.refMsgs.store(marked, channelId, msg.id));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     store(msg.fromId);[39m
[31m+     if (msg._ === "message") {[39m
[31m+       store(msg.viaBotId);[39m
[31m+       store(msg.guestchatViaFrom);[39m
[31m+       store(msg.fwdFrom?.fromId);[39m
[31m+       if (msg.richMessage) {[39m
[31m+         const richMessagePeers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+         collectRichMessagePeerIds(msg.richMessage, richMessagePeers);[39m
[31m+         store([...richMessagePeers]);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (msg.media) {[39m
[31m+         switch (msg.media._) {[39m
[31m+           case "messageMediaWebPage":[39m
[31m+             if (msg.media.webpage._ === "webPage" && msg.media.webpage.attributes) {[39m
[31m+               for (const attr of msg.media.webpage.attributes) {[39m
[31m+                 if (attr._ === "webPageAttributeStory") {[39m
[31m+                   store(attr.peer);[39m
[31m+                 }[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+           case "messageMediaContact":[39m
[31m+             store(msg.media.userId);[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+           case "messageMediaStory":[39m
[31m+             store(msg.media.peer);[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+           case "messageMediaGiveaway":[39m
[31m+             store(msg.media.channels.map(toggleChannelIdMark));[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       switch (msg.action._) {[39m
[31m+         case "messageActionChatCreate":[39m
[31m+         case "messageActionChatAddUser":[39m
[31m+         case "messageActionInviteToGroupCall":[39m
[31m+           store(msg.action.users);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "messageActionChatDeleteUser":[39m
[31m+           store(msg.action.userId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (msg.replyTo) {[39m
[31m+       switch (msg.replyTo._) {[39m
[31m+         case "messageReplyHeader":[39m
[31m+           store(msg.replyTo.replyToPeerId);[39m
[31m+           store(msg.replyTo.replyFrom?.fromId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "messageReplyStoryHeader":[39m
[31m+           store(msg.replyTo.peer);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     await Promise.all(promises);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _fetchChannelDifference(channelId, fallbackPts) {[39m
[31m+     const { channelDiffTimeouts, cpts, cptsMod, channelsOpened, client: client2, log, pendingUnorderedUpdates } = this;[39m
[31m+     if (channelDiffTimeouts.has(channelId)) {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.clearTimeout(channelDiffTimeouts.get(channelId));[39m
[31m+       channelDiffTimeouts.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let _pts = cpts.get(channelId);[39m
[31m+     if (!_pts && this.catchingUp) {[39m

[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     if (pts <= 0) {[39m
[31m+       pts = 1;[39m
[31m+       limit = 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+       const diff = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+         _: "updates.getChannelDifference",[39m
[31m+         force: true,[39m
[31m+         // Set to true to skip some possibly unneeded updates and reduce server-side load[39m
[31m+         channel,[39m
[31m+         pts,[39m

[31m+         filter: { _: "channelMessagesFilterEmpty" }[39m

[31m+       if (diff._ === "updates.channelDifferenceEmpty") {[39m
[31m+         log.debug("getChannelDifference (cid = %d) returned channelDifferenceEmpty", channelId);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const peers = PeersIndex.from(diff);[39m
[31m+       if (diff._ === "updates.channelDifferenceTooLong") {[39m
[31m+         if (diff.dialog._ === "dialog") {[39m
[31m+           pts = diff.dialog.pts;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (this.params.onChannelTooLong) {[39m
[31m+           this.params.onChannelTooLong(channelId, diff);[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           log.warn([39m
[31m+             "getChannelDifference (cid = %d) returned channelDifferenceTooLong. new pts: %d, recent msgs: %d",[39m
[31m+             channelId,[39m
[31m+             pts,[39m
[31m+             diff.messages.length[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           diff.messages.forEach((message2) => {[39m
[31m+             log.debug([39m
[31m+               "processing message %d (%s) from TooLong diff for channel %d",[39m
[31m+               message2.id,[39m
[31m+               message2._,[39m
[31m+               channelId[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+             if (message2._ === "messageEmpty") return;[39m
[31m+             pendingUnorderedUpdates.pushBack(toPendingUpdate(messageToUpdate(message2), peers, true));[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       log.debug([39m
[31m+         "getChannelDifference (cid = %d) returned %d messages, %d updates. new pts: %d, final: %b",[39m
[31m+         channelId,[39m
[31m+         diff.newMessages.length,[39m
[31m+         diff.otherUpdates.length,[39m
[31m+         diff.pts,[39m
[31m+         diff.final[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       diff.newMessages.forEach((message2) => {[39m
[31m+         log.debug("processing message %d (%s) from diff for channel %d", message2.id, message2._, channelId);[39m
[31m+         if (message2._ === "messageEmpty") return;[39m
[31m+         pendingUnorderedUpdates.pushBack(toPendingUpdate(messageToUpdate(message2), peers, true));[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       diff.otherUpdates.forEach((upd) => {[39m
[31m+         const parsed = toPendingUpdate(upd, peers, true);[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "processing %s from diff for channel %d, pts_before: %d, pts: %d",[39m
[31m+           upd._,[39m
[31m+           channelId,[39m
[31m+           parsed.ptsBefore,[39m
[31m+           parsed.pts[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         if (isMessageEmpty(upd)) return;[39m
[31m+         pendingUnorderedUpdates.pushBack(parsed);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       pts = diff.pts;[39m
[31m+       if (diff.final) break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     cpts.set(channelId, pts);[39m
[31m+     cptsMod.set(channelId, pts);[39m
[31m+     if (lastTimeout !== 0 && channelsOpened.has(channelId)) {[39m
[31m+       log.debug("scheduling next fetch for channel %d in %d seconds", channelId, lastTimeout);[39m
[31m+       channelDiffTimeouts.set([39m
[31m+         channelId,[39m
[31m+         timers_exports.setTimeout(() => this._fetchChannelDifferenceViaUpdate(channelId), lastTimeout * 1e3)[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _fetchChannelDifferenceLater(requestedDiff, channelId, fallbackPts) {[39m
[31m+     if (!requestedDiff.has(channelId)) {[39m
[31m+       requestedDiff.set([39m
[31m+         channelId,[39m
[31m+         this._fetchChannelDifference(channelId, fallbackPts).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("error fetching difference for %d: %e", channelId, err);[39m
[31m+           if (RpcError.is(err, "PERSISTENT_TIMESTAMP_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.warn("received PERSISTENT_TIMESTAMP_INVALID, resetting channel pts value");[39m
[31m+             this.cpts.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+             this.cptsMod.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (RpcError.is(err, "CHANNEL_PRIVATE") || RpcError.is(err, "CHANNEL_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.debug("channel %d is inaccessible, skipping gap fills until updateChannel", channelId);[39m
[31m+             this.inaccessibleChannels.add(channelId);[39m
[31m+             this.cpts.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+             this.cptsMod.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }).then((ok) => {[39m
[31m+           requestedDiff.delete(channelId);[39m
[31m+           if (!ok && !this.inaccessibleChannels.has(channelId)) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.debug("channel difference for %d failed, falling back to common diff", channelId);[39m
[31m+             this._fetchDifferenceLater(requestedDiff);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _fetchChannelDifferenceViaUpdate(channelId, pts) {[39m
[31m+     this.handleUpdate([39m
[31m+       createDummyUpdatesContainer([[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           _: "updateChannelTooLong",[39m
[31m+           channelId,[39m
[31m+           pts[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       ])[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _fetchDifference(requestedDiff) {[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2, log, pendingPtsUpdates, pendingUnorderedUpdates } = this;[39m
[31m+     const diff = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+       _: "updates.getDifference",[39m
[31m+       pts: this.pts,[39m
[31m+       date: this.date,[39m
[31m+       qts: this.qts[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     switch (diff._) {[39m
[31m+       case "updates.differenceEmpty":[39m
[31m+         log.debug("updates.getDifference returned updates.differenceEmpty");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       case "updates.differenceTooLong":[39m
[31m+         this.pts = diff.pts;[39m
[31m+         log.debug("updates.getDifference returned updates.differenceTooLong");[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const fetchedState = diff._ === "updates.difference" ? diff.state : diff.intermediateState;[39m
[31m+     log.debug([39m
[31m+       "updates.getDifference returned %d messages, %d updates. new pts: %d, qts: %d, seq: %d, final: %b",[39m
[31m+       diff.newMessages.length,[39m
[31m+       diff.otherUpdates.length,[39m
[31m+       fetchedState.pts,[39m
[31m+       fetchedState.qts,[39m
[31m+       fetchedState.seq,[39m
[31m+       diff._ === "updates.difference"[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const peers = PeersIndex.from(diff);[39m
[31m+     diff.newMessages.forEach((message2) => {[39m
[31m+       log.debug("processing message %d in %j (%s) from common diff", message2.id, message2.peerId, message2._);[39m
[31m+       if (message2._ === "messageEmpty") return;[39m
[31m+       if (this._recentlyDispatchedCommonMsgs.has(message2.id)) {[39m
[31m+         log.debug("skipping message %d from common diff because it was already dispatched", message2.id);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       pendingUnorderedUpdates.pushBack(toPendingUpdate(messageToUpdate(message2), peers, true));[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     diff.otherUpdates.forEach((upd) => {[39m
[31m+       if (upd._ === "updateChannelTooLong") {[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "received updateChannelTooLong for channel %d in common diff (pts = %d), fetching diff",[39m
[31m+           upd.channelId,[39m
[31m+           upd.pts[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         this._fetchChannelDifferenceLater(requestedDiff, upd.channelId, upd.pts);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (isMessageEmpty(upd)) return;[39m
[31m+       const parsed = toPendingUpdate(upd, peers, true);[39m
[31m+       if (parsed.channelId && parsed.ptsBefore) {[39m
[31m+         pendingPtsUpdates.insert(parsed);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         pendingUnorderedUpdates.pushBack(parsed);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       log.debug([39m
[31m+         "received %s from common diff, cid: %d, pts_before: %d, pts: %d, qts_before: %d",[39m
[31m+         upd._,[39m
[31m+         parsed.channelId,[39m
[31m+         parsed.ptsBefore,[39m
[31m+         parsed.pts,[39m
[31m+         parsed.qtsBefore[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     this.pts = fetchedState.pts;[39m
[31m+     this.qts = fetchedState.qts;[39m
[31m+     this.seq = fetchedState.seq;[39m
[31m+     this.date = fetchedState.date;[39m
[31m+     if (diff._ === "updates.difference") {[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.handleUpdate(UPDATES_TOO_LONG);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _fetchDifferenceLater(requestedDiff) {[39m
[31m+     if (!requestedDiff.has(0)) {[39m
[31m+       requestedDiff.set([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         this._fetchDifference(requestedDiff).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+           if (RpcError.is(err, "AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED")) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.debug("received AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED, stopping updates loop");[39m
[31m+             this.stopLoop();[39m
[31m+             return;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           this.log.warn("error fetching common difference: %e", err);[39m
[31m+           if (RpcError.is(err, "PERSISTENT_TIMESTAMP_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+             this.log.warn("received PERSISTENT_TIMESTAMP_INVALID, re-fetching updates state");[39m
[31m+             return this._fetchUpdatesState();[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }).then(() => {[39m
[31m+           requestedDiff.delete(0);[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _consumeNoDispatch(pending) {[39m
[31m+     if (!this.noDispatchEnabled) return false;[39m
[31m+     const upd = pending.update;[39m
[31m+     const channelId = pending.channelId ?? 0;[39m
[31m+     const msgId = upd._ === "updateNewMessage" || upd._ === "updateNewChannelMessage" || upd._ === "updateBotNewBusinessMessage" ? upd.message.id : void 0;[39m
[31m+     const foundByMsgId = msgId ? this.noDispatchMsg.get(channelId)?.delete(msgId) : false;[39m
[31m+     const foundByPts = this.noDispatchPts.get(channelId)?.delete(pending.pts);[39m
[31m+     const foundByQts = this.noDispatchQts.delete(pending.qts);[39m
[31m+     return Boolean(foundByMsgId || foundByPts || foundByQts);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _onUpdate(pending, requestedDiff, postponed = false, unordered = false) {[39m
[31m+     const { client: client2, log } = this;[39m
[31m+     const upd = pending.update;[39m
[31m+     let missing;[39m
[31m+     if (pending.peers.hasMin || pending.peers.empty) {[39m
[31m+       log.debug("loading missing peers for %s (pts = %d, cid = %d)", upd._, pending.pts, pending.channelId);[39m
[31m+       missing = await this._fetchMissingPeers(upd, pending.peers, pending.fromDifference);[39m
[31m+       if (!pending.fromDifference && missing.size) {[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "fetching difference because some peers were min (%J) and not cached for %s (pts = %d, cid = %d)",[39m
[31m+           missing,[39m
[31m+           upd._,[39m
[31m+           pending.pts,[39m
[31m+           pending.channelId[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         if (pending.channelId && !(upd._ === "updateNewChannelMessage" && upd.message._ === "messageService")) {[39m
[31m+           this._fetchChannelDifferenceLater(requestedDiff, pending.channelId, pending.ptsBefore);[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           this._fetchDifferenceLater(requestedDiff);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (missing.size) {[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "peers still missing after fetching difference: %J for %s (pts = %d, cid = %d)",[39m
[31m+           missing,[39m
[31m+           upd._,[39m
[31m+           pending.pts,[39m
[31m+           pending.channelId[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!unordered) {[39m
[31m+       if (pending.pts) {[39m
[31m+         const localPts = pending.channelId ? this.cpts.get(pending.channelId) : this.pts;[39m
[31m+         if (localPts && pending.ptsBefore !== localPts) {[39m
[31m+           log.warn([39m
[31m+             "pts_before does not match local_pts for %s (cid = %d, pts_before = %d, pts = %d, local_pts = %d)",[39m
[31m+             upd._,[39m
[31m+             pending.channelId,[39m
[31m+             pending.ptsBefore,[39m
[31m+             pending.pts,[39m
[31m+             localPts[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "applying new pts (cid = %d) because received %s: %d -> %d (before: %d, count: %d) (postponed = %s)",[39m
[31m+           pending.channelId,[39m
[31m+           upd._,[39m
[31m+           localPts,[39m
[31m+           pending.pts,[39m
[31m+           pending.ptsBefore,[39m
[31m+           pending.pts - pending.ptsBefore,[39m
[31m+           postponed[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         if (pending.channelId) {[39m
[31m+           this.cpts.set(pending.channelId, pending.pts);[39m
[31m+           this.cptsMod.set(pending.channelId, pending.pts);[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           this.pts = pending.pts;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (pending.qtsBefore) {[39m
[31m+         log.debug([39m
[31m+           "applying new qts because received %s: %d -> %d (postponed = %s)",[39m
[31m+           upd._,[39m
[31m+           this.qts,[39m
[31m+           pending.qtsBefore + 1,[39m
[31m+           postponed[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         this.qts = pending.qts;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const inNoDispatchIndex = this._consumeNoDispatch(pending);[39m
[31m+     if (isMessageEmpty(upd)) return;[39m
[31m+     switch (upd._) {[39m
[31m+       case "mtcute.dummyUpdate":[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       case "updateDcOptions": {[39m
[31m+         const config = client2.mt.network.config.getCached();[39m
[31m+         if (config) {[39m
[31m+           client2.mt.network.config.setData({[39m

[31m+               log.debug([39m
[31m+                 "postponing %s for 0.5s because small gap detected (by qts: exp %d, got %d, diff=%d)",[39m
[31m+                 upd._,[39m
[31m+                 this.qts,[39m
[31m+                 pending.qtsBefore,[39m
[31m+                 diff[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+               pending.timeout = performance.now() + 500;[39m
[31m+               pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.insert(pending);[39m
[31m+               postponedTimer.emitBefore(pending.timeout);[39m
[31m+             } else {[39m
[31m+               log.debug([39m
[31m+                 "fetching difference after %s because qts gap detected (by qts: exp %d, got %d, diff=%d)",[39m
[31m+                 upd._,[39m
[31m+                 this.qts,[39m
[31m+                 pending.qtsBefore,[39m
[31m+                 diff[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+               this._fetchDifferenceLater(requestedDiff);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             continue;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (isQtsDrop) {[39m
[31m+             log.debug("qts drop detected (%d -> %d)", this.qts, pending.qtsBefore);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           await this._onUpdate(pending, requestedDiff);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("processing postponed qts-ordered updates");[39m
[31m+         for (let i = 0; i < pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.raw.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+           const pending = pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.raw[i];[39m
[31m+           const upd = pending.update;[39m
[31m+           if (this.qts > pending.qtsBefore) {[39m
[31m+             log.debug([39m
[31m+               "ignoring postponed %s because already applied (by qts: exp %d, got %d)",[39m
[31m+               upd._,[39m
[31m+               this.qts,[39m
[31m+               pending.qtsBefore[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+             pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.removeIndex(i);[39m
[31m+             i--;[39m
[31m+             continue;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (this.qts < pending.qtsBefore) {[39m
[31m+             const now = performance.now();[39m
[31m+             if (now < pending.timeout) {[39m
[31m+               log.debug([39m
[31m+                 "postponed %s is still waiting (%dms left) (current qts %d, need %d)",[39m
[31m+                 upd._,[39m
[31m+                 pending.timeout - now,[39m
[31m+                 this.qts,[39m
[31m+                 pending.qtsBefore[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+               postponedTimer.emitBefore(pending.timeout);[39m
[31m+             } else {[39m
[31m+               log.debug([39m
[31m+                 "gap for postponed %s wasn't filled, fetching diff (current qts %d, need %d)",[39m
[31m+                 upd._,[39m
[31m+                 this.qts,[39m
[31m+                 pending.qtsBefore[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+               pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.removeIndex(i);[39m
[31m+               i--;[39m
[31m+               this._fetchDifferenceLater(requestedDiff);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             continue;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           await this._onUpdate(pending, requestedDiff, true);[39m
[31m+           pendingQtsUpdatesPostponed.removeIndex(i);[39m
[31m+           i--;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         this.hasTimedoutPostponed = false;[39m
[31m+         while (requestedDiff.size) {[39m
[31m+           log.debug([39m
[31m+             "waiting for %d pending diffs before processing unordered: %J",[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.size,[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.keys()[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           await Promise.all([...requestedDiff.values()]);[39m
[31m+           log.debug([39m
[31m+             "pending diffs awaited, new diffs requested: %d (%J)",[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.size,[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.keys()[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         this.log.debug("processing pending unordered updates");[39m
[31m+         while (pendingUnorderedUpdates.length) {[39m
[31m+           const pending = pendingUnorderedUpdates.popFront();[39m
[31m+           await this._onUpdate(pending, requestedDiff, false, true);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         while (requestedDiff.size) {[39m
[31m+           log.debug([39m
[31m+             "waiting for %d pending diffs after processing unordered: %J",[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.size,[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.keys()[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           await Promise.all([...requestedDiff.values()]);[39m
[31m+           log.debug([39m
[31m+             "pending diffs awaited, new diffs requested: %d (%j)",[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.size,[39m
[31m+             requestedDiff.keys()[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         await this._saveUpdatesStorage(true);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       log.debug("updates loop stopped");[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (this.client.destroyed) return;[39m
[31m+       log.error("updates loop encountered error, restarting: %s", e);[39m
[31m+       return this._loop();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/string-session.js[39m
[31m+ function writeStringSession(data) {[39m
[31m+   const writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(512);[39m
[31m+   const version = data.version;[39m
[31m+   if (version !== 3) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError(`Unsupported string session version: ${version}`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let flags = 0;[39m
[31m+   if (data.self) {[39m
[31m+     flags |= 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   writer.uint8View[0] = version;[39m
[31m+   writer.pos += 1;[39m
[31m+   if (data.primaryDcs.media !== data.primaryDcs.main) {[39m
[31m+     flags |= 4;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   writer.int(flags);[39m
[31m+   writer.bytes(serializeBasicDcOption(data.primaryDcs.main));[39m
[31m+   if (data.primaryDcs.media !== data.primaryDcs.main) {[39m
[31m+     writer.bytes(serializeBasicDcOption(data.primaryDcs.media));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (data.self) {[39m
[31m+     writer.int53(data.self.userId);[39m
[31m+     writer.boolean(data.self.isBot);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   writer.bytes(data.authKey);[39m
[31m+   return base64_exports.encode(writer.result(), true);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function readStringSession(data) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof data !== "string") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       version: 3,[39m
[31m+       primaryDcs: data.primaryDcs ?? (data.testMode ? defaultTestDc : defaultProductionDc),[39m
[31m+       self: data.self ?? null,[39m
[31m+       authKey: data.authKey[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const buf = base64_exports.decode(data, true);[39m
[31m+   const version = buf[0];[39m
[31m+   if (version !== 3) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error(`Invalid session string (version = ${version})`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const reader = TlBinaryReader.manual(buf, 1);[39m
[31m+   const flags = reader.int();[39m
[31m+   const hasSelf = flags & 1;[39m
[31m+   const testModeOld = Boolean(flags & 2);[39m
[31m+   const hasMedia = version >= 2 && Boolean(flags & 4);[39m
[31m+   const primaryDc = parseBasicDcOption(reader.bytes());[39m
[31m+   if (primaryDc === null) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Invalid session string (failed to parse primaryDc)");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const primaryMediaDc = hasMedia ? parseBasicDcOption(reader.bytes()) : primaryDc;[39m
[31m+   if (primaryMediaDc === null) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Invalid session string (failed to parse primaryMediaDc)");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (testModeOld) {[39m
[31m+     primaryDc.testMode = true;[39m
[31m+     primaryMediaDc.testMode = true;[39m
[31m+   } else if (primaryDc.testMode !== primaryMediaDc.testMode) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Primary DC and primary media DC must have the same test mode flag");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let self = null;[39m
[31m+   if (hasSelf) {[39m
[31m+     const selfId = reader.int53();[39m
[31m+     const selfBot = reader.boolean();[39m
[31m+     self = {[39m
[31m+       userId: selfId,[39m
[31m+       isBot: selfBot,[39m
[31m+       // todo: we should make sure we fetch this from the server at first start[39m
[31m+       isPremium: false,[39m
[31m+       usernames: [][39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const key = reader.bytes();[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     version,[39m
[31m+     primaryDcs: {[39m
[31m+       main: primaryDc,[39m
[31m+       media: primaryMediaDc[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     self,[39m
[31m+     authKey: key[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/crypto/password.js[39m
[31m+ async function computePasswordHash(crypto, password, salt1, salt2) {[39m
[31m+   const SH = (data, salt) => crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat3(salt, data, salt));[39m
[31m+   const PH1 = (pwd, salt12, salt22) => SH(SH(pwd, salt12), salt22);[39m
[31m+   return SH(await crypto.pbkdf2(PH1(password, salt1, salt2), salt1, 1e5), salt2);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function computeNewPasswordHash(crypto, algo, password) {[39m
[31m+   assertTypeIs("account.getPassword", algo, "passwordKdfAlgoSHA256SHA256PBKDF2HMACSHA512iter100000SHA256ModPow");[39m
[31m+   const salt1 = u8_exports.alloc(algo.salt1.length + 32);[39m
[31m+   salt1.set(algo.salt1);[39m
[31m+   crypto.randomFill(salt1.subarray(algo.salt1.length));[39m
[31m+   algo.salt1 = salt1;[39m
[31m+   const _x = await computePasswordHash(crypto, utf8_exports.encoder.encode(password), algo.salt1, algo.salt2);[39m
[31m+   const g = BigInt(algo.g);[39m
[31m+   const p = bundle_exports.fromBytes(algo.p);[39m
[31m+   const x = bundle_exports.fromBytes(_x);[39m
[31m+   return bundle_exports.toBytes(bundle_exports.modPowBinary(g, x, p), 256);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function computeSrpParams(crypto, request, password) {[39m
[31m+   if (!request.currentAlgo || request.currentAlgo._ !== "passwordKdfAlgoSHA256SHA256PBKDF2HMACSHA512iter100000SHA256ModPow") {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtUnsupportedError(`Unknown algo ${request.currentAlgo?._}`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const algo = request.currentAlgo;[39m
[31m+   if (!request.srpB) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("SRP_B is not present in the request");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!request.srpId) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtSecurityError("SRP_ID is not present in the request");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const g = BigInt(algo.g);[39m
[31m+   const _g = bundle_exports.toBytes(g, 256);[39m
[31m+   const p = bundle_exports.fromBytes(algo.p);[39m
[31m+   const gB = bundle_exports.fromBytes(request.srpB);[39m
[31m+   const a = bundle_exports.fromBytes(crypto.randomBytes(256));[39m
[31m+   const gA = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(g, a, p);[39m
[31m+   const _gA = bundle_exports.toBytes(gA, 256);[39m
[31m+   const H = (data) => crypto.sha256(data);[39m
[31m+   const _k = crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat2(algo.p, _g));[39m
[31m+   const _u = crypto.sha256(u8_exports.concat2(_gA, request.srpB));[39m
[31m+   const _x = await computePasswordHash(crypto, utf8_exports.encoder.encode(password), algo.salt1, algo.salt2);[39m
[31m+   const k = bundle_exports.fromBytes(_k);[39m
[31m+   const u = bundle_exports.fromBytes(_u);[39m
[31m+   const x = bundle_exports.fromBytes(_x);[39m
[31m+   const v = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(g, x, p);[39m
[31m+   const kV = k * v % p;[39m
[31m+   let t = gB - kV;[39m
[31m+   if (t < 0n) t += p;[39m
[31m+   const sA = bundle_exports.modPowBinary(t, a + u * x, p);[39m
[31m+   const _kA = H(bundle_exports.toBytes(sA, 256));[39m
[31m+   const _M1 = H(u8_exports.concat([[39m
[31m+     u8_exports.xor(H(algo.p), H(_g)),[39m
[31m+     H(algo.salt1),[39m
[31m+     H(algo.salt2),[39m
[31m+     _gA,[39m
[31m+     request.srpB,[39m
[31m+     _kA[39m
[31m+   ]));[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     _: "inputCheckPasswordSRP",[39m
[31m+     srpId: request.srpId,[39m
[31m+     A: _gA,[39m
[31m+     M1: _M1[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/base.js[39m
[31m+ function makeRpcError(raw, stack, method) {[39m
[31m+   const error = RpcError.fromTl(raw);[39m
[31m+   error.stack = `RpcError (${error.code} ${error.text}): ${error.message}[39m
[31m+     at ${method}[39m
[31m+ ${stack.split("\n").slice(2).join("\n")}`;[39m
[31m+   return error;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ var BaseTelegramClient = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(params) {[39m
[31m+     this.params = params;[39m
[31m+     this.log = this.params.logger ?? new LogManager("client", params.platform);[39m
[31m+     this.platform = this.params.platform;[39m
[31m+     this.mt = new MtClient({[39m
[31m+       ...dropUndefined(this.params),[39m
[31m+       logger: this.log.create("mtproto"),[39m
[31m+       onError: (err) => {[39m
[31m+         if (this.onError.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           this.onError.emit(unknownToError(err));[39m
[31m+         } else if (this._connect.finished()) {[39m
[31m+           this.log.error("unhandled error:", err);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (!params.disableUpdates && params.updates !== false) {[39m
[31m+       this.updates = new UpdatesManager(this, params.updates);[39m
[31m+       this.updates.onCatchingUp((catchingUp) => {[39m
[31m+         this.onConnectionState.emit(catchingUp ? "updating" : "connected");[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this.mt.onUpdate.forwardTo(this.onServerUpdate);[39m
[31m+     this.mt.onUsable.add(() => this.onConnectionState.emit("connected"));[39m
[31m+     this.mt.onConnecting.add(() => this.onConnectionState.emit("connecting"));[39m
[31m+     this.mt.onNetworkChanged.add((connected) => {[39m
[31m+       if (!connected) {[39m
[31m+         this.onConnectionState.emit("offline");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     this.crypto = this.mt.crypto;[39m
[31m+     this.storage = new TelegramStorageManager(this.mt.storage, {[39m
[31m+       provider: this.params.storage,[39m
[31m+       ...dropUndefined(this.params.storageOptions)[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     this.timers = new TimersManager(async (spec, abortSignal) => {[39m
[31m+       await this.call(spec.request, {[39m
[31m+         abortSignal,[39m
[31m+         ...spec.options[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     this.timers.onError((err) => this.onError.emit(unknownToError(err)));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   updates;[39m
[31m+   log;[39m
[31m+   mt;[39m
[31m+   crypto;[39m
[31m+   storage;[39m
[31m+   platform;[39m
[31m+   timers;[39m
[31m+   onServerUpdate = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onRawUpdate = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   onConnectionState = new Emitter();[39m
[31m+   appConfig = new AppConfigManager(this);[39m
[31m+   _prepare = asyncResettable(async () => {[39m
[31m+     await this.mt.prepare();[39m
[31m+     const self = await this.storage.self.fetch();[39m
[31m+     this.log.prefix = `[USER ${self?.userId ?? "n/a"}] `;[39m
[31m+     this.mt.network.setIsPremium(self?.isPremium ?? false);[39m
[31m+     await this.updates?.prepare();[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * **ADVANCED**[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Do all the preparations, but don't connect just yet.[39m
[31m+    * Useful when you want to do some preparations before[39m
[31m+    * connecting, like setting up session.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Call {@link connect} to actually connect.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   prepare() {[39m
[31m+     return this._prepare.run();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   // used in a hot path, avoid extra function calls[39m
[31m+   _connected = false;[39m
[31m+   _connect = asyncResettable(async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (this.#destroyed) throw new Error("Client is destroyed");[39m
[31m+     await this._prepare.run();[39m
[31m+     await this.mt.connect();[39m
[31m+     this._connected = true;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Initialize the connection to the primary DC.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * You shouldn't usually call this method directly as it is called[39m
[31m+    * implicitly the first time you call {@link call}.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async connect() {[39m
[31m+     return this._connect.run();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   get isConnected() {[39m
[31m+     return this._connected;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async disconnect() {[39m
[31m+     this._connected = false;[39m
[31m+     this.timers.destroy();[39m
[31m+     this.updates?.stopLoop();[39m
[31m+     await this.storage.close();[39m
[31m+     this._prepare.reset();[39m
[31m+     this._connect.reset();[39m
[31m+     await this.mt.disconnect();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   #destroyed = false;[39m
[31m+   async destroy() {[39m
[31m+     if (this.#destroyed) return;[39m
[31m+     this.#destroyed = true;[39m
[31m+     await this.disconnect();[39m
[31m+     this.updates?.destroy();[39m
[31m+     await this.mt.destroy();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   get destroyed() {[39m
[31m+     return this.#destroyed;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   [Symbol.asyncDispose]() {[39m
[31m+     return this.destroy();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async notifyLoggedIn(auth) {[39m
[31m+     const user = this.mt.network.notifyLoggedIn(auth);[39m
[31m+     this.log.prefix = `[USER ${user.id}] `;[39m
[31m+     await this.storage.self.storeFrom(user);[39m
[31m+     this.updates?.notifyLoggedIn();[39m
[31m+     return user;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async notifyLoggedOut() {[39m
[31m+     this.mt.network.notifyLoggedOut();[39m
[31m+     this.updates?.notifyLoggedOut();[39m
[31m+     this.log.prefix = "[USER n/a] ";[39m
[31m+     await this.storage.self.store(null);[39m
[31m+     const primaryDc = this.mt.network.getPrimaryDcId();[39m
[31m+     for (const dcId of [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) {[39m
[31m+       if (dcId === primaryDc) continue;[39m
[31m+       await this.mt.storage.provider.authKeys.deleteByDc(dcId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async notifyChannelOpened(channelId, pts) {[39m
[31m+     return this.updates?.notifyChannelOpened(channelId, pts) ?? false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async notifyChannelClosed(channelId) {[39m
[31m+     return this.updates?.notifyChannelClosed(channelId) ?? false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async startUpdatesLoop() {[39m
[31m+     await this.updates?.startLoop();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async stopUpdatesLoop() {[39m
[31m+     this.updates?.stopLoop();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Make an RPC call[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * This method is still quite low-level and you shouldn't use this[39m
[31m+    * when using high-level API provided by `@mtcute/client`.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param message  RPC method to call[39m
[31m+    * @param params  Additional call parameters[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async call(message2, params) {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._connected) {[39m
[31m+       await this._connect.run();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const res = await this.mt.call(message2, params);[39m
[31m+     if (isTlRpcError(res)) {[39m
[31m+       const error = makeRpcError(res, new Error().stack ?? "", message2._);[39m
[31m+       throw error;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     await this.storage.peers.updatePeersFrom(res);[39m
[31m+     return res;[39m

[31m+ function telegramRleEncode(buf) {[39m
[31m+   const len = buf.length;[39m
[31m+   const ret = [];[39m
[31m+   let count = 0;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const cur = buf[i];[39m
[31m+     if (cur === 0) {[39m
[31m+       count += 1;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (count > 0) {[39m
[31m+         ret.push(0, count);[39m
[31m+         count = 0;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       ret.push(cur);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (count > 0) {[39m
[31m+     ret.push(0, count);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return new Uint8Array(ret);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function telegramRleDecode(buf) {[39m
[31m+   const len = buf.length;[39m
[31m+   const ret = [];[39m
[31m+   let prev = -1;[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {[39m
[31m+     const cur = buf[i];[39m
[31m+     if (prev === 0) {[39m
[31m+       for (let j = 0; j < cur; j++) {[39m
[31m+         ret.push(prev);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       prev = -1;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (prev !== -1) ret.push(prev);[39m
[31m+       prev = cur;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (prev !== -1) ret.push(prev);[39m
[31m+   return new Uint8Array(ret);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+         throw new InvalidFileIdError([39m

[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       }[39m

[31m+         _: "thumbnail",[39m
[31m+         fileType,[39m

[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     case 2:[39m
[31m+     case 3:[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "dialogPhoto",[39m

[31m+         _: "fullLegacy",[39m

[31m+         localId: reader.int()[39m

[31m+       if (res.localId < 0) {[39m

[31m+     case 6:[39m
[31m+     case 7: {[39m

[31m+         big: variant === 7,[39m
[31m+         id: reader.int53(),[39m
[31m+         accessHash: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+         volumeId: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+         localId: reader.int()[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       if (res.localId < 0) {[39m

[31m+       const res = {[39m

[31m+       );[39m

[31m+ function parsePhotoFileLocation(reader, version) {[39m
[31m+   const id = reader.long();[39m
[31m+   const accessHash = reader.long();[39m
[31m+   let source;[39m
[31m+   if (version >= 32) {[39m

[31m+   } else {[39m

[31m+     if (version >= 22) {[39m
[31m+       source = parsePhotoSizeSource(reader);[39m
[31m+       localId = reader.int();[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       source = {[39m
[31m+         _: "fullLegacy",[39m
[31m+         secret: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+         localId: reader.int(),[39m
[31m+         volumeId[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     switch (source._) {[39m
[31m+       case "legacy":[39m
[31m+         source = {[39m
[31m+           _: "fullLegacy",[39m
[31m+           secret: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+           localId: reader.int(),[39m
[31m+           volumeId[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "fullLegacy":[39m
[31m+       case "thumbnail":[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "dialogPhoto":[39m
[31m+         source = {[39m
[31m+           _: "dialogPhotoLegacy",[39m
[31m+           id: source.id,[39m
[31m+           accessHash: source.accessHash,[39m
[31m+           big: source.big,[39m
[31m+           localId,[39m
[31m+           volumeId[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case "stickerSetThumbnail":[39m
[31m+         source = {[39m

[31m+ function parseCommonFileLocation(reader) {[39m

[31m+     accessHash: reader.long()[39m

[31m+ function fromPersistentIdV23(binary, version) {[39m
[31m+   if (version < 0 || version > CURRENT_VERSION) {[39m
[31m+     throw new UnsupportedError(`Unsupported file ID v3 subversion: ${version} (${base64_exports.encode(binary)})`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   binary = telegramRleDecode(binary);[39m
[31m+   const reader = TlBinaryReader.manual(binary);[39m
[31m+   let fileType = reader.int();[39m
[31m+   const isWeb = Boolean(fileType & WEB_LOCATION_FLAG);[39m
[31m+   const hasFileReference = Boolean(fileType & FILE_REFERENCE_FLAG);[39m
[31m+   fileType &= -16777217;[39m
[31m+   fileType &= -33554433;[39m
[31m+   if (fileType < 0 || fileType >= FileType.Size) {[39m
[31m+     throw new UnsupportedError(`Unsupported file type: ${fileType} (${base64_exports.encode(binary)})`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const dcId = reader.int();[39m
[31m+   let fileReference = null;[39m
[31m+   if (hasFileReference) {[39m
[31m+     fileReference = reader.bytes();[39m
[31m+     if (fileReference.length === 1 && fileReference[0] === 35) {[39m
[31m+       fileReference = null;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let location;[39m
[31m+   if (isWeb) {[39m
[31m+     location = parseWebFileLocation(reader);[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     switch (fileType) {[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Photo:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.ProfilePhoto:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Thumbnail:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.EncryptedThumbnail:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Wallpaper: {[39m
[31m+         location = parsePhotoFileLocation(reader, version);[39m
[31m+         switch (location.source._) {[39m
[31m+           case "thumbnail":[39m
[31m+             if (location.source.fileType !== fileType || fileType !== FileType.Photo && fileType !== FileType.Thumbnail && fileType !== FileType.EncryptedThumbnail) {[39m
[31m+               throw new InvalidFileIdError("Invalid FileType in PhotoRemoteFileLocation Thumbnail");[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+           case "dialogPhoto":[39m
[31m+           case "dialogPhotoLegacy":[39m
[31m+             if (fileType !== FileType.ProfilePhoto) {[39m
[31m+               throw new InvalidFileIdError("Invalid FileType in PhotoRemoteFileLocation DialogPhoto");[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+           case "stickerSetThumbnail":[39m
[31m+           case "stickerSetThumbnailLegacy":[39m
[31m+           case "stickerSetThumbnailVersion":[39m
[31m+             if (fileType !== FileType.Thumbnail) {[39m
[31m+               throw new InvalidFileIdError([39m
[31m+                 "Invalid FileType in PhotoRemoteFileLocation StickerSetThumbnail"[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Video:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.VoiceNote:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Document:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Sticker:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Audio:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Animation:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Encrypted:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.VideoNote:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.SecureRaw:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Secure:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Background:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.DocumentAsFile: {[39m
[31m+         location = parseCommonFileLocation(reader);[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         throw new UnsupportedError(`Invalid file type: ${fileType} (${base64_exports.encode(binary)})`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     _: "remoteFileLocation",[39m
[31m+     dcId,[39m
[31m+     type: fileType,[39m
[31m+     fileReference,[39m
[31m+     location[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function fromPersistentIdV2(binary) {[39m
[31m+   return fromPersistentIdV23(binary.subarray(0, -1), 0);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function fromPersistentIdV3(binary) {[39m
[31m+   const subversion = binary[binary.length - 2];[39m
[31m+   return fromPersistentIdV23(binary.subarray(0, -2), subversion);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function parseFileId(fileId) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof fileId === "string") fileId = base64_exports.decode(fileId, true);[39m
[31m+   const version = fileId[fileId.length - 1];[39m
[31m+   if (version === PERSISTENT_ID_VERSION_OLD) {[39m
[31m+     return fromPersistentIdV2(fileId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (version === PERSISTENT_ID_VERSION) {[39m
[31m+     return fromPersistentIdV3(fileId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new UnsupportedError(`Unsupported file ID version: ${version} (${base64_exports.encode(fileId)})`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
