[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/file-id/serialize-unique.js[39m
[31m+ function toUniqueFileId(first, second) {[39m
[31m+   const inputType = typeof first === "number" ? first : first.type;[39m
[31m+   const inputLocation = typeof first === "number" ? second : first.location;[39m
[31m+   let type;[39m
[31m+   if (inputLocation._ === "web") {[39m
[31m+     type = UniqueFileIdType.Web;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     switch (inputType) {[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Photo:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.ProfilePhoto:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Thumbnail:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.EncryptedThumbnail:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Wallpaper:[39m
[31m+         type = UniqueFileIdType.Photo;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Video:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.VoiceNote:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Document:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Sticker:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Audio:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Animation:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.VideoNote:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Background:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.DocumentAsFile:[39m
[31m+         type = UniqueFileIdType.Document;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case FileType.SecureRaw:[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Secure:[39m
[31m+         type = UniqueFileIdType.Secure;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Encrypted:[39m
[31m+         type = UniqueFileIdType.Encrypted;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       case FileType.Temp:[39m
[31m+         type = UniqueFileIdType.Temp;[39m
[31m+         break;[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         throw new InvalidFileIdError(`Invalid file type: ${inputType}`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let writer;[39m
[31m+   switch (inputLocation._) {[39m
[31m+     case "photo": {[39m
[31m+       const source = inputLocation.source;[39m
[31m+       switch (source._) {[39m
[31m+         case "legacy": {[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(16);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(100);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(source.secret);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnail": {[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(24);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(150);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         case "dialogPhoto": {[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(13);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(inputLocation.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.raw(new Uint8Array([Number(source.big)]));[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         case "thumbnail": {[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(13);[39m
[31m+           let thumbType = source.thumbnailType.charCodeAt(0);[39m
[31m+           if (thumbType === 97) {[39m
[31m+             thumbType = 0;[39m
[31m+           } else if (thumbType === 99) {[39m
[31m+             thumbType = 1;[39m
[31m+           } else {[39m
[31m+             thumbType += 5;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(inputLocation.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.raw(new Uint8Array([thumbType]));[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         case "fullLegacy":[39m
[31m+         case "dialogPhotoLegacy":[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnailLegacy":[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(16);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(source.volumeId);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(source.localId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnailVersion":[39m
[31m+           writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(17);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+           writer.raw(new Uint8Array([2]));[39m
[31m+           writer.long(source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(source.version);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     case "web":[39m
[31m+       writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(utf8_exports.encodedLength(inputLocation.url) + 8);[39m
[31m+       writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+       writer.string(inputLocation.url);[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case "common":[39m
[31m+       writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(12);[39m
[31m+       writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(inputLocation.id);[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       assertNever2();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return base64_exports.encode(telegramRleEncode(writer.result()), true);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/file-id/serialize.js[39m
[31m+ var SUFFIX = new Uint8Array([CURRENT_VERSION, PERSISTENT_ID_VERSION]);[39m
[31m+ function toFileId(location) {[39m
[31m+   const loc = location.location;[39m
[31m+   let type = location.type;[39m
[31m+   if (loc._ === "web") type |= WEB_LOCATION_FLAG;[39m
[31m+   if (location.fileReference) type |= FILE_REFERENCE_FLAG;[39m
[31m+   const writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(loc._ === "web" ? utf8_exports.encodedLength(loc.url) + 32 : 100);[39m
[31m+   writer.int(type);[39m
[31m+   writer.int(location.dcId);[39m
[31m+   if (location.fileReference) {[39m
[31m+     writer.bytes(location.fileReference);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   switch (loc._) {[39m
[31m+     case "web":[39m
[31m+       writer.string(loc.url);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(loc.accessHash);[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case "photo":[39m
[31m+       writer.long(loc.id);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(loc.accessHash);[39m
[31m+       switch (loc.source._) {[39m
[31m+         case "legacy":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(0);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.secret);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "thumbnail":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(1);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.fileType);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.thumbnailType.charCodeAt(0));[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "dialogPhoto":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.big ? 3 : 2);[39m
[31m+           writer.int53(loc.source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnail":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(4);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "fullLegacy":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(5);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.volumeId);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.secret);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.localId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "dialogPhotoLegacy":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.big ? 7 : 6);[39m
[31m+           writer.int53(loc.source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.volumeId);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.localId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnailLegacy":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(8);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.volumeId);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.localId);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "stickerSetThumbnailVersion":[39m
[31m+           writer.int(9);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.id);[39m
[31m+           writer.long(loc.source.accessHash);[39m
[31m+           writer.int(loc.source.version);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         default:[39m
[31m+           assertNever2(loc.source);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     case "common":[39m
[31m+       writer.long(loc.id);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(loc.accessHash);[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       assertNever2();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const result = telegramRleEncode(writer.result());[39m
[31m+   const withSuffix = u8_exports.alloc(result.length + SUFFIX.length);[39m
[31m+   withSuffix.set(result);[39m
[31m+   withSuffix.set(SUFFIX, result.length);[39m
[31m+   return base64_exports.encode(withSuffix, true);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function determinePartSize(fileSize, forUpload = false) {[39m
[31m+   if (fileSize <= 262078465) return 128;[39m
[31m+   if (fileSize <= 786432e3) return 256;[39m
[31m+   if (fileSize <= 2097152e3) return 512;[39m
[31m+   return forUpload ? 512 : 1024;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function isProbablyPlainText(buf) {[39m
[31m+   return !buf.some([39m
[31m+     (it) => !(it >= 32 && it < 127 || it === 13 || it === 10 || it === 9)[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function JPEG_HEADER() {[39m
[31m+   return hex_exports.decode([39m
[31m+     ""[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ var JPEG_HEADER_BYTES = null;[39m
[31m+ var JPEG_FOOTER = new Uint8Array([255, 217]);[39m
[31m+ function strippedPhotoToJpg(stripped) {[39m
[31m+   if (stripped.length < 3 || stripped[0] !== 1) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Invalid stripped JPEG");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (JPEG_HEADER_BYTES === null) {[39m
[31m+     JPEG_HEADER_BYTES = JPEG_HEADER();[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/auth/sign-in-qr.js[39m
[31m+ async function signInQr(client2, params) {[39m

[31m+   let waiter;[39m
[31m+   const onUpdate = (update) => {[39m
[31m+     if (update._ === "updateShort" && update.update._ === "updateLoginToken") {[39m
[31m+       onQrScanned?.();[39m
[31m+       waiter?.resolve();[39m
[31m+       client2.onServerUpdate.remove(onUpdate);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   client2.onServerUpdate.add(onUpdate);[39m
[31m+   abortSignal?.addEventListener("abort", () => {[39m
[31m+     client2.onServerUpdate.remove(onUpdate);[39m
[31m+     waiter?.reject(abortSignal.reason);[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   async function handle2fa(input) {[39m
[31m+     const isDynamic = typeof input === "function";[39m
[31m+     while (true) {[39m
[31m+       const password = await resolveMaybeDynamic(input);[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         return await checkPassword(client2, {[39m
[31m+           password,[39m
[31m+           abortSignal[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (RpcError.is(e, "PASSWORD_HASH_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+           if (!isDynamic) {[39m
[31m+             throw e;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (params.invalidPasswordCallback) {[39m
[31m+             await params.invalidPasswordCallback?.();[39m
[31m+           } else {[39m
[31m+             console.log("Invalid password. Please try again");[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const { id, hash } = await client2.getApiCredentials();[39m
[31m+     loop: while (true) {[39m
[31m+       let res;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         res = await client2.call([39m
[31m+           {[39m
[31m+             _: "auth.exportLoginToken",[39m
[31m+             apiId: id,[39m
[31m+             apiHash: hash,[39m
[31m+             exceptIds: [][39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+           { abortSignal }[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m

[31m+           return await handle2fa(params.password);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       switch (res._) {[39m
[31m+         case "auth.loginToken":[39m

[31m+             `tg://login?token=${base64_exports.encode(res.token, true)}`,[39m
[31m+             new Date(res.expires * 1e3)[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           waiter = new Deferred();[39m
[31m+           await Promise.race([[39m
[31m+             waiter.promise,[39m
[31m+             sleepWithAbort(res.expires * 1e3 - Date.now(), client2.stopSignal)[39m
[31m+           ]);[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "auth.loginTokenMigrateTo": {[39m
[31m+           abortSignal?.throwIfAborted();[39m
[31m+           await client2.changePrimaryDc(res.dcId);[39m
[31m+           abortSignal?.throwIfAborted();[39m
[31m+           let res2;[39m
[31m+           try {[39m
[31m+             res2 = await client2.call([39m
[31m+               {[39m
[31m+                 _: "auth.importLoginToken",[39m
[31m+                 token: res.token[39m
[31m+               },[39m
[31m+               { abortSignal }[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+           } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+             if (RpcError.is(e, "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED") && params.password) {[39m
[31m+               return await handle2fa(params.password);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             throw e;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           assertTypeIs("auth.importLoginToken", res2, "auth.loginTokenSuccess");[39m
[31m+           break loop;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         case "auth.loginTokenSuccess":[39m
[31m+           break loop;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const [self] = await client2.call([39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         _: "users.getUsers",[39m
[31m+         id: [{ _: "inputUserSelf" }][39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       { abortSignal }[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     assertTypeIs("users.getUsers", self, "user");[39m
[31m+     await client2.notifyLoggedIn(self);[39m
[31m+     return new User$2(self);[39m
[31m+   } finally {[39m
[31m+     client2.onServerUpdate.remove(onUpdate);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/auth/start.js[39m
[31m+ async function start(client2, params) {[39m
[31m+   if (params.session) {[39m
[31m+     await client2.importSession(params.session, params.sessionForce);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const { abortSignal } = params;[39m
[31m+   let has2fa = false;[39m
[31m+   let sentCode;[39m
[31m+   let phone = null;[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const me = await getMe(client2);[39m
[31m+     client2.log.info("Logged in as %s (ID: %s, username: %s, bot: %s)", me.displayName, me.id, me.username, me.isBot);[39m
[31m+     await client2.notifyLoggedIn(me.raw);[39m
[31m+     return me;[39m
[31m+   } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+     if (RpcError.is(e)) {[39m
[31m+       if (e.text === "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED") {[39m
[31m+         has2fa = true;[39m
[31m+       } else if (e.text === "SESSION_REVOKED" || e.text === "USER_DEACTIVATED" || e.text === "USER_DEACTIVATED_BAN") {[39m
[31m+         await logOut(client2).catch((err) => {[39m
[31m+           client2.log.warn("failed to log out: %e", err);[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       } else if (e.text !== "AUTH_KEY_UNREGISTERED") {[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       throw e;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!has2fa && !params.qrCodeHandler) {[39m
[31m+     if (!params.phone && !params.botToken) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("Neither phone nor bot token were provided");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     phone = params.phone ? await resolveMaybeDynamic(params.phone) : null;[39m
[31m+     if (phone) {[39m
[31m+       phone = normalizePhoneNumber(phone);[39m
[31m+       if (!params.code) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError("You must pass `code` to use `phone`");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const botToken = params.botToken ? await resolveMaybeDynamic(params.botToken) : null;[39m
[31m+       if (!botToken) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError("Either bot token or phone number must be provided");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return signInBot(client2, botToken);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const res = await sendCode(client2, {[39m
[31m+         phone,[39m
[31m+         futureAuthTokens: params.futureAuthTokens,[39m
[31m+         codeSettings: params.codeSettings,[39m
[31m+         abortSignal[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       if (res instanceof User$2) {[39m
[31m+         return res;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       sentCode = res;[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (RpcError.is(e, "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED")) {[39m
[31m+         has2fa = true;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (sentCode) {[39m
[31m+     if (params.forceSms && (sentCode.type === "app" || sentCode.type === "email")) {[39m
[31m+       sentCode = await resendCode(client2, {[39m
[31m+         phone,[39m
[31m+         phoneCodeHash: sentCode.phoneCodeHash,[39m
[31m+         abortSignal[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (params.codeSentCallback) {[39m
[31m+       await params.codeSentCallback(sentCode);[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       if (sentCode.type === "email_required") {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtcuteError("Email login setup is required to sign in");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       console.log(`The confirmation code has been sent via ${sentCode.type}.`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+       const code = await resolveMaybeDynamic(params.code);[39m
[31m+       if (!code) throw new RpcError(400, "PHONE_CODE_EMPTY");[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         return await signIn(client2, {[39m
[31m+           phone,[39m
[31m+           phoneCodeHash: sentCode.phoneCodeHash,[39m
[31m+           phoneCode: code,[39m
[31m+           abortSignal[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (!RpcError.is(e)) throw e;[39m
[31m+         if (e.is("SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED")) {[39m
[31m+           has2fa = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         } else if (e.is("PHONE_CODE_EMPTY") || e.is("PHONE_CODE_EXPIRED") || e.is("PHONE_CODE_INVALID") || e.is("PHONE_CODE_HASH_EMPTY")) {[39m
[31m+           if (typeof params.code !== "function") {[39m
[31m+             throw new MtArgumentError("Provided code was invalid");[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           if (params.invalidCodeCallback) {[39m
[31m+             await params.invalidCodeCallback("code");[39m
[31m+           } else {[39m
[31m+             console.log("Invalid code. Please try again");[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           throw e;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (has2fa) {[39m
[31m+     if (!params.password) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("2FA is enabled, but `password` was not provided.");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+       const password = await resolveMaybeDynamic(params.password);[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         return await checkPassword(client2, {[39m
[31m+           password,[39m
[31m+           abortSignal[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (typeof params.password !== "function") {[39m
[31m+           throw new MtArgumentError("Provided password was invalid");[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (RpcError.is(e, "PASSWORD_HASH_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+           if (params.invalidCodeCallback) {[39m
[31m+             await params.invalidCodeCallback("password");[39m
[31m+           } else {[39m
[31m+             console.log("Invalid password. Please try again");[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           continue;[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           throw e;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (params.qrCodeHandler) {[39m
[31m+     return signInQr(client2, {[39m
[31m+       onUrlUpdated: params.qrCodeHandler,[39m
[31m+       password: params.password,[39m
[31m+       invalidPasswordCallback: params.invalidCodeCallback ? () => params.invalidCodeCallback("password") : void 0,[39m
[31m+       abortSignal[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtArgumentError("Failed to log in with provided credentials");[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/auth/start-test.js[39m
[31m+ async function startTest(client2, params) {[39m
[31m+   if (!params) params = {};[39m
[31m+   if (params.logout) {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       await logOut(client2);[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const availableDcs = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+     _: "help.getConfig"[39m
[31m+   }).then((res) => res.dcOptions);[39m
[31m+   let phone = params.phone;[39m
[31m+   if (phone) {[39m
[31m+     if (!phone.match(/^99966\d{5}/)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError(`${phone} is an invalid test phone number`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const id = Number.parseInt(phone[5]);[39m
[31m+     if (!availableDcs.find((dc) => dc.id === id)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError(`${phone} has invalid DC ID (${id})`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     let dcId = await client2.getPrimaryDcId();[39m
[31m+     if (params.dcId) {[39m
[31m+       if (!availableDcs.find((dc) => dc.id === params.dcId)) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError(`DC ID is invalid (${dcId})`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       dcId = params.dcId;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let numbers = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9999).toString();[39m
[31m+     while (numbers.length !== 4) numbers += "0";[39m
[31m+     phone = `99966${dcId}${numbers}`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let code = "";[39m
[31m+   return start(client2, {[39m
[31m+     phone,[39m
[31m+     code: () => code,[39m
[31m+     codeSentCallback: (sent) => {[39m
[31m+       for (let i = 0; i < sent.length; i++) {[39m
[31m+         code += phone[5];[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function fileIdToInputFileLocation(fileId) {[39m

[31m+ function fileIdToInputDocument(fileId) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof fileId === "string") fileId = parseFileId(fileId);[39m
[31m+   if (fileId.location._ !== "common" || fileId.type === FileType2.Secure || fileId.type === FileType2.SecureRaw || fileId.type === FileType2.Encrypted) {[39m
[31m+     throw new types_inner_exports.ConversionError("inputDocument");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let fileRef = fileId.fileReference;[39m
[31m+   if (!fileRef) {[39m

[31m+     } else {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     _: "inputDocument",[39m
[31m+     fileReference: fileRef,[39m
[31m+     id: fileId.location.id,[39m
[31m+     accessHash: fileId.location.accessHash[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/voice-utils.js[39m
[31m+ function decodeWaveform(wf) {[39m
[31m+   const bitsCount = wf.length * 8;[39m
[31m+   const valuesCount = ~~(bitsCount / 5);[39m
[31m+   if (!valuesCount) return [];[39m
[31m+   const lastIdx = valuesCount - 1;[39m
[31m+   const result = [];[39m
[31m+   const dv = typed_exports.toDataView(wf);[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < lastIdx; i++, j += 5) {[39m
[31m+     const byteIdx = ~~(j / 8);[39m
[31m+     const bitShift = j % 8;[39m
[31m+     result[i] = dv.getUint16(byteIdx, true) >> bitShift & 31;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const lastByteIdx = ~~(lastIdx * 5 / 8);[39m
[31m+   const lastBitShift = lastIdx * 5 % 8;[39m
[31m+   const lastValue = lastByteIdx === wf.length - 1 ? wf[lastByteIdx] : dv.getUint16(lastByteIdx, true);[39m
[31m+   result[lastIdx] = lastValue >> lastBitShift & 31;[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function encodeWaveform(wf) {[39m
[31m+   const bitsCount = wf.length * 5;[39m
[31m+   const bytesCount = ~~((bitsCount + 7) / 8);[39m
[31m+   const result = u8_exports.alloc(bytesCount + 1);[39m
[31m+   const dv = typed_exports.toDataView(result);[39m
[31m+   for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < wf.length; i++, j += 5) {[39m
[31m+     const byteIdx = ~~(j / 8);[39m
[31m+     const bitShift = j % 8;[39m
[31m+     const value = (wf[i] & 31) << bitShift;[39m
[31m+     dv.setUint16(byteIdx, dv.getUint16(byteIdx, true) | value, true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return result.slice(0, bytesCount);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/users/_resolve-common.js[39m
[31m+ function _normalizePeerId(peerId) {[39m

[31m+ function _handleContactsResolvedPeer(peerId, res) {[39m

[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "inputPeerChannel",[39m
[31m+         channelId: found.id,[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/users/resolve-phone-number.js[39m
[31m+ async function resolvePhoneNumber(client2, phone, force = false) {[39m
[31m+   phone = phone.replace(/[@+\s()]/g, "");[39m
[31m+   if (!phone.match(/^\d+$/)) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   try {[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/users/resolve-peer.js[39m
[31m+ async function resolvePeer(client2, peerId, force = false) {[39m
[31m+   peerId = _normalizePeerId(peerId);[39m
[31m+   if (typeof peerId === "object") {[39m
[31m+     return peerId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof peerId === "number" && !force) {[39m
[31m+     const fromStorage = await client2.storage.peers.getById(peerId);[39m
[31m+     if (fromStorage) return fromStorage;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof peerId === "string") {[39m
[31m+     if (peerId === "self" || peerId === "me") return { _: "inputPeerSelf" };[39m
[31m+     peerId = peerId.replace(/^@/, "");[39m
[31m+     if (peerId.match(/^\d/)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError([39m
[31m+         `Invalid username: ${peerId}. If you wanted to resolve by user ID, pass a number instead. If you wanted to resolve by phone number, use resolvePhoneNumber instead.`[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!force) {[39m
[31m+       const fromStorage = await client2.storage.peers.getByUsername(peerId);[39m
[31m+       if (fromStorage) return fromStorage;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const res = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+         _: "contacts.resolveUsername",[39m
[31m+         username: peerId[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       return _handleContactsResolvedPeer(peerId, res);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (RpcError.is(e, "USERNAME_NOT_OCCUPIED") || RpcError.is(e, "USERNAME_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtPeerNotFoundError(`Peer with username ${peerId} was not found`);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const [peerType, bareId] = parseMarkedPeerId(peerId);[39m
[31m+   if (peerType === "chat") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputPeerChat",[39m
[31m+       chatId: bareId[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const cached = await client2.storage.peers.getCompleteById(peerId, true);[39m
[31m+   if (cached && (cached._ === "channel" || cached._ === "user")) {[39m
[31m+     const [username] = extractUsernames(cached);[39m
[31m+     if (username) {[39m
[31m+       const resolved = await resolvePeer(client2, username, true).catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (resolved && getMarkedPeerId(resolved) === peerId) {[39m
[31m+         return resolved;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (cached._ === "user" && cached.phone) {[39m
[31m+       const resolved = await resolvePhoneNumber(client2, cached.phone, true).catch(() => null);[39m
[31m+       if (resolved && getMarkedPeerId(resolved) === peerId) {[39m
[31m+         return resolved;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   switch (peerType) {[39m
[31m+     case "user": {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const res = await _getUsersBatched(client2, {[39m
[31m+           _: "inputUser",[39m
[31m+           userId: bareId,[39m
[31m+           accessHash: long_default.ZERO[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         if (res != null && res._ === "user" && res.accessHash != null) {[39m
[31m+           return {[39m
[31m+             _: "inputPeerUser",[39m
[31m+             userId: bareId,[39m
[31m+             accessHash: res.accessHash[39m
[31m+           };[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (!RpcError.is(e, "USER_INVALID")) throw e;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     case "channel": {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const res = await _getChannelsBatched(client2, {[39m
[31m+           _: "inputChannel",[39m
[31m+           channelId: bareId,[39m
[31m+           accessHash: long_default.ZERO[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         if (res != null && res._ === "channel" && res.accessHash != null) {[39m
[31m+           return {[39m
[31m+             _: "inputPeerChannel",[39m
[31m+             channelId: bareId,[39m
[31m+             accessHash: res.accessHash[39m
[31m+           };[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         if (RpcError.is(e, "COMMUNITY_ID_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+           if (client2.storage.self.getCached(true)?.isBot) {[39m
[31m+             return {[39m
[31m+               _: "inputPeerChannel",[39m
[31m+               channelId: bareId,[39m
[31m+               accessHash: long_default.ZERO[39m
[31m+             };[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         } else if (!RpcError.is(e, "CHANNEL_INVALID")) {[39m
[31m+           throw e;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtPeerNotFoundError(`Peer ${peerId} is not found in local cache`);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function resolveUser(client2, peerId, force = false) {[39m
[31m+   return toInputUser(await resolvePeer(client2, peerId, force), peerId);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function resolveChannel(client2, peerId, force = false) {[39m
[31m+   return toInputChannel(await resolvePeer(client2, peerId, force), peerId);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/misc/normalize-text.js[39m
[31m+ var empty2 = ["", void 0];[39m
[31m+ function adjustOffsets(entities, from, by) {[39m
[31m+   for (const ent of entities) {[39m
[31m+     if (ent.offset < from) continue;[39m
[31m+     if (by >= 0) {[39m
[31m+       ent.offset += by;[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const adjustTotal = Math.min(ent.offset, Math.abs(by));[39m
[31m+     const adjustInternal = Math.max(Math.abs(by) - ent.offset, 0);[39m
[31m+     ent.offset -= adjustTotal;[39m
[31m+     ent.length -= adjustInternal;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function _normalizeInputText(client2, input) {[39m
[31m+   if (!input) {[39m
[31m+     return empty2;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof input === "string") {[39m
[31m+     return [input, void 0];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let text = input.text;[39m
[31m+   const entities = input.entities;[39m
[31m+   if (!entities) return [text, void 0];[39m
[31m+   let canTrimStart = true;[39m
[31m+   for (const ent of entities) {[39m
[31m+     if (ent._ === "messageEntityMentionName") {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const inputPeer = await resolveUser(client2, ent.userId);[39m
[31m+         const ent_ = ent;[39m
[31m+         ent_._ = "inputMessageEntityMentionName";[39m
[31m+         ent_.userId = inputPeer;[39m
[31m+       } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+         client2.log.warn("Failed to resolve mention entity for %s: %s", ent.userId, e);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (ent._ === "messageEntityPre" && ent.offset === 0) {[39m
[31m+       canTrimStart = false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (canTrimStart) {[39m
[31m+     const resultTrimmed = text.trimStart();[39m
[31m+     const numCharsTrimmed = text.length - resultTrimmed.length;[39m
[31m+     text = resultTrimmed;[39m
[31m+     adjustOffsets(entities, 0, -numCharsTrimmed);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   text = text.trimEnd();[39m
[31m+   for (const ent of entities) {[39m
[31m+     const end = ent.offset + ent.length;[39m
[31m+     if (end > text.length) ent.length = text.length - ent.offset;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return [text, entities];[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/file-type.js[39m
[31m+ function guessFileMime(chunk) {[39m
[31m+   if (chunk.length < 12) return null;[39m
[31m+   const b0 = chunk[0];[39m
[31m+   const b1 = chunk[1];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 66 && b1 === 77) return "image/bmp";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 77 && b1 === 90) return "application/x-msdownload";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 31 && (b1 === 157 || b1 === 160)) return "application/x-compress";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 31 && b1 === 139) return "application/gzip";[39m
[31m+   const b2 = chunk[2];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 66 && b1 === 90 && b2 === 104) return "application/x-bzip2";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 73 && b1 === 68 && b2 === 51) return "audio/mpeg";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 255 && (b1 === 251 || b1 === 243 || b1 === 242)) return "audio/mpeg";[39m
[31m+   const b3 = chunk[3];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 80 && b1 === 75 && b2 === 3 && b3 === 4) return "application/zip";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 56 && b1 === 66 && b2 === 80 && b3 === 83) return "image/vnd.adobe.photoshop";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 127 && b1 === 69 && b2 === 76 && b3 === 70) return "application/x-elf";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 254 && b1 === 237 && b2 === 250 && b3 === 207) return "application/x-mach-binary";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 40 && b1 === 181 && b2 === 47 && b3 === 253) return "application/zstd";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 102 && b1 === 76 && b2 === 97 && b3 === 67) return "audio/x-flac";[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 255 && b1 === 216 && b2 === 255 && (b3 === 219 || b3 === 224 || b3 === 238 || b3 === 225)) {[39m
[31m+     return "image/jpeg";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 79 && b1 === 103 && b2 === 103 && b3 === 83) {[39m
[31m+     if (chunk.length > 36) {[39m
[31m+       const type = String.fromCharCode(...chunk.subarray(28, 36));[39m
[31m+       if (type === "OpusHead") return "audio/ogg";[39m
[31m+       if (type.startsWith("\x80theora")) return "video/ogg";[39m
[31m+       if (type.startsWith("video")) return "video/ogg";[39m
[31m+       if (type.startsWith("\x7FFLAC")) return "audio/ogg";[39m
[31m+       if (type.startsWith("Speex  ")) return "audio/ogg";[39m
[31m+       if (type.startsWith("vorbis")) return "audio/ogg";[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return "application/ogg";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const b4 = chunk[4];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 37 && b1 === 80 && b2 === 68 && b3 === 70 && b4 === 45) return "application/pdf";[39m
[31m+   const b5 = chunk[5];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 71 && b1 === 73 && b2 === 70 && b3 === 56) {[39m
[31m+     if ((b4 === 55 || b4 === 57) && b5 === 97) return "image/gif";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 55 && b1 === 122 && b2 === 188 && b3 === 175 && b4 === 39 && b5 === 28) {[39m
[31m+     return "application/x-7z-compressed";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const b6 = chunk[6];[39m
[31m+   const b7 = chunk[7];[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 137 && b1 === 80 && b2 === 78 && b3 === 71 && b4 === 13 && b5 === 10 && b6 === 26 && b7 === 10) {[39m
[31m+     return "image/png";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (b0 === 82 && b1 === 97 && b2 === 114 && b3 === 33 && b4 === 26 && b5 === 7) {[39m
[31m+     if (b6 === 0 || b6 === 1) return "application/x-rar-compressed";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (b4 === 102 && b5 === 116 && b6 === 121 && b7 === 112 && chunk[8] & 96) {[39m
[31m+     const brandMajor = String.fromCharCode(...chunk.subarray(8, 12)).replace(/\0/g, " ").trim();[39m
[31m+     switch (brandMajor) {[39m
[31m+       case "avif":[39m
[31m+       case "avis":[39m
[31m+         return "image/avif";[39m
[31m+       case "mif1":[39m
[31m+         return "image/heif";[39m
[31m+       case "msf1":[39m
[31m+         return "image/heif-sequence";[39m
[31m+       case "heic":[39m
[31m+       case "heix":[39m
[31m+         return "image/heic";[39m
[31m+       case "hevc":[39m
[31m+       case "hevx":[39m
[31m+         return "image/heic-sequence";[39m
[31m+       case "qt":[39m
[31m+         return "video/quicktime";[39m
[31m+       case "M4V":[39m
[31m+       case "M4VH":[39m
[31m+       case "M4VP":[39m
[31m+         return "video/x-m4v";[39m
[31m+       case "M4A":[39m
[31m+         return "audio/x-m4a";[39m
[31m+       case "M4B":[39m
[31m+       case "F4A":[39m
[31m+       case "F4B":[39m
[31m+         return "audio/mp4";[39m
[31m+       case "crx":[39m
[31m+         return "image/x-canon-cr3";[39m
[31m+       default:[39m
[31m+         if (brandMajor.startsWith("3g")) {[39m
[31m+           if (brandMajor.startsWith("3g2")) {[39m
[31m+             return "video/3gpp2";[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           return "video/3gpp";[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return "video/mp4";[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/files/upload-file.js[39m
[31m+ var OVERRIDE_MIME = {[39m
[31m+   // tg doesn't interpret `audio/opus` files as voice messages for some reason[39m
[31m+   "audio/opus": "audio/ogg"[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ var SMALL_FILE_MAX_SIZE = 131072;[39m
[31m+ var BIG_FILE_MIN_SIZE = 10485760;[39m
[31m+ var DEFAULT_FILE_NAME = "unnamed";[39m
[31m+ var REQUESTS_PER_CONNECTION = 3;[39m
[31m+ var MAX_PART_COUNT = 4e3;[39m
[31m+ var MAX_PART_COUNT_PREMIUM = 8e3;[39m
[31m+ var HAS_FILE = typeof File !== "undefined";[39m
[31m+ var HAS_RESPONSE = typeof Response !== "undefined";[39m
[31m+ var HAS_URL = typeof URL !== "undefined";[39m
[31m+ var HAS_BLOB = typeof Blob !== "undefined";[39m
[31m+ async function uploadFile(client2, params) {[39m
[31m+   let file = params.file;[39m
[31m+   let fileSize = -1;[39m
[31m+   let fileName = params.fileName;[39m
[31m+   let fileMime = params.fileMime;[39m
[31m+   const abortSignal = params.abortSignal;[39m
[31m+   if (client2.platform.normalizeFile) {[39m
[31m+     const res = await client2.platform.normalizeFile(file);[39m
[31m+     if (res?.file) {[39m
[31m+       file = res.file;[39m
[31m+       if (res.fileSize) fileSize = res.fileSize;[39m
[31m+       if (res.fileName) fileName = res.fileName;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (ArrayBuffer.isView(file)) {[39m
[31m+     fileSize = file.length;[39m
[31m+     file = Bytes.from(file);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (HAS_FILE && file instanceof File) {[39m
[31m+     fileName = file.name;[39m
[31m+     fileSize = file.size;[39m
[31m+     fileMime = file.type;[39m
[31m+     file = file.stream();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (HAS_URL && file instanceof URL) {[39m
[31m+     file = await fetch(file);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (HAS_BLOB && file instanceof Blob) {[39m
[31m+     fileSize = file.size;[39m
[31m+     file = file.stream();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (HAS_RESPONSE && file instanceof Response) {[39m
[31m+     const length = Number.parseInt(file.headers.get("content-length") || "0");[39m
[31m+     if (!Number.isNaN(length) && length) fileSize = length;[39m
[31m+     fileMime = file.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0];[39m
[31m+     const disposition = file.headers.get("content-disposition");[39m
[31m+     if (disposition) {[39m
[31m+       const idx2 = disposition.indexOf("filename=");[39m
[31m+       if (idx2 > -1) {[39m
[31m+         const raw = disposition.slice(idx2 + 9).split(";")[0];[39m
[31m+         fileName = JSON.parse(raw);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (fileName === DEFAULT_FILE_NAME) {[39m
[31m+       const url = new URL(file.url);[39m
[31m+       const name = url.pathname.split("/").pop();[39m
[31m+       if (name && name.includes(".")) {[39m
[31m+         fileName = name;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!file.body) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("Fetch response contains `null` body");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     file = file.body;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (file instanceof ReadableStream) {[39m
[31m+     file = webReadableToFuman(file);[39m
[31m+   } else if (!(typeof file === "object" && "read" in file)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Could not convert input `file` to stream!");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let readable = file;[39m
[31m+   if (fileSize === -1 && params.fileSize) fileSize = params.fileSize;[39m
[31m+   if (fileSize === -1 && params.requireFileSize) {[39m
[31m+     const buffer = await read_exports.async.untilEnd(readable);[39m
[31m+     fileSize = buffer.length;[39m
[31m+     readable = Bytes.from(buffer);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let partSizeKb = params.partSize;[39m
[31m+   if (!partSizeKb) {[39m
[31m+     if (fileSize === -1) {[39m
[31m+       partSizeKb = params.estimatedSize ? determinePartSize(params.estimatedSize, true) : 64;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       partSizeKb = determinePartSize(fileSize, true);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (partSizeKb > 512) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError(`Invalid part size: ${partSizeKb}KB`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const partSize = partSizeKb * 1024;[39m
[31m+   let partCount = fileSize === -1 ? -1 : ~~((fileSize + partSize - 1) / partSize);[39m
[31m+   const maxPartCount = client2.storage.self.getCached()?.isPremium ? MAX_PART_COUNT_PREMIUM : MAX_PART_COUNT;[39m
[31m+   if (partCount > maxPartCount) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError(`File is too large (max ${maxPartCount} parts, got ${partCount})`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const isBig = fileSize === -1 || fileSize > BIG_FILE_MIN_SIZE;[39m
[31m+   const isSmall = fileSize !== -1 && fileSize < SMALL_FILE_MAX_SIZE;[39m
[31m+   const connectionKind = isSmall ? "main" : "upload";[39m
[31m+   const connectionPoolSize = Math.min(await client2.getPoolSize(connectionKind), partCount);[39m
[31m+   const requestsPerConnection = params.requestsPerConnection ?? REQUESTS_PER_CONNECTION;[39m
[31m+   client2.log.debug([39m
[31m+     "uploading %d bytes file in %d chunks, each %d bytes in %s connection pool of size %d",[39m
[31m+     fileSize,[39m
[31m+     partCount,[39m
[31m+     partSize,[39m
[31m+     connectionKind,[39m
[31m+     connectionPoolSize[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const fileId = randomLong();[39m
[31m+   const lock = new AsyncLock();[39m
[31m+   let pos = 0;[39m
[31m+   let idx = 0;[39m
[31m+   let readableEnded = false;[39m
[31m+   const uploadNextPart = async () => {[39m
[31m+     if (abortSignal?.aborted) return;[39m
[31m+     const thisIdx = idx++;[39m
[31m+     await lock.acquire();[39m
[31m+     if (readableEnded) {[39m
[31m+       lock.release();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     let part;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       part = await read_exports.async.exactly(readable, partSize, "truncate");[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       lock.release();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (abortSignal?.aborted) return;[39m
[31m+     const ended = part.length < partSize;[39m
[31m+     if (ended) {[39m
[31m+       readableEnded = true;[39m
[31m+       if (fileSize === -1) {[39m
[31m+         fileSize = pos + part.length;[39m
[31m+         partCount = ~~((fileSize + partSize - 1) / partSize);[39m
[31m+       } else if (thisIdx !== partCount - 1) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError(`Unexpected EOS (there were only ${idx} parts, but expected ${partCount})`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       client2.log.debug("readable ended, file size = %d, part count = %d", fileSize, partCount);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (thisIdx === 0 && fileMime === void 0) {[39m
[31m+       const mime = guessFileMime(part);[39m
[31m+       if (mime) {[39m
[31m+         fileMime = mime;[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         const isPlainText = isProbablyPlainText(part.slice(0, 8));[39m
[31m+         fileMime = isPlainText ? "text/plain" : "application/octet-stream";[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const request = isBig ? {[39m
[31m+       _: "upload.saveBigFilePart",[39m
[31m+       fileId,[39m
[31m+       filePart: thisIdx,[39m
[31m+       fileTotalParts: partCount,[39m
[31m+       bytes: part[39m
[31m+     } : {[39m
[31m+       _: "upload.saveFilePart",[39m
[31m+       fileId,[39m
[31m+       filePart: thisIdx,[39m
[31m+       bytes: part[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     const result = await client2.call(request, {[39m
[31m+       kind: connectionKind,[39m
[31m+       maxRetryCount: Infinity,[39m
[31m+       floodSleepThreshold: Infinity,[39m
[31m+       abortSignal[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (!result) throw new Error(`Failed to upload part ${idx}`);[39m
[31m+     if (abortSignal?.aborted) return;[39m
[31m+     pos += part.length;[39m
[31m+     params.progressCallback?.(pos, fileSize);[39m
[31m+     if (idx === partCount) return;[39m
[31m+     return uploadNextPart();[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   let poolSize = partCount === -1 ? 1 : connectionPoolSize * requestsPerConnection;[39m
[31m+   if (partCount !== -1 && poolSize > partCount) poolSize = partCount;[39m
[31m+   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: poolSize }, uploadNextPart));[39m
[31m+   abortSignal?.throwIfAborted();[39m
[31m+   if (fileName === void 0) {[39m
[31m+     const ext = MIME_TO_EXTENSION[fileMime];[39m
[31m+     fileName = ext ? `${DEFAULT_FILE_NAME}.${ext}` : DEFAULT_FILE_NAME;[39m
[31m+   } else if (params.requireExtension) {[39m
[31m+     const extFromMime = MIME_TO_EXTENSION[fileMime];[39m
[31m+     const idx2 = fileName.lastIndexOf(".");[39m
[31m+     const extFromName = idx2 === -1 ? void 0 : fileName.slice(idx2 + 1);[39m
[31m+     if (!extFromName) {[39m
[31m+       if (!extFromMime) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError(`File name does not have an extension, and we cannot guess it from the mime type (${fileMime})`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       fileName = `${fileName}.${extFromMime}`;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let inputFile;[39m
[31m+   if (isBig) {[39m
[31m+     inputFile = {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputFileBig",[39m
[31m+       id: fileId,[39m
[31m+       parts: partCount,[39m
[31m+       name: fileName[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     inputFile = {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputFile",[39m
[31m+       id: fileId,[39m
[31m+       parts: partCount,[39m
[31m+       name: fileName,[39m
[31m+       md5Checksum: ""[39m
[31m+       // tdlib doesn't do this, why should we?[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (fileMime in OVERRIDE_MIME) fileMime = OVERRIDE_MIME[fileMime];[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     inputFile,[39m
[31m+     size: fileSize,[39m
[31m+     mime: fileMime[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/files/normalize-input-file.js[39m
[31m+ async function _normalizeInputFile(client2, input, params) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof input === "object" && isAnyInputMedia(input)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("InputFile can't be created from an InputMedia");[39m
[31m+   } else if (types_inner_exports.isFileIdLike(input)) {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof input === "string" && input.match(/^file:/)) {[39m
[31m+       const uploaded = await uploadFile(client2, {[39m
[31m+         file: input.substring(5),[39m
[31m+         ...params[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       return uploaded.inputFile;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("InputFile can't be created from an URL or a File ID");[39m
[31m+   } else if (isUploadedFile(input)) {[39m
[31m+     return input.inputFile;[39m
[31m+   } else if (typeof input === "object" && isAnyInputFile(input)) {[39m
[31m+     return input;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     const uploaded = await uploadFile(client2, {[39m
[31m+       file: input,[39m
[31m+       ...params[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return uploaded.inputFile;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/users/resolve-peer-many.js[39m
[31m+ async function resolvePeerMany(client2, peerIds, normalizer) {[39m
[31m+   const ret = [];[39m
[31m+   const limit = 8;[39m
[31m+   if (peerIds.length < limit) {[39m
[31m+     const res = await Promise.all([39m
[31m+       peerIds.map([39m
[31m+         (it) => resolvePeer(client2, it).catch((e) => {[39m
[31m+           if (e instanceof MtPeerNotFoundError) {[39m
[31m+             return null;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           throw e;[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     if (!normalizer) return res;[39m
[31m+     for (const value of res) {[39m
[31m+       if (!value) continue;[39m
[31m+       const norm = normalizer(value);[39m
[31m+       if (norm) {[39m
[31m+         ret.push(norm);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return ret;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return parallelMap(peerIds, async (it) => {[39m
[31m+     let peer;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       peer = await resolvePeer(client2, it);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+       if (e instanceof MtPeerNotFoundError) {[39m
[31m+         return null;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       throw e;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (normalizer) return normalizer(peer);[39m
[31m+     return peer;[39m
[31m+   }, { limit });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ async function _uploadRichMedia(client2, peer, id, media, params) {[39m

[31m+ async function _normalizeInputRichMessage(client2, peer, input, params) {[39m
[31m+   if ("_" in input) return input;[39m
[31m+   if (input.type !== "blocks") {[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const photos = [];[39m

[31m+   function processBlock(node) {[39m

[31m+       case "pageBlockCollage":[39m

[31m+ function _convertToTl(obj) {[39m
[31m+   if (!obj) return obj;[39m
[31m+   if (isAnyReplyMarkup(obj)) return obj;[39m
[31m+   switch (obj.type) {[39m
[31m+     case "reply":[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "replyKeyboardMarkup",[39m

[31m+         selective: obj.selective,[39m
[31m+         persistent: obj.persistent,[39m
[31m+         placeholder: obj.placeholder,[39m
[31m+         rows: _2dToRows(obj.buttons, false)[39m
[31m+       };[39m

[31m+         selective: obj.selective,[39m
[31m+         placeholder: obj.placeholder[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     case "inline":[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "replyInlineMarkup",[39m
[31m+         rows: _2dToRows(obj.buttons, true)[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       assertNever();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/bots/inline-result/factories.js[39m
[31m+ async function _convertToTl3(client2, results) {[39m
[31m+   const normalizeThumb = (obj, fallback) => {[39m
[31m+     if (obj.type !== "voice" && obj.type !== "audio" && obj.type !== "sticker" && obj.type !== "game") {[39m

[31m+   };[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/bots/normalize-command-scope.js[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/inline-utils.js[39m
[31m+ function parseInlineMessageId(id) {[39m
[31m+   const buf = base64_exports.decode(id, true);[39m
[31m+   const reader = TlBinaryReader.manual(buf);[39m
[31m+   if (buf.length === 20) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputBotInlineMessageID",[39m
[31m+       dcId: reader.int(),[39m
[31m+       id: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+       accessHash: reader.long()[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     _: "inputBotInlineMessageID64",[39m
[31m+     dcId: reader.int(),[39m
[31m+     ownerId: reader.long(),[39m
[31m+     id: reader.int(),[39m
[31m+     accessHash: reader.long()[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function encodeInlineMessageId(id) {[39m
[31m+   let writer;[39m
[31m+   switch (id._) {[39m
[31m+     case "inputBotInlineMessageID":[39m
[31m+       writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(20);[39m
[31m+       writer.int(id.dcId);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(id.id);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(id.accessHash);[39m

[31m+     case "inputBotInlineMessageID64":[39m
[31m+       writer = TlBinaryWriter.manual(24);[39m
[31m+       writer.int(id.dcId);[39m
[31m+       writer.long(id.ownerId);[39m

[31m+       break;[39m
[31m+     default:[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return base64_exports.encode(writer.result(), true);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ var Dice = class {[39m

[31m+    */[39m

[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * A dart. Telegram dart has 4 rings and middle.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * {@link value} represents the position of the dart:[39m
[31m+    * ![Dart position graph](https://i.imgur.com/iPBm7HG.png)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   static TYPE_DART = "\u{1F3AF}";[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * A basketball thrown into a hoop.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * {@link value} represents the motion of the ball:[39m
[31m+    *  - 1: simple miss (ball hits right part, bounces to the left)[39m
[31m+    *  - 2: first hit the ring, then miss[39m
[31m+    *  - 3: ball gets stuck between the ring and the base[39m
[31m+    *  - 4: first hit the ring, then score[39m
[31m+    *  - 5: direct score[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   static TYPE_BASKETBALL = "\u{1F3C0}";[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * A football thrown to the gate.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * {@link value} represents the motion of the ball:[39m
[31m+    *  - 1: flies above the top barbell[39m
[31m+    *  - 2: hits right barbell, then miss[39m
[31m+    *  - 3: direct score in the middle[39m
[31m+    *  - 4: hits left barbell, then score, then hits right barbell[39m
[31m+    *  - 5: score in the top-right corner[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   static TYPE_FOOTBALL = "\u26BD\uFE0F";[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * A bowling ball thrown to pins.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Assuming the following identifiers for the pins:[39m
[31m+    * ```[39m
[31m+    * 4 5 6[39m
[31m+    *  2 3[39m
[31m+    *   1[39m
[31m+    * ```[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * {@link value} represents the motion of the ball and pins:[39m
[31m+    *  - 1: the ball touched 6th pin, none are down[39m
[31m+    *  - 2: the ball hit 4th pin, only 4th pin is down.[39m
[31m+    *  - 3: the ball hit 1st pin, pins 1, 2, 5 are down, leaving pins 3, 4, 6[39m
[31m+    *  - 4: the ball hit 1st pin on the right side, all the pins except 2nd and 6th are down[39m
[31m+    *  - 5: the ball hit 3rd pin and all the pins except 2nd are down.[39m
[31m+    *  - 6: the ball hit 1st pin and all pins are down[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   static TYPE_BOWLING = "\u{1F3B3}";[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * A slot machine.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * {@link value} represents the result of the machine.[39m
[31m+    * Value itself is an integer in range `[1, 64]`,[39m
[31m+    * and is composed out of several parts.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * > **Note**: The following information is based on the TDesktop[39m
[31m+    * > implementation. These are the relevant files:[39m
[31m+    * >  - [`chat_helpers/stickers_dice_pack.cpp`](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/blob/dev/Telegram/SourceFiles/chat_helpers/stickers_dice_pack.cpp)[39m
[31m+    * >  - [`history/view/media/history_view_slot_machine.cpp`](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/blob/dev/Telegram/SourceFiles/history/view/media/history_view_slot_machine.cpp)[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Unlike other animated dices, this does not have[39m
[31m+    * all the possible combinations in the sticker set.[39m
[31m+    * Instead, `value` is a specially encoded integer that contains[39m
[31m+    * the information about the indexes.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * There are some base parts of the animations:[39m
[31m+    *  - 0th sticker is the base background of the machine[39m
[31m+    *  - 1st sticker is the background of the machine for the "winning" state (i.e. `777`)[39m
[31m+    *  - 2nd sticker is the frame of the machine, including the handle[39m
[31m+    *  - 8th sticker is the "idle" state for the left slot[39m
[31m+    *  - 14th sticker is the "idle" state for the middle slot[39m
[31m+    *  - 20th sticker is the "idle" state for the right slot[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * The machine result is encoded as 3 concatenated two-bit integers,[39m
[31m+    * and the resulting integer is incremented by one.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * So, to decode the value to its parts, you can use this code:[39m
[31m+    * ```typescript[39m
[31m+    * const computePartValue = (val: number, idx: number) => ((val - 1) >> (idx * 2)) & 0x03; // 0..3[39m
[31m+    * const parts = [[39m
[31m+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 0),[39m
[31m+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 1),[39m
[31m+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 2),[39m
[31m+    * ][39m
[31m+    * ```[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Each part of the value corresponds to a particular slot (i.e. part 0 is left slot,[39m
[31m+    * part 1 is middle, part 2 is right). The slot values are as follows:[39m
[31m+    *  - 0: BAR (displayed as a *BAR* sign on a black background)[39m
[31m+    *  - 1: BERRIES (displayed as berries, similar to emoji 🍇)[39m
[31m+    *  - 2: LEMON (displayed as a lemon, similar to emoji 🍋)[39m
[31m+    *  - 3: SEVEN (displayed as a red digit 7)[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Therefore, the winning value (i.e. `777`) is represented as `(3 << 4 | 3 << 2 | 3 << 0) + 1 = 64`[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * To determine the needed animation parts, you'll need to apply some shifts.[39m
[31m+    * These are the offsets for the individual symbols:[39m
[31m+    *  - WIN_SEVEN: 0[39m
[31m+    *  - SEVEN: 1[39m
[31m+    *  - BAR: 2[39m
[31m+    *  - BERRIES: 3[39m
[31m+    *  - LEMON: 4[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * And these are the shifts for each slot:[39m
[31m+    *  - LEFT: 3[39m
[31m+    *  - MIDDLE: 9[39m
[31m+    *  - RIGHT: 15[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * > WIN_SEVEN is the same as SEVEN, but only used if the machine result is `777` (i.e. `value = 64`),[39m
[31m+    * > as it contains additional "blinking" animation.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * The sticker index is computed as follows: `SHIFTS[SLOT] + OFFSETS[SYM]`.[39m
[31m+    * For example, berries for the middle slot would be: `SHIFTS[MIDDLE] + OFFSETS[BERRIES] = 9 + 3 = 12`[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Currently, this sticker set is used for the machine: [SlotMachineAnimated](https://t.me/addstickers/SlotMachineAnimated)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   static TYPE_SLOTS = "\u{1F3B0}";[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * An emoji which was originally sent.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * See static members of {@link Dice} for a list[39m
[31m+    * of possible values[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get emoji() {[39m
[31m+     return this.obj.emoticon;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Emoji's interactive value.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * See what this value represents in the corresponding[39m
[31m+    * type's documentation (in {@link Dice} static fields)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get value() {[39m
[31m+     return this.obj.value;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Input media TL object generated from this object,[39m

[31m+    * {@link TelegramClient.sendMedia}[39m

[31m+    * will be generated![39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get inputMedia() {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputMediaDice",[39m
[31m+       emoticon: this.obj.emoticon[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/reactions/types.js[39m
[31m+ function normalizeInputReaction(reaction) {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof reaction === "string") {[39m
[31m+     if (reaction === "paid") {[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         _: "reactionPaid"[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       _: "reactionEmoji",[39m
[31m+       emoticon: reaction[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   } else if (long_default.isLong(reaction)) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       _: "reactionCustomEmoji",[39m
[31m+       documentId: reaction[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   } else if (reaction) {[39m
[31m+     return reaction;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     _: "reactionEmpty"[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function toReactionEmoji(reaction, allowEmpty) {[39m
[31m+   switch (reaction._) {[39m
[31m+     case "reactionEmoji":[39m
[31m+       return reaction.emoticon;[39m
[31m+     case "reactionCustomEmoji":[39m
[31m+       return reaction.documentId;[39m
[31m+     case "reactionPaid":[39m
[31m+       return "\u2B50";[39m
[31m+     case "reactionEmpty":[39m
[31m+       if (!allowEmpty) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtTypeAssertionError("toReactionEmoji", "not reactionEmpty", reaction._);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return null;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/chats/add-chat-members.js[39m
[31m+ async function addChatMembers(client2, chatId, users, params) {[39m
[31m+   const { forwardCount = 100 } = params;[39m
[31m+   const chat = await resolvePeer(client2, chatId);[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(users)) users = [users];[39m
[31m+   if (isInputPeerChat(chat)) {[39m
[31m+     const missing = [];[39m
[31m+     for (const user of users) {[39m
[31m+       const p = await resolveUser(client2, user);[39m
[31m+       const { updates, missingInvitees } = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+         _: "messages.addChatUser",[39m

[31m+         userId: p,[39m
[31m+         fwdLimit: forwardCount[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       client2.handleClientUpdate(updates);[39m
[31m+       missing.push(...missingInvitees);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return missing;[39m
[31m+   } else if (isInputPeerChannel(chat)) {[39m
[31m+     const { updates, missingInvitees } = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+       _: "channels.inviteToChannel",[39m
[31m+       channel: toInputChannel(chat),[39m
[31m+       users: await resolvePeerMany(client2, users, toInputUser)[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     client2.handleClientUpdate(updates);[39m
[31m+     return missingInvitees;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   throw new MtInvalidPeerTypeError(chatId, "chat or channel");[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/peers/chat-event/filters.js[39m
[31m+ function normalizeChatEventFilters(input) {[39m
[31m+   if (!input) {[39m
[31m+     return {};[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof input === "string" || Array.isArray(input)) {[39m
[31m+     if (!Array.isArray(input)) input = [input];[39m
[31m+     const serverFilter = {[39m
[31m+       _: "channelAdminLogEventsFilter"[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     const localFilter = {};[39m
[31m+     input.forEach((type) => {[39m
[31m+       localFilter[type] = true;[39m
[31m+       switch (type) {[39m
[31m+         case "user_joined":[39m
[31m+         case "user_joined_invite":[39m
[31m+         case "user_joined_approved":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.join = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "user_left":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.leave = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "user_invited":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.invite = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "title_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "description_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "linked_chat_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "location_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "photo_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "username_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "usernames_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "stickerset_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "slow_mode_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "ttl_changed":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.info = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "invites_toggled":[39m
[31m+         case "history_toggled":[39m
[31m+         case "signatures_toggled":[39m
[31m+         case "def_perms_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "forum_toggled":[39m
[31m+         case "no_forwards_toggled":[39m
[31m+         case "signature_profiles_toggled":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.settings = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "msg_pinned":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.pinned = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "msg_edited":[39m
[31m+         case "poll_stopped":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.edit = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "msg_deleted":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.delete = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "user_perms_changed":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.ban = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.unban = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.kick = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.unkick = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "user_admin_perms_changed":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.promote = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.demote = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "call_started":[39m
[31m+         case "call_ended":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.groupCall = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "call_setting_changed":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.groupCall = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.settings = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.info = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "invite_deleted":[39m
[31m+         case "invite_edited":[39m
[31m+         case "invite_revoked":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.invites = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "topic_created":[39m
[31m+         case "topic_edited":[39m
[31m+         case "topic_deleted":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.forums = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         case "sub_extend":[39m
[31m+         case "available_reactions_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "emoji_status_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "emoji_stickerset_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "msg_sent":[39m
[31m+         case "peer_color_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "profile_peer_color_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "wallpaper_changed":[39m
[31m+         case "toggle_anti_spam":[39m
[31m+         case "toggle_autotranslation":[39m
[31m+         case "participant_rank_edited":[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.invite = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.invites = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.join = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.info = true;[39m
[31m+           serverFilter.settings = true;[39m
[31m+           break;[39m
[31m+         default:[39m
[31m+           assertNever();[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       serverFilter,[39m
[31m+       localFilter[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if ("_" in input) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       serverFilter: input[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return input;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/peers/chat-invite-link.js[39m
[31m+ var ChatInviteLink = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(raw, _peers) {[39m
[31m+     this._peers = _peers;[39m
[31m+     assertTypeIsNot("ChatInviteLink", raw, "chatInvitePublicJoinRequests");[39m
[31m+     this.raw = raw;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   raw;[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * The invite link as a `t.me/joinchat/` string.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * If the link was created by another administrator, the second[39m
[31m+    * part of the link will be censored with `...` (e.g. `https://t.me/joinchat/BGxxHIg4...`[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * See also: {@link isMyLink}[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get link() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.link;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Whether this invite link was created by the current user.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * If so, {@link link} will be a full invite link.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get isMyLink() {[39m
[31m+     return this.creator?.isSelf ?? !this.raw.link.endsWith("...");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Creator of the invite link, if available[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get creator() {[39m
[31m+     if (!this._peers) return null;[39m
[31m+     return new User$2(this._peers.user(this.raw.adminId));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Creation date of the link[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get date() {[39m
[31m+     return new Date(this.raw.date * 1e3);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Whether this link is primary (i.e. "permanent")[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get isPrimary() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.permanent;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Whether this link was revoked and can't be used anymore[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get isRevoked() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.revoked;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * The date since which the link will be valid (if any)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get startDate() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.startDate ? new Date(this.raw.startDate * 1e3) : null;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * The date until which the link will be valid (if any)[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get endDate() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.expireDate ? new Date(this.raw.expireDate * 1e3) : null;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Maximum number of users that can be members of this chat[39m
[31m+    * at the same time after joining using this link.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Integer in range `[1, 99999]` or `Infinity` if unspecified[39m

[31m+ async function getChatEventLog(client2, chatId, params) {[39m
[31m+   const { maxId = long_default.ZERO, minId = long_default.ZERO, query = "", limit = 100, users, filters } = params ?? {};[39m
[31m+   const channel = await resolveChannel(client2, chatId);[39m

[31m+ async function getChatMember(client2, params) {[39m

[31m+ var DAYS_IN_WEEK = 7;[39m
[31m+ var MINUTES_IN_DAY = 24 * 60;[39m
[31m+ function businessWorkHoursDaysToRaw(day) {[39m
[31m+   const res = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const d of day) {[39m
[31m+     const dayStart = d.day * MINUTES_IN_DAY;[39m
[31m+     if (d.is24h) {[39m
[31m+       res.push({[39m
[31m+         _: "businessWeeklyOpen",[39m
[31m+         startMinute: dayStart,[39m
[31m+         endMinute: dayStart + MINUTES_IN_DAY[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (const interval of d.intervals) {[39m
[31m+       const start2 = dayStart + interval.startHour * 60 + interval.startMinute;[39m
[31m+       const end = dayStart + interval.endHour * 60 + interval.endMinute;[39m
[31m+       if (start2 >= end) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtArgumentError("startMinute >= endMinute");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       res.push({[39m
[31m+         _: "businessWeeklyOpen",[39m
[31m+         startMinute: start2,[39m
[31m+         endMinute: end[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return res;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     const sorted = [...this.raw.weeklyOpen].sort((a, b) => a.startMinute - b.startMinute);[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/chats/set-chat-photo.js[39m
[31m+ async function setChatPhoto(client2, params) {[39m
[31m+   const { chatId, type, media, previewSec } = params;[39m
[31m+   const chat = await resolvePeer(client2, chatId);[39m
[31m+   if (!(isInputPeerChannel(chat) || isInputPeerChat(chat))) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtInvalidPeerTypeError(chatId, "chat or channel");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let photo2;[39m
[31m+   let inputFile;[39m
[31m+   if (types_inner_exports.isFileIdLike(media)) {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof media === "string" && media.match(/^https?:\/\//)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("Chat photo can't be external");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (typeof media === "string" && media.match(/^file:/)) {[39m
[31m+       const uploaded = await uploadFile(client2, {[39m
[31m+         file: media.substring(5)[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       inputFile = uploaded.inputFile;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const input = fileIdToInputPhoto(media);[39m
[31m+       photo2 = {[39m
[31m+         _: "inputChatPhoto",[39m
[31m+         id: input[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } else if (typeof media === "object" && isAnyInputMedia(media)) {[39m
[31m+     if (media._ === "inputMediaPhoto") {[39m
[31m+       photo2 = {[39m
[31m+         _: "inputChatPhoto",[39m
[31m+         id: media.id[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("Chat photo can't be InputMedia");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } else if (isUploadedFile(media)) {[39m
[31m+     inputFile = media.inputFile;[39m
[31m+   } else if (typeof media === "object" && isAnyInputFile(media)) {[39m
[31m+     inputFile = media;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     const uploaded = await uploadFile(client2, {[39m
[31m+       file: media[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     inputFile = uploaded.inputFile;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!photo2) {[39m
[31m+     photo2 = {[39m
[31m+       _: "inputChatUploadedPhoto",[39m
[31m+       [type === "photo" ? "file" : "video"]: inputFile,[39m
[31m+       videoStartTs: previewSec[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let res;[39m
[31m+   if (isInputPeerChat(chat)) {[39m
[31m+     res = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+       _: "messages.editChatPhoto",[39m
[31m+       chatId: chat.chatId,[39m
[31m+       photo: photo2[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     res = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+       _: "channels.editPhoto",[39m
[31m+       channel: toInputChannel(chat),[39m
[31m+       photo: photo2[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   client2.handleClientUpdate(res);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/dialogs/find-dialogs.js[39m
[31m+ async function findDialogs(client2, peers) {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(peers)) peers = [peers];[39m
[31m+   const resolved = await resolvePeerMany(client2, peers);[39m

[31m+   let notFoundCount = 0;[39m
[31m+   const foundInputPeers = [];[39m
[31m+   const foundIdxToOriginalIdx = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m

[31m+       }[39m

[31m+     for (const [idx, origIdx] of foundIdxToOriginalIdx) {[39m

[31m+       ret[origIdx] = dialogs[idx];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+     if (!chat.username) continue;[39m

[31m+     if (idxByUsername !== void 0) {[39m

[31m+       notFoundCount -= 1;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (notFoundCount === 0) break;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (notFoundCount > 0) {[39m
[31m+     const notFound = [...notFoundIds.keys(), ...notFoundUsernames.keys()];[39m
[31m+     throw new MtPeerNotFoundError(`Could not find dialogs with peers: ${notFound.join(", ")}`);[39m

[31m+     return new Promise((resolve) => {[39m
[31m+       timers_exports.setTimeout(resolve, ms);[39m

[31m+     client2.log.debug("download aborted");[39m
[31m+     error = abortSignal.reason;[39m
[31m+     ended = true;[39m
[31m+     nextChunkCv.notify();[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   abortSignal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort);[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/files/download-chunk.js[39m
[31m+ async function downloadChunk(client2, params) {[39m
[31m+   const { location: input, dcId, offset, limit, maxRetryCount, floodSleepThreshold, abortSignal } = params;[39m
[31m+   const normalized = await _normalizeFileDownloadLocation(client2, input);[39m
[31m+   const location = normalized.location;[39m
[31m+   if (isAnyInputWebFileLocation(location)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtUnsupportedError("Web file locations are not supported for chunked downloads");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (ArrayBuffer.isView(location)) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError("Inline file locations are not supported for chunked downloads");[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   let alignedOffset = offset;[39m
[31m+   let alignedLimit = limit;[39m
[31m+   if (alignedOffset % 1024 !== 0) {[39m
[31m+     alignedOffset = Math.floor(alignedOffset / 1024) * 1024;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const stripStart = offset - alignedOffset;[39m
[31m+   if (stripStart > 0) {[39m
[31m+     alignedLimit += 1024 - stripStart;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (alignedLimit % 1024 !== 0) {[39m
[31m+     alignedLimit = Math.ceil(alignedLimit / 1024) * 1024;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (alignedLimit > 1048576) {[39m
[31m+     throw new MtArgumentError(`Limit (${alignedLimit}) is too large for chunked downloads`);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const stripEnd = alignedLimit - limit - stripStart;[39m
[31m+   const result = await client2.call([39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       _: "upload.getFile",[39m
[31m+       location,[39m
[31m+       offset: alignedOffset,[39m
[31m+       limit: alignedLimit,[39m
[31m+       precise: true[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       dcId,[39m
[31m+       maxRetryCount,[39m
[31m+       floodSleepThreshold,[39m
[31m+       abortSignal[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   assert(result._ === "upload.file");[39m
[31m+   let bytes2 = result.bytes;[39m
[31m+   if (stripStart > 0) {[39m
[31m+     bytes2 = bytes2.subarray(stripStart);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (stripEnd > 0) {[39m
[31m+     bytes2 = bytes2.subarray(0, -stripEnd);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return bytes2;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function downloadAsStream(client2, location, params) {[39m
[31m+   if (location instanceof FileLocation$1 && ArrayBuffer.isView(location.location)) {[39m
[31m+     const buf = location.location;[39m
[31m+     return new ReadableStream({[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const cancel = new AbortController();[39m

[31m+     pull() {[39m
