[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     cancel() {[39m
[31m+       cancel.abort();[39m
[31m+       removeAbortListener();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, {[39m
[31m+     highWaterMark: params?.highWaterMark,[39m
[31m+     size: (chunk) => chunk?.length ?? 0[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/utils/entities.js[39m
[31m+ function joinTextWithEntities(parts, delim = "") {[39m
[31m+   const textParts = [];[39m
[31m+   const newEntities = [];[39m
[31m+   let position = 0;[39m
[31m+   if (typeof delim === "string") {[39m
[31m+     delim = { text: delim };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const pushPart = (part) => {[39m
[31m+     textParts.push(part.text);[39m
[31m+     const entitiesOffset = position;[39m
[31m+     position += part.text.length;[39m
[31m+     if (part.entities) {[39m
[31m+       for (const entity of part.entities) {[39m
[31m+         newEntities.push({[39m
[31m+           ...entity,[39m
[31m+           offset: entity.offset + entitiesOffset[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   for (const part of parts) {[39m
[31m+     if (position > 0) {[39m
[31m+       pushPart(delim);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     pushPart(typeof part === "string" ? { text: part } : part);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     text: textParts.join(""),[39m
[31m+     entities: newEntities[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/messages/create-streaming-draft.js[39m

[31m+   const {[39m
[31m+     mode = "replace",[39m
[31m+     threadId,[39m

[31m+ function writeQuery(query) {[39m
[31m+   if (!query) return "";[39m
[31m+   let str = "";[39m
[31m+   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (!str) return "";[39m
[31m+   return `?${str}`;[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/messages/search-hashtag.js[39m
[31m+ var defaultOffset4 = {[39m
[31m+   rate: 0,[39m
[31m+   peer: { _: "inputPeerEmpty" },[39m
[31m+   id: 0[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+ async function searchHashtag(client2, hashtag, params) {[39m
[31m+   const { offset: { rate: offsetRate, peer: offsetPeer, id: offsetId } = defaultOffset4, limit = 100 } = params ?? {};[39m
[31m+   const res = await client2.call({[39m
[31m+     _: "channels.searchPosts",[39m
[31m+     hashtag,[39m
[31m+     offsetId,[39m
[31m+     offsetRate,[39m
[31m+     offsetPeer,[39m
[31m+     limit[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   assertTypeIsNot("searchHashtag", res, "messages.messagesNotModified");[39m
[31m+   const peers = PeersIndex.from(res);[39m
[31m+   const msgs = res.messages.filter((msg) => msg._ !== "messageEmpty").map((msg) => new Message$2(msg, peers));[39m
[31m+   const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1];[39m
[31m+   const next = last ? {[39m
[31m+     rate: res.nextRate ?? last.raw.date,[39m
[31m+     peer: last.chat.inputPeer,[39m
[31m+     id: last.id[39m
[31m+   } : void 0;[39m
[31m+   return makeArrayPaginated(msgs, res.count ?? msgs.length, next);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function* iterSearchHashtag(client2, hashtag, params) {[39m
[31m+   if (!params) params = {};[39m
[31m+   const { limit = Infinity, chunkSize = 100 } = params;[39m
[31m+   let { offset } = params;[39m
[31m+   let current = 0;[39m
[31m+   for (; ; ) {[39m
[31m+     const res = await searchHashtag(client2, hashtag, {[39m
[31m+       offset,[39m
[31m+       limit: Math.min(chunkSize, limit - current)[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (!res.length) return;[39m
[31m+     for (const msg of res) {[39m
[31m+       yield msg;[39m
[31m+       if (++current >= limit) return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (!res.next) return;[39m
[31m+     offset = res.next;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/messages/send-text.js[39m
[31m+ function _inputReplyToToHeader(replyTo, peer) {[39m
[31m+   if (!replyTo) return [void 0, void 0];[39m
[31m+   switch (replyTo._) {[39m

[31m+       return [[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           _: "messageReplyHeader",[39m

[31m+           replyToTopId: replyTo.topMsgId,[39m
[31m+           quote: replyTo.quoteText !== void 0 ? true : void 0,[39m
[31m+           quoteText: replyTo.quoteText,[39m
[31m+           quoteEntities: replyTo.quoteEntities,[39m
[31m+           quoteOffset: replyTo.quoteOffset,[39m
[31m+           todoItemId: replyTo.todoItemId,[39m
[31m+           pollOption: replyTo.pollOption[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         replyTo.monoforumPeerId ? inputPeerToPeer(replyTo.monoforumPeerId) : void 0[39m
[31m+       ];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     case "inputReplyToStory":[39m
[31m+       return [[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           _: "messageReplyStoryHeader",[39m
[31m+           peer: inputPeerToPeer(replyTo.peer),[39m
[31m+           storyId: replyTo.storyId[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         void 0[39m
[31m+       ];[39m
[31m+     case "inputReplyToMonoForum":[39m
[31m+       return [void 0, inputPeerToPeer(replyTo.monoforumPeerId)];[39m
[31m+     case "inputReplyToEphemeralMessage":[39m
[31m+       return [[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           _: "messageReplyHeader",[39m
[31m+           replyToEphemeral: true,[39m
[31m+           replyToMsgId: replyTo.id[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         void 0[39m
[31m+       ];[39m

[31m+ async function sendText(client2, chatId, text, params) {[39m

[31m+   );[39m

[31m+       sendAs,[39m

[31m+       quickReplyShortcut,[39m
[31m+       effect: params.effect,[39m
[31m+       allowPaidFloodskip: params.allowPaidFloodskip,[39m
[31m+       allowPaidStars: params.allowPaidMessages[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       chainId,[39m
[31m+       abortSignal: params.abortSignal,[39m

[31m+       fromId: sendAs ? inputPeerToPeer(sendAs) : { _: "peerUser", userId: client2.storage.self.getCached().userId },[39m

[31m+       if (!cached) {[39m

[31m+       }[39m

[31m+     if (replyToHeader?._ === "messageReplyHeader" && replyToHeader.replyToTopId && replyToHeader.replyToTopId !== 1 && msg2.peerId._ === "peerChannel") {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const ret = new Message$2(msg2, peers);[39m
[31m+     return ret;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const msg = _findMessageInUpdate(client2, res, false, !params.shouldDispatch, false, randomId);[39m
[31m+   return msg;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/methods/messages/send-quote.js[39m
[31m+ function extractQuote(message2, from, to) {[39m
[31m+   const { raw } = message2;[39m
[31m+   if (raw._ === "messageService") throw new MtArgumentError("Cannot quote service message");[39m
[31m+   if (!raw.message) throw new MtArgumentError("Cannot quote empty message");[39m
[31m+   const text = raw.message;[39m
[31m+   if (from < 0) from = 0;[39m
[31m+   if (to > text.length) to = text.length;[39m
[31m+   if (from >= to) throw new MtArgumentError("Invalid quote range");[39m
[31m+   if (!raw.entities) return { text: text.slice(from, to), entities: void 0 };[39m
[31m+   const entities = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const ent of raw.entities) {[39m
[31m+     const start2 = ent.offset;[39m
[31m+     const end = ent.offset + ent.length;[39m
[31m+     if (start2 >= to || end <= from) continue;[39m
[31m+     const newStart = Math.max(start2, from) - from;[39m
[31m+     const newEnd = Math.min(end, to) - from;[39m
[31m+     const newEnt = { ...ent, offset: newStart, length: newEnd - newStart };[39m
[31m+     entities.push(newEnt);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return { text: text.slice(from, to), entities };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/highlevel/types/misc/takeout-session.js[39m
[31m+ var TakeoutSession = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(client2, session2) {[39m
[31m+     this.client = client2;[39m
[31m+     this.id = session2.id;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Takeout session id[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   id;[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Make an API call using this takeout session[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * This method just wraps the query into `invokeWithTakeout`[39m
[31m+    * and passes the control down to {@link TelegramClient.call}.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param message  RPC method to call[39m
[31m+    * @param params  Additional call parameters[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async call(message2, params) {[39m
[31m+     let query = {[39m
[31m+       _: "invokeWithTakeout",[39m
[31m+       takeoutId: this.id,[39m
[31m+       query: message2[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     if (params?.withMessageRange) {[39m
[31m+       query = {[39m
[31m+         _: "invokeWithMessagesRange",[39m
[31m+         range: params.withMessageRange,[39m
[31m+         query[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return this.client.call(query, params);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Create a proxy over {@link TelegramClient}[39m
[31m+    * that will use this takeout session to call methods.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * You can optionally provide a function to check if some[39m
[31m+    * RPC method should be called via a takeout session or directly,[39m
[31m+    * otherwise all methods are called through the takeout session.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   createProxy(params) {[39m
[31m+     const boundCall = params ? (obj, theirParams) => {[39m
[31m+       const mergedParams = theirParams ? { ...params, ...theirParams } : params;[39m
[31m+       if (!params.predicate || params.predicate?.(obj)) {[39m
[31m+         return this.call(obj, mergedParams);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return this.client.call(obj, params);[39m
[31m+     } : this.call.bind(this);[39m
[31m+     return new Proxy(this.client, {[39m
[31m+       get(target, prop, receiver) {[39m
[31m+         if (prop === "call") return boundCall;[39m
[31m+         return Reflect.get(target, prop, receiver);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+    * Finish account takeout session[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * @param success  Whether the data was successfully exported[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   async finish(success = true) {[39m

[31m+       _: "account.finishTakeoutSession",[39m

[31m+     });[39m

[31m+   const wrappedClientsMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();[39m
[31m+   function wrapClient(client22) {[39m
[31m+     const existing = wrappedClientsMap.get(client22);[39m
[31m+     if (existing) return existing;[39m
[31m+     const wrappedCall = (message2, extraParams) => client22.call(message2, extraParams ? { ...params, ...extraParams } : params);[39m
[31m+     const wrapped = new Proxy(client22, {[39m
[31m+       get: (target, prop, receiver) => {[39m

[31m+         const res = Reflect.get(target, prop, receiver);[39m
[31m+         if (res && typeof res === "object" && "storage" in res && "call" in res) {[39m

[31m+         return res;[39m

[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     wrappedClientsMap.set(client22, wrapped);[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return wrapClient(client2);[39m

[31m+       throw new MtArgumentError("Conversation hasn't started yet");[39m

[31m+     state.hasConversations = true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _rejectPending(it, error) {[39m

[31m+     it.promise.reject(error);[39m

[31m+ function extractPeerId(raw) {[39m
[31m+   if (!raw) return 0;[39m
[31m+   if (isAnyChatParticipant(raw)) {[39m
[31m+     return raw.userId;[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ var PollVoteUpdate = class {[39m
[31m+   constructor(raw, _peers) {[39m
[31m+     this.raw = raw;[39m
[31m+     this._peers = _peers;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Unique poll ID[39m
[31m+    */[39m

[31m+     return this.raw.pollId;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Peer who has voted[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get peer() {[39m
[31m+     return parsePeer(this.raw.peer, this._peers);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Answers that the user has chosen.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Note that due to incredible Telegram APIs, you[39m
[31m+    * have to have the poll cached to be able to properly[39m
[31m+    * tell which answers were chosen, since in the API[39m
[31m+    * there are just arbitrary `Buffer`s, which are[39m
[31m+    * defined by the client.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * However, most of the major implementations[39m
[31m+    * (tested with TDLib and Bot API, official apps[39m
[31m+    * for Android, Desktop, iOS/macOS) and mtcute[39m
[31m+    * (by default) create `option` as a one-byte `Buffer`,[39m
[31m+    * incrementing from `48` (ASCII `0`) up to `57` (ASCII `9`),[39m
[31m+    * and ASCII representation would define index in the array.[39m
[31m+    * Meaning, if `chosen[0][0] === 48` or `chosen[0].toString() === '0'`,[39m
[31m+    * then the first answer (indexed with `0`) was chosen. To get the index,[39m
[31m+    * you simply subtract `48` from the first byte.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * This might break at any time, but seems to be consistent for now.[39m
[31m+    * To get chosen answer indexes derived as before, use {@link chosenIndexesAuto}.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get chosen() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.options;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Indexes of the chosen answers, derived based on observations[39m
[31m+    * described in {@link chosen}.[39m
[31m+    * This might break at any time, but seems to be consistent for now.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * If something does not add up, {@link MtUnsupportedError} is thrown[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   get chosenIndexesAuto() {[39m
[31m+     return this.raw.options.map((buf) => {[39m
[31m+       if (buf.length > 1) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtUnsupportedError("option had >1 byte");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (buf[0] < 48 || buf[0] > 57) {[39m
[31m+         throw new MtUnsupportedError("option had first byte out of 0-9 range");[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return buf[0] - 48;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ function makeParsedUpdateHandler(params) {[39m
[31m+   const { messageGroupingInterval, onUpdate } = params;[39m
[31m+   if (!messageGroupingInterval) {[39m
[31m+     return (info) => {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = _parseUpdate(info);[39m
[31m+       if (parsed) onUpdate(parsed);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const pending = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+   return (info) => {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = _parseUpdate(info);[39m
[31m+     if (parsed) {[39m
[31m+       if (parsed.name === "new_message" || parsed.name === "new_business_message") {[39m
[31m+         const group = parsed.data.groupedIdUnique;[39m
[31m+         if (group) {[39m
[31m+           const isBusiness = parsed.name === "new_business_message";[39m
[31m+           const pendingGroup = pending.get(group);[39m
[31m+           if (pendingGroup) {[39m
[31m+             pendingGroup[0].push(parsed.data);[39m
[31m+           } else {[39m
[31m+             const messages = [parsed.data];[39m
[31m+             const timeout2 = timers_exports.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+               pending.delete(group);[39m
[31m+               if (isBusiness) {[39m
[31m+                 onUpdate({ name: "business_message_group", data: messages });[39m
[31m+               } else {[39m
[31m+                 onUpdate({ name: "message_group", data: messages });[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             }, messageGroupingInterval);[39m
[31m+             pending.set(group, [messages, timeout2]);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       onUpdate(parsed);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ // node_modules/@mtcute/core/utils/crypto/factorization.js[39m
[31m+ function factorizePQSync(crypto, pq) {[39m
[31m+   const pq_ = bundle_exports.fromBytes(pq);[39m
[31m+   const n = PollardRhoBrent(crypto, pq_);[39m
[31m+   const m3 = pq_ / n;[39m
[31m+   let p;[39m
[31m+   let q;[39m
[31m+   if (n < m3) {[39m
[31m+     p = n;[39m
[31m+     q = m3;[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     p = m3;[39m
[31m+     q = n;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return [bundle_exports.toBytes(p), bundle_exports.toBytes(q)];[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function PollardRhoBrent(crypto, n) {[39m
[31m+   if (n % 2n === 0n) return 2n;[39m
[31m+   let y = randomBigIntInRange(crypto, n - 1n);[39m
[31m+   const c = randomBigIntInRange(crypto, n - 1n);[39m
[31m+   const m3 = randomBigIntInRange(crypto, n - 1n);[39m
[31m+   let g = 1n;[39m
[31m+   let r = 1n;[39m
[31m+   let q = 1n;[39m
[31m+   let ys;[39m
[31m+   let x;[39m
[31m+   while (g === 1n) {[39m
[31m+     x = y;[39m
[31m+     for (let i = 0; r >= i; i++) y = (y * y % n + c) % n;[39m
[31m+     let k = 0n;[39m
[31m+     while (k < r && g === 1n) {[39m
[31m+       ys = y;[39m
[31m+       for (let i = 0n; i < bundle_exports.min2(m3, r - k); i++) {[39m
[31m+         y = (y * y % n + c) % n;[39m
[31m+         q = q * bundle_exports.abs(x - y) % n;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       g = bundle_exports.euclideanGcd(q, n);[39m
[31m+       k = k + m3;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     r <<= 1n;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (g === n) {[39m
[31m+     do {[39m
[31m+       ys = (ys * ys % n + c) % n;[39m
[31m+       g = bundle_exports.euclideanGcd(x - ys, n);[39m
[31m+     } while (g <= 1n);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return g;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   if (typeof input === "undefined") {[39m
[31m+     input = getWasmUrl();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof input === "string" || typeof Request === "function" && input instanceof Request || typeof URL === "function" && input instanceof URL) {[39m
[31m+     input = await fetch(input);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (typeof Response === "function" && input instanceof Response) {[39m

[31m+         const { instance: instance2 } = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(input);[39m

[31m+           console.warn([39m

[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           throw e;[39m

[31m+     const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes2);[39m

[31m+ var V2_MIGRATIONS_EPOCH = 2e12;[39m
[31m+ var IdbStorageDriver = class extends BaseStorageDriver {[39m
[31m+   constructor(_dbName) {[39m
[31m+     super();[39m
[31m+     this._dbName = _dbName;[39m

[31m+   _migrations = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+   _maxVersion = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+   registerMigration(repo, version, migration) {[39m
[31m+     if (this.loaded) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error("Cannot register migrations after loading");[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     if (!map) {[39m
[31m+       map = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+       this._migrations.set(repo, map);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (map.has(version)) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error(`Migration for ${repo} version ${version} is already registered`);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     map.set(version, migration);[39m
[31m+     const prevMax = this._maxVersion.get(repo) ?? 0;[39m
[31m+     if (version > prevMax) {[39m
[31m+       this._maxVersion.set(repo, version);[39m

[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   setRepoCountOverride(repoCount) {[39m
[31m+     if (repoCount < this._maxVersion.size) {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     this._repoCountOverride = repoCount;[39m

[31m+     let version = (this._repoCountOverride ?? repoCount) << 8;[39m

[31m+   async _load() {[39m
[31m+     this.db = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {[39m

[31m+       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);[39m
[31m+       const postUpgrade = [];[39m

[31m+         if (db.version !== this.calculateVersion()) {[39m
[31m+           const ourRepoCount = this._maxVersion.size;[39m
[31m+           const dbRepoCount = db.version - V2_MIGRATIONS_EPOCH >> 8;[39m
[31m+           reject(new Error(`IDB version number mismatch. Did some repository get removed? If so, please use \`setRepoCountOverride\` (DB has ${dbRepoCount} repos, but we have ${ourRepoCount})`));[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           for (const cb of postUpgrade) {[39m
[31m+             await cb(db);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           resolve(db);[39m
[31m+         } catch (e) {[39m
[31m+           reject(e);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       req.onupgradeneeded = () => {[39m
[31m+         const db = req.result;[39m
[31m+         const didUpgrade = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+         const doUpgrade = (repo, fromVersion) => {[39m
[31m+           const migrations = this._migrations.get(repo);[39m
[31m+           if (!migrations) return;[39m
[31m+           const targetVer = this._maxVersion.get(repo);[39m
[31m+           while (fromVersion < targetVer) {[39m
[31m+             const nextVersion = fromVersion + 1;[39m
[31m+             const migration = migrations.get(nextVersion);[39m
[31m+             if (!migration) {[39m
[31m+               throw new Error(`No migration for ${repo} to version ${nextVersion}`);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             const result = migration(db);[39m
[31m+             if (result) {[39m
[31m+               postUpgrade.push(result);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             fromVersion = nextVersion;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+           didUpgrade.add(repo);[39m
[31m+           db.createObjectStore(`${REPO_VERSION_PREFIX}${repo}:${targetVer}`);[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         for (const key of db.objectStoreNames) {[39m
[31m+           if (!key.startsWith(REPO_VERSION_PREFIX)) continue;[39m
[31m+           const [, repo, version] = key.split(":");[39m
[31m+           const currentVer = Number(version);[39m
[31m+           db.deleteObjectStore(key);[39m
[31m+           doUpgrade(repo, currentVer);[39m
[31m+           didUpgrade.add(repo);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         for (const repo of this._migrations.keys()) {[39m
[31m+           if (didUpgrade.has(repo)) continue;[39m
[31m+           doUpgrade(repo, 0);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   async _save() {[39m
[31m+     if (this._pendingWritesOses.size === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     const writes = this._pendingWrites;[39m
[31m+     const oses = this._pendingWritesOses;[39m
[31m+     this._pendingWrites = [];[39m
[31m+     this._pendingWritesOses = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();[39m
[31m+     const tx = this.db.transaction(oses, "readwrite");[39m
[31m+     const osMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();[39m
[31m+     for (const table of oses) {[39m
[31m+       osMap.set(table, tx.objectStore(table));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     for (const [table, obj] of writes) {[39m
[31m+       const os3 = osMap.get(table);[39m
[31m+       if (obj === null) {[39m
[31m+         os3.delete(table);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         os3.put(obj);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     await txToPromise(tx);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   _destroy() {[39m
[31m+     this.db.close();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ };[39m

[31m+ var import_node_fs = __toESM(require("node:fs"), 1);[39m
[31m+ var import_node_os = __toESM(require("node:os"), 1);[39m

[31m+ function id3v2PrefixLength(header, fileSize) {[39m
[31m+   if (header.length < 10 || header[0] !== 73 || header[1] !== 68 || header[2] !== 51) return 0;[39m
[31m+   const major = header[3];[39m
[31m+   if (major < 2 || major > 4) return 0;[39m
[31m+   const sizeBytes = [header[6], header[7], header[8], header[9]];[39m
[31m+   if (sizeBytes.some((value) => value >= 128)) return 0;[39m
[31m+   const bodySize = sizeBytes[0] << 21 | sizeBytes[1] << 14 | sizeBytes[2] << 7 | sizeBytes[3];[39m
[31m+   const footerSize = major === 4 && (header[5] & 16) !== 0 ? 10 : 0;[39m
[31m+   const total = 10 + bodySize + footerSize;[39m
[31m+   return total > 0 && total < fileSize ? total : 0;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function copyRange(sourcePath, destinationPath, start2, endExclusive) {[39m
[31m+   const input = import_node_fs.default.openSync(sourcePath, "r");[39m
[31m+   const output = import_node_fs.default.openSync(destinationPath, "wx", 384);[39m
[31m+   const buffer = Buffer.allocUnsafe(1024 * 1024);[39m
[31m+   let offset = start2;[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     while (offset < endExclusive) {[39m
[31m+       const wanted = Math.min(buffer.byteLength, endExclusive - offset);[39m
[31m+       const read = import_node_fs.default.readSync(input, buffer, 0, wanted, offset);[39m
[31m+       if (read <= 0) throw new Error("Unexpected end of MP3 while creating clean Cloud payload.");[39m
[31m+       let written = 0;[39m
[31m+       while (written < read) written += import_node_fs.default.writeSync(output, buffer, written, read - written);[39m
[31m+       offset += read;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } finally {[39m
[31m+     import_node_fs.default.closeSync(output);[39m
[31m+     import_node_fs.default.closeSync(input);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ function prepareCleanMp3CloudUpload(filePath, filename) {[39m
[31m+   const originalPath = import_node_path.default.resolve(filePath);[39m
[31m+   const stat = import_node_fs.default.statSync(originalPath);[39m
[31m+   if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size <= 0 || !/\.mp3$/i.test(String(filename || originalPath))) {[39m
[31m+     return { path: originalPath, bytes: stat.size, removedBytes: 0, cleanup() {[39m
[31m+     } };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const fd = import_node_fs.default.openSync(originalPath, "r");[39m
[31m+   let prefix = 0;[39m
[31m+   let suffix = 0;[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const head = Buffer.alloc(10);[39m
[31m+     const headRead = import_node_fs.default.readSync(fd, head, 0, head.length, 0);[39m
[31m+     prefix = id3v2PrefixLength(head.subarray(0, headRead), stat.size);[39m
[31m+     if (stat.size - prefix > 128) {[39m
[31m+       const tail = Buffer.alloc(128);[39m
[31m+       const tailRead = import_node_fs.default.readSync(fd, tail, 0, tail.length, stat.size - 128);[39m
[31m+       if (tailRead === 128 && tail[0] === 84 && tail[1] === 65 && tail[2] === 71) suffix = 128;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   } finally {[39m
[31m+     import_node_fs.default.closeSync(fd);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const end = stat.size - suffix;[39m
[31m+   if (prefix === 0 && suffix === 0 || prefix >= end) {[39m
[31m+     return { path: originalPath, bytes: stat.size, removedBytes: 0, cleanup() {[39m
[31m+     } };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const tempPath = import_node_path.default.join(import_node_os.default.tmpdir(), `beatgaler-clean-mp3-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}.mp3`);[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     copyRange(originalPath, tempPath, prefix, end);[39m
[31m+   } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       import_node_fs.default.unlinkSync(tempPath);[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     throw error;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const cleanBytes = end - prefix;[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     path: tempPath,[39m
[31m+     bytes: cleanBytes,[39m
[31m+     removedBytes: stat.size - cleanBytes,[39m
[31m+     cleanup() {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         import_node_fs.default.unlinkSync(tempPath);[39m
[31m+       } catch {[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   const previousRefs = collectMediaIds(previous?.manifest);[39m
[31m+   const nextRefs = collectMediaIds(next);[39m
[31m+   const safe = [...oldIds].every((id) => newIds.has(id));[39m
[31m+   if (safe) {[39m
[31m+     for (const id of previousRefs) if (!nextRefs.has(id)) {[39m

[31m+         await active.deleteMessagesById(Number(session.chat_id), [id]);[39m
[31m+         deletedMedia += 1;[39m
[31m+       } catch {[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   const fileId = String(fresh?.media?.fileId || `direct:${sent.id}`);[39m

[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ async function deleteMessages2(ids) {[39m
[31m+   const active = await ensureFreshTemporarySession();[39m
[31m+   const unique = [...new Set((ids || []).map(Number).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0))];[39m
[31m+   let deleted = 0;[39m
[31m+   const errors = [];[39m
[31m+   for (let offset = 0; offset < unique.length; offset += 100) {[39m
[31m+     const batch = unique.slice(offset, offset + 100);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       await active.deleteMessagesById(Number(session.chat_id), batch);[39m
[31m+       deleted += batch.length;[39m

[31m+       errors.push(String(e?.message || e));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     try {[39m

[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m

[31m+       await sleep(Math.min(2e3, 250 * 2 ** Math.min(attempt - 1, 3)));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const current = await ensureIndex();[39m
[31m+   emit({ ok: true, op: "ready", session_id: session.session_id, transport_id: session.transport_id, generation: session.generation, credential_version: session.credential_version, index_message_id: Number(current?.message?.id || 0), beat_count: Array.isArray(current?.manifest?.beats) ? current.manifest.beats.length : 0, mode: "temp-mtproto" });[39m

[31m+   while (!closing) {[39m

[31m+     if (!line.trim()) continue;[39m

[31m+ function formatCloudBytes(bytes: number) {[39m
[31m+   if (!bytes) return "0 B";[39m
[31m+   const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];[39m
[31m+   let n = bytes; let i = 0;[39m
[31m+   while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }[39m
[31m+   return `${n.toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;[39m

[31m+ function readActiveCloudUploads(): ActiveCloudUpload[] {[39m

[31m+ async function rollbackInterruptedCloudUploads(beatgalerUserId: string, authoritativeBeatIds: Set<string> | null): Promise<string[]> {[39m
[31m+   const pending = readActiveCloudUploads();[39m
[31m+   if (pending.length === 0) return [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rolledBack: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   const remaining: ActiveCloudUpload[] = [];[39m
[31m+   const base = getResolvedCloudApiBase();[39m
[31m+   const token = getBeatGalerAuthToken();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const item of pending) {[39m
[31m+     // A recovery marker is only evidence that the process died mid-flow.[39m
[31m+     // Telegram INDEX is authoritative: if the beat is already present there,[39m
[31m+     // the upload was durable and MUST NOT be rolled back. Clear only the stale[39m
[31m+     // local marker and keep the beat/media intact.[39m
[31m+     if (authoritativeBeatIds?.has(item.beatId)) {[39m
[31m+       console.info(`[upload-recovery] marker cleared for durable beat ${item.beatId}`);[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // If we could not verify the authoritative INDEX, fail closed: keep the[39m
[31m+     // marker for a later launch instead of guessing and deleting anything.[39m
[31m+     if (authoritativeBeatIds === null) {[39m
[31m+       remaining.push(item);[39m
[31m+       continue;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const response = await fetch(`${base}/beats/delete-topic`, {[39m
[31m+         method: "POST",[39m
[31m+         headers: {[39m
[31m+           "Content-Type": "application/json",[39m
[31m+           ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         body: JSON.stringify({ beatgalerUserId, beatId: item.beatId }),[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       if (!response.ok) {[39m
[31m+         const text = await response.text().catch(() => "");[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(text || `HTTP ${response.status}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await purgeInterruptedUploadLocal(item.beatId, item.stagingPaths);[39m
[31m+       rolledBack.push(item.beatName);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn(`Could not roll back interrupted upload ${item.beatName}:`, error);[39m
[31m+       remaining.push(item);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   writeActiveCloudUploads(remaining);[39m
[31m+   return rolledBack;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function loadCachedBeats(): Beat[] | null {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const raw = localStorage.getItem(LIBRARY_CACHE_KEY);[39m
[31m+     if (!raw) {[39m
[31m+       playTrace("LIBRARY_CACHE_READ", { library_cache: "miss", ...startupCacheContext("miss") });[39m
[31m+       return null;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);[39m
[31m+     playTrace("LIBRARY_CACHE_READ", {[39m
[31m+       library_cache: Array.isArray(parsed) ? "hit" : "invalid",[39m
[31m+       ...startupCacheContext(Array.isArray(parsed) ? "hit" : "invalid"),[39m
[31m+       cached_card_count: Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.length : 0,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : null;[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     playTrace("LIBRARY_CACHE_READ", { library_cache: "unavailable_or_invalid", ...startupCacheContext("unavailable_or_invalid") });[39m
[31m+     return null;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function saveCachedBeats(beats: Beat[]) {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     // Never serialize full-resolution artwork into localStorage on every edit.[39m
[31m+     // The cache only exists for instant paint; SQLite/Telegram remain source of truth.[39m
[31m+     const lightweight = beats.map(beat => ({[39m
[31m+       ...beat,[39m
[31m+       image_base64: null,[39m
[31m+       // Artwork bytes live in Cache Storage as bounded thumbnails; keep the manifest metadata-only.[39m
[31m+       image_preview_base64: null,[39m
[31m+       other_files: [],[39m
[31m+     }));[39m
[31m+     localStorage.setItem(LIBRARY_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(lightweight));[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     // quota or disabled — ignore[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function cloudBeatFingerprint(beat: Beat): string {[39m
[31m+   // IMPORTANT: image_base64/image_preview_base64 are presentation/cache state.[39m
[31m+   // Cloud artwork is tracked durably in Rust cloud_metadata. Including decoded[39m
[31m+   // image bytes here made startup artwork hydration look like nine independent[39m
[31m+   // metadata edits, causing an INDEX rewrite storm and Telegram 429s.[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     beat.id,[39m
[31m+     beat.name,[39m
[31m+     String(beat.bpm ?? ""),[39m
[31m+     beat.key ?? "",[39m
[31m+     beat.tags.join("\u001f"),[39m
[31m+     String(beat.rating ?? 0),[39m
[31m+     beat.color ?? "",[39m
[31m+     beat.color2 ?? "",[39m
[31m+     beat.telegram_file_id ?? "",[39m
[31m+     String(beat.telegram_message_id ?? ""),[39m
[31m+   ].join("\u001e");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function drawerMetadataCommitFingerprint(beat: Beat): string {[39m
[31m+   const artwork = beat.image_base64 ?? "";[39m
[31m+   const artworkMark = artwork[39m
[31m+     ? `${artwork.length}:${artwork.slice(0, 32)}:${artwork.slice(-32)}`[39m
[31m+     : "";[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     cloudBeatFingerprint(beat),[39m
[31m+     artworkMark,[39m
[31m+     JSON.stringify(beat.image_crop ?? null),[39m
[31m+   ].join("\u001d");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function libraryViewFingerprint(beats: Beat[]): string {[39m
[31m+   return beats.map(beat => [[39m
[31m+     beat.id,[39m
[31m+     beat.name,[39m
[31m+     beat.cloud_status ?? "",[39m
[31m+     beat.telegram_file_id ?? "",[39m
[31m+     String(beat.telegram_message_id ?? ""),[39m
[31m+     String(beat.bpm ?? ""),[39m
[31m+     beat.key ?? "",[39m
[31m+     beat.tags.join("\u001f"),[39m
[31m+     String(beat.rating ?? 0),[39m
[31m+   ].join("\u001d")).join("\u001c");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function loadCachedSort(): SortKey {[39m
[31m+   try {[39m
[31m+     const raw = localStorage.getItem(SORT_CACHE_KEY);[39m
[31m+     return raw === "name" || raw === "bpm" || raw === "rating" || raw === "manual" ? raw : "rating";[39m
[31m+   } catch {[39m
[31m+     return "rating";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function saveCachedSort(sortBy: SortKey) {[39m
[31m+   try { localStorage.setItem(SORT_CACHE_KEY, sortBy); } catch { /* quota or disabled — ignore */ }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function preserveLoadedArtwork(incoming: Beat[], current: Beat[]): Beat[] {[39m
[31m+   const previous = new Map(current.map(beat => [beat.id, beat]));[39m
[31m+   return incoming.map(beat => {[39m
[31m+     const old = previous.get(beat.id);[39m
[31m+     if (!old) return beat;[39m
[31m+     if (beat.image_base64 || beat.image_preview_base64) return beat;[39m
[31m+     const artwork = old.image_preview_base64 || old.image_base64;[39m
[31m+     return artwork[39m
[31m+       ? { ...beat, image_base64: old.image_base64 ?? null, image_preview_base64: old.image_preview_base64 ?? null }[39m
[31m+       : beat;[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // Clear upload preview cache when library reload is requested via UI reload button[39m
[31m+ // (This keeps reload button behavior explicit: refresh disk scan + clear derived previews)[39m
[31m+ export function clearUploadPreviewCache() {[39m
[31m+   try { localStorage.removeItem('beatvault:upload-cache:v1'); } catch {}[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function decodeArtworkDataUrl(src: string): Promise<boolean> {[39m
[31m+   return new Promise(resolve => {[39m
[31m+     const image = new Image();[39m
[31m+     let settled = false;[39m
[31m+     const done = (ok: boolean) => {[39m
[31m+       if (settled) return;[39m
[31m+       settled = true;[39m
[31m+       resolve(ok);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     image.onload = () => done(true);[39m
[31m+     image.onerror = () => done(false);[39m
[31m+     image.src = src;[39m
[31m+     if (typeof image.decode === "function") {[39m
[31m+       void image.decode().then(() => done(true)).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     window.setTimeout(() => done(false), 2500);[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function BeatGalerApp() {[39m
[31m+   // Browser/localStorage library data is an instant-paint presentation cache.[39m
[31m+   // It may render before cloud authority resolves, but remains read-only until[39m
[31m+   // verification and is never allowed to overwrite the authoritative library.[39m
[31m+   const startupCachedBeatsRef = useRef<Beat[] | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   if (startupCachedBeatsRef.current === null) {[39m
[31m+     const cached = loadCachedBeats() ?? [];[39m
[31m+     const interruptedIds = new Set(readActiveCloudUploads().map(item => item.beatId));[39m
[31m+     startupCachedBeatsRef.current = interruptedIds.size > 0[39m
[31m+       ? cached.filter(beat => !interruptedIds.has(beat.id))[39m
[31m+       : cached;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const [beats, setBeats] = useState<Beat[]>(() => startupCachedBeatsRef.current ?? []);[39m
[31m+   const [openableCloudProjectIds, setOpenableCloudProjectIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());[39m
[31m+   const cloudMetaSnapshotRef = useRef<Map<string, string> | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const cloudMetaTimersRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());[39m
[31m+   const cloudLibraryTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const cloudLibrarySnapshotRef = useRef<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const drawerMetadataCommitVerifiedRef = useRef<Map<string, string>>(new Map());[39m
[31m+   const drawerMetadataCommitInFlightRef = useRef<Map<string, { fingerprint: string; promise: Promise<void> }>>(new Map());[39m
[31m+   const cacheSaveTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const visibleLibraryFingerprintRef = useRef<string>("");[39m
[31m+   const autoCloudUploadRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());[39m
[31m+   const backgroundUploadQueueRef = useRef<Beat[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   // Always holds the newest library snapshot for immediate cloud-index writes.[39m
[31m+   const beatsLatestRef = useRef<Beat[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   // Definitive per-beat operation model. These states are intentionally session-local:[39m
[31m+   // unfinished upload/download/playback work never resurrects after an app restart.[39m
[31m+   // Stable Offline availability is re-hydrated from native durable BeatMeta instead.[39m
[31m+   const [beatRuntimeStates, setBeatRuntimeStates] = useState<Record<string, BeatRuntimeState>>({});[39m
[31m+   const beatRuntimeStatesRef = useRef<Record<string, BeatRuntimeState>>({});[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => { beatRuntimeStatesRef.current = beatRuntimeStates; }, [beatRuntimeStates]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const transitionRuntime = useCallback((beatId: string, event: BeatRuntimeEvent, beatHint?: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     setBeatRuntimeStates(current => {[39m
[31m+       const beat = beatHint ?? beatsLatestRef.current.find(item => item.id === beatId);[39m
[31m+       const base = current[beatId] ?? createBeatRuntimeState(beat);[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const nextState = transitionBeatRuntimeState(base, event);[39m
[31m+         if (nextState === base) return current;[39m
[31m+         return { ...current, [beatId]: nextState };[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         // A rejected transition is a programming bug, not a user-facing failure.[39m
[31m+         // Keep the last valid state so races cannot corrupt the machine.[39m
[31m+         console.warn(`Beat runtime transition rejected for ${beatId}:`, event.type, error);[39m
[31m+         return current;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const forgetRuntimeState = useCallback((beatId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     setBeatRuntimeStates(current => {[39m
[31m+       if (!(beatId in current)) return current;[39m
[31m+       const next = { ...current };[39m
[31m+       delete next[beatId];[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const clearReconciledTrashRuntimeStates = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     const visibleIds = new Set(beatsLatestRef.current.map(beat => beat.id));[39m
[31m+     setBeatRuntimeStates(current => {[39m
[31m+       let changed = false;[39m
[31m+       const next = { ...current };[39m
[31m+       for (const [id, runtime] of Object.entries(current)) {[39m
[31m+         if (!visibleIds.has(id) && runtime.trash_sync_required) {[39m
[31m+           delete next[id];[39m
[31m+           changed = true;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return changed ? next : current;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     // Library reloads/Telegram refreshes must not overwrite transient machines,[39m
[31m+     // but the durable Offline bit always comes from the native source of truth.[39m
[31m+     setBeatRuntimeStates(current => {[39m
[31m+       const next: Record<string, BeatRuntimeState> = {};[39m
[31m+       let changed = false;[39m
[31m+       for (const beat of beats) {[39m
[31m+         const hydrated = hydrateBeatRuntimeState(current[beat.id], beat);[39m
[31m+         next[beat.id] = hydrated;[39m
[31m+         if (hydrated !== current[beat.id]) changed = true;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       // A deleting beat leaves the visible library before its cloud-index commit[39m
[31m+       // finishes. Keep that transient state (and the Offline Trash intent bit)[39m
[31m+       // until the responsible operation explicitly clears it.[39m
[31m+       for (const [id, runtime] of Object.entries(current)) {[39m
[31m+         if (next[id]) continue;[39m
[31m+         if (runtime.sync_state === "deleting" || runtime.trash_sync_required) next[id] = runtime;[39m
[31m+         else changed = true;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return changed ? next : current;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, [beats]);[39m
[31m+   const backgroundUploadRunningRef = useRef(false);[39m
[31m+   // A manual Reload pressed during an import must never overwrite the optimistic[39m
[31m+   // in-flight rows with the older committed Telegram INDEX. Queue the reload and[39m
[31m+   // execute it after the batch commits instead.[39m
[31m+   const deferredLibraryReloadRef = useRef(false);[39m
[31m+   const uploadCompleteTimersRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());[39m
[31m+   const cloudPullInFlightRef = useRef(false);[39m
[31m+   const stagedImportPathsRef = useRef<Map<string, string[]>>(new Map());[39m
[31m+   const [backgroundUploadErrors, setBackgroundUploadErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});[39m

[31m+           setSettings(current => current ? { ...current, telegram_cloud_connected: true, telegram_cloud_username: status.username } : current);[39m
[31m+           await applyRemoteLibraryChange();[39m
[31m+           if (!cancelled) setCloudSessionVerified(true);[39m
[31m+         } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+           console.warn("Could not activate Telegram vault:", error);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       })();[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const connectEvents = async () => {[39m
[31m+       const token = getBeatGalerAuthToken();[39m
[31m+       if (!token) return;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const response = await fetch(`${cloudBase}/events/ticket`, {[39m
[31m+           method: "POST",[39m
[31m+           headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },[39m
[31m+           body: JSON.stringify({ beatgalerUserId: userId }),[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Event authorization failed (${response.status}).`);[39m
[31m+         const body = await response.json();[39m
[31m+         if (cancelled || !body?.ticket) return;[39m
[31m+         const url =[39m
[31m+           `${cloudBase}/events?beatgalerUserId=${encodeURIComponent(userId)}` +[39m
[31m+           `&sourceId=${encodeURIComponent(sourceId)}` +[39m
[31m+           `&ticket=${encodeURIComponent(String(body.ticket))}`;[39m
[31m+         events = new EventSource(url);[39m
[31m+         events.onopen = () => { eventReconnectDelayMs = 1000; };[39m
[31m+         events.addEventListener("ready", onReady);[39m
[31m+         events.addEventListener("library_changed", onLibraryChanged);[39m
[31m+         events.addEventListener("telegram_connected", onTelegramConnected);[39m
[31m+         events.onerror = () => {[39m
[31m+           // Event tickets are intentionally single-use. EventSource's built-in[39m
[31m+           // reconnect would reuse the consumed ticket and receive 401 forever,[39m
[31m+           // so close it and obtain a fresh ticket instead. SSE is only the push[39m
[31m+           // notification channel; its failure is not evidence that Telegram or[39m
[31m+           // the Cloud data plane is unreachable.[39m
[31m+           events?.close();[39m
[31m+           events = null;[39m
[31m+           if (cancelled || eventReconnectTimer !== null) return;[39m
[31m+           const delay = eventReconnectDelayMs;[39m
[31m+           eventReconnectDelayMs = Math.min(eventReconnectDelayMs * 2, 30000);[39m
[31m+           eventReconnectTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+             eventReconnectTimer = null;[39m
[31m+             void connectEvents();[39m
[31m+           }, delay);[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.warn("BeatGaler event authorization failed:", error);[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled && eventReconnectTimer === null) {[39m
[31m+           const delay = eventReconnectDelayMs;[39m
[31m+           eventReconnectDelayMs = Math.min(eventReconnectDelayMs * 2, 30000);[39m
[31m+           eventReconnectTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+             eventReconnectTimer = null;[39m
[31m+             void connectEvents();[39m
[31m+           }, delay);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void connectEvents();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+       if (eventReconnectTimer !== null) window.clearTimeout(eventReconnectTimer);[39m
[31m+       events?.removeEventListener("ready", onReady);[39m
[31m+       events?.removeEventListener("library_changed", onLibraryChanged);[39m
[31m+       events?.removeEventListener("telegram_connected", onTelegramConnected);[39m
[31m+       events?.close();[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [setupDone, settings?.beatgaler_user_id]);[39m

[31m+   const waitForCookingReady = useCallback(async (beat: Beat, timeoutMs = 12000): Promise<boolean> => {[39m
[31m+     if (beat.offline_available || !beat.telegram_file_id) return true;[39m
[31m+     const started = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     while (performance.now() - started < timeoutMs) {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const status = await getDownloadCookingStatus();[39m
[31m+         const entry = status.entries.find(item => item.beat_id === beat.id);[39m
[31m+         const urlReady = cookingPlaybackUrlRef.current.get(beat.id)?.telegramFileId === beat.telegram_file_id;[39m
[31m+         if (entry && !entry.failed && urlReady && (entry.complete || entry.downloaded_bytes >= status.ready_bytes)) return true;[39m
[31m+         if (entry?.failed) return false;[39m
[31m+       } catch {}[39m
[31m+       await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 90));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m

[31m+   const waitForUploadedBeatPlaybackReady = useCallback(async (beat: Beat, timeoutMs = 15000): Promise<boolean> => {[39m
[31m+     if (!beat.telegram_file_id) return false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const started = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent("UPLOAD_PLAYBACK_GATE_BEGIN", beat.id, beat.name, "").catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     while (performance.now() - started < timeoutMs) {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         // Re-issue WARM explicitly on every retry. A newly-uploaded Telegram[39m
[31m+         // document can be briefly unavailable to the download endpoint even[39m
[31m+         // though sendDocument already returned its file_id. Rust revives a[39m
[31m+         // previously failed cooker entry when this explicit warm is requested.[39m
[31m+         const prewarmUrl = await warmBeatForPlayback(beat);[39m
[31m+         if (prewarmUrl) {[39m
[31m+           const url = prewarmUrl.replace(/[?&]prewarm=1(?:&|$)/, "").replace(/[?&]$/, "");[39m
[31m+           cookingPlaybackUrlRef.current.set(beat.id, { telegramFileId: beat.telegram_file_id, url });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (await waitForCookingReady(beat, 1400)) {[39m
[31m+           void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent([39m
[31m+             "UPLOAD_PLAYBACK_GATE_READY",[39m
[31m+             beat.id,[39m
[31m+             beat.name,[39m
[31m+             `wait_ms=${(performance.now() - started).toFixed(1)}`[39m
[31m+           ).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+           return true;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.debug(`Post-upload playback warm retry for ${beat.name}:`, error);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 180));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent([39m
[31m+       "UPLOAD_PLAYBACK_GATE_TIMEOUT",[39m
[31m+       beat.id,[39m
[31m+       beat.name,[39m
[31m+       `wait_ms=${(performance.now() - started).toFixed(1)}`[39m
[31m+     ).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }, [waitForCookingReady]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleWarm = useCallback((beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     // Cached cards can be visible before the authoritative INDEX is restored.[39m
[31m+     // Do not let viewport-driven audio range downloads compete with that INDEX[39m
[31m+     // read (or lazy artwork) on the single Direct transport session.[39m
[31m+     if (!platform.capabilities.playbackCache || !cloudSessionVerified || connectionState !== "online") return;[39m
[31m+     void ensureWarmPlaybackUrl(beat);[39m
[31m+   }, [cloudSessionVerified, connectionState, ensureWarmPlaybackUrl]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handlePlay = useCallback(async (beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     // Never let a stale card/queue callback bypass the upload readiness gate.[39m
[31m+     // Read the latest Beat object because upload state can change after the[39m
[31m+     // caller captured its render-time object.[39m
[31m+     const latestBeat = beatsLatestRef.current.find(item => item.id === beat.id) ?? beat;[39m
[31m+     playTrace("APP_HANDLE_PLAY_ENTER", {[39m
[31m+       beat_id: beat.id,[39m
[31m+       render_status: beat.cloud_status || null,[39m
[31m+       latest_status: latestBeat.cloud_status || null,[39m
[31m+       slot_busy: beatCloudUpdateBusyIds.has(beat.id),[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (beatCloudUpdateBusyIds.has(beat.id) || isBeatPlaybackBlocked(beat) || isBeatPlaybackBlocked(latestBeat)) {[39m
[31m+       const blocked = isBeatPlaybackBlocked(latestBeat) ? latestBeat : beat;[39m
[31m+       const reason = beatCloudUpdateBusyIds.has(beat.id) ? "SLOT_UPDATE" : String(blocked.cloud_status || "");[39m
[31m+       playTrace("APP_HANDLE_PLAY_BLOCKED", { beat_id: blocked.id, reason });[39m
[31m+       void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent("PLAY_BLOCKED_LOADING", blocked.id, blocked.name, reason).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     beat = latestBeat;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Web playback uses the browser MTProto streaming adapter.[39m
[31m+     // Never fall through to the native Tauri playback/cache path.[39m
[31m+     if (!isTauriAvailable) {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         if (audio.playingId && audio.playingId !== beat.id) {[39m
[31m+           platform.media.releasePlayback(audio.playingId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         playTrace("APP_PREPARE_BEGIN", { beat_id: beat.id });[39m
[31m+         const prepared = await platform.media.preparePlayback(beat);[39m
[31m+         playTrace("APP_PREPARE_READY", { beat_id: beat.id, url_scheme: String(prepared.url || "").split(":")[0] || null });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         void prepared.completed.catch(error => {[39m
[31m+           console.warn(`[web/playback] stream failed beat_id=${beat.id}`, error);[39m
[31m+           platform.media.releasePlayback(beat.id);[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         playTrace("APP_AUDIO_PLAY_CALL", { beat_id: beat.id });[39m
[31m+         play(beat.id, [prepared.url]);[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         playTrace("APP_PREPARE_ERROR", { beat_id: beat.id, error_name: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown" });[39m
[31m+         platform.media.releasePlayback(beat.id);[39m
[31m+         await appAlert({[39m
[31m+           title: "Beat unavailable",[39m
[31m+           message: sanitizeUserVisibleText([39m
[31m+             error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),[39m
[31m+             "Cloud audio unavailable."[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+           danger: true,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const runtime = beatRuntimeStatesRef.current[beat.id] ?? createBeatRuntimeState(beat);[39m
[31m+     // Sync and playback are independent state machines. In V7 a beat can stay in[39m
[31m+     // sync_state=uploading until the ONE final batch INDEX commit even though its[39m
[31m+     // MASTER is already durable and Download Cooking has made it playable. Do not[39m
[31m+     // hold an already-ready beat hostage to the rest of the batch. cloud_status[39m
[31m+     // (UPLOADING / PLAYBACK_PREPARING) remains the authoritative readiness gate.[39m
[31m+     const syncStillBlocksPlayback =[39m
[31m+       runtime.sync_state === "pending_upload" ||[39m
[31m+       runtime.sync_state === "deleting" ||[39m
[31m+       (runtime.sync_state === "uploading" && !beat.telegram_file_id);[39m
[31m+     if (syncStillBlocksPlayback || runtime.playback_state === "playback_preparing") {[39m
[31m+       void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent([39m
[31m+         "PLAY_BLOCKED_RUNTIME_STATE",[39m
[31m+         beat.id,[39m
[31m+         beat.name,[39m
[31m+         `${runtime.sync_state}/${runtime.playback_state}/master=${beat.telegram_file_id ? 1 : 0}`[39m
[31m+       ).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const startingPlaybackSession = audio.playingId !== beat.id || runtime.playback_state === "idle" || runtime.playback_state === "error";[39m
[31m+     if (startingPlaybackSession) {[39m
[31m+       if (audio.playingId && audio.playingId !== beat.id) transitionRuntime(audio.playingId, { type: "PLAYBACK_IDLE" });[39m
[31m+       transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "PLAYBACK_PREPARING" }, beat);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const clickedAt = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent("PLAY_CLICK", beat.id, beat.name, "").catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // FAST PATH: a visible Cloud beat already has a localhost playback URL.[39m
[31m+     // Set audio.src immediately. The localhost request itself promotes the beat[39m
[31m+     // to HOT inside Rust, so no invoke/filesystem/network work is needed first.[39m
[31m+     if (beat.telegram_file_id) {[39m
[31m+       const cooked = cookingPlaybackUrlRef.current.get(beat.id);[39m
[31m+       if (cooked && cooked.telegramFileId === beat.telegram_file_id) {[39m
[31m+         void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent("PLAY_FAST_PATH", beat.id, beat.name, `prepare_ms=${(performance.now() - clickedAt).toFixed(1)}`).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+         play(beat.id, [cooked.url]);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Fallback for a beat that was clicked before it ever became WARM, or for[39m
[31m+     // local/pre-cloud audio. This path preserves the existing safety behavior.[39m
[31m+     const playbackNeedsCloudDownload = Boolean(beat.telegram_file_id && !beat.offline_available);[39m
[31m+     let playbackOwnsDownloadState = false;[39m
[31m+     if (playbackNeedsCloudDownload) {[39m
[31m+       const downloadRuntime = beatRuntimeStatesRef.current[beat.id] ?? createBeatRuntimeState(beat);[39m
[31m+       if (downloadRuntime.download_state !== "downloading") {[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "DOWNLOAD_STARTED" }, beat);[39m
[31m+         playbackOwnsDownloadState = true;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const ready = await prepareBeatForPlayback(beat);[39m
[31m+       void downloadCookingDiagnosticEvent("PLAY_PREPARED", beat.id, beat.name, `prepare_ms=${(performance.now() - clickedAt).toFixed(1)}`).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+       if (ready.telegram_file_id && ready.playback_path) {[39m
[31m+         cookingPlaybackUrlRef.current.set(ready.id, { telegramFileId: ready.telegram_file_id, url: ready.playback_path });[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       // `ready.playback_path` may point at BeatGaler's private cloud cache. Do[39m
[31m+       // not copy that transient path into the library state/localStorage.[39m
[31m+       if (ready.cloud_status !== beat.cloud_status) {[39m
[31m+         setBeats(bs => bs.map(b => b.id === ready.id ? { ...b, cloud_status: ready.cloud_status } : b));[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       // Once a Cloud MASTER exists, it is the ONLY playback source. Do not[39m
[31m+       // silently fall back to an old local MP3/WAV if the cloud file is missing.[39m
[31m+       const playbackSources = ready.telegram_file_id[39m
[31m+         ? [ready.playback_path][39m
[31m+         : [ready.playback_path, ready.mp3_path, ready.wav_path ?? ""];[39m
[31m+       if (playbackOwnsDownloadState) {[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "DOWNLOAD_SUCCEEDED" }, ready);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       play(ready.id, playbackSources);[39m
[31m+     } catch (e: any) {[39m
[31m+       const message = sanitizeUserVisibleText(String(e?.message || e), "Cloud audio unavailable.");[39m
[31m+       if (playbackOwnsDownloadState) {[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "DOWNLOAD_FAILED", code: "PLAYBACK_DOWNLOAD_FAILED", message, retryable: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (startingPlaybackSession) {[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "PLAYBACK_FAILED", code: "PLAYBACK_PREPARE_FAILED", message, retryable: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       await appAlert({[39m
[31m+         title: "Beat unavailable",[39m
[31m+         message,[39m
[31m+         danger: true,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [audio.playingId, play, transitionRuntime]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleUpload = useCallback((beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Uploading to YouTube")) return;[39m
[31m+     setShowUpload({ initialBeat: beat, selectedIds: undefined });[39m
[31m+   }, [rejectOfflineMutation]);[39m

[31m+         danger: true,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+       await appAlert({[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleUploadBulk = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Bulk upload")) return;[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleEditBulk = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Editing metadata")) return;[39m
[31m+     const firstSelected = beats.find(b => selectedIds.has(b.id));[39m
[31m+     if (firstSelected) setDrawer({ beat: firstSelected, mode: "edit" });[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleRemoveBulk = useCallback(async () => {[39m
[31m+     const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);[39m
[31m+     if (ids.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const approved = await appConfirm({[39m
[31m+       title: `Remove ${ids.length} beat${ids.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}?`,[39m
[31m+       message: "Remove the selected beats from BeatGaler? Cloud-backed files remain stored; local-only files are moved to BeatGaler trash.",[39m
[31m+       confirmLabel: ids.length === 1 ? "Remove beat" : "Remove beats",[39m
[31m+       cancelLabel: "Cancel",[39m
[31m+       danger: true,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     if (!approved) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const deleted = new Set<string>();[39m
[31m+     for (const id of ids) {[39m
[31m+       if (deleteInFlightRef.current.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+       deleteInFlightRef.current.add(id);[39m
[31m+       const beat = beats.find(item => item.id === id);[39m
[31m+       if (beat?.telegram_file_id) {[39m
[31m+         if (connectionState === "online") transitionRuntime(id, { type: "SYNC_DELETE_STARTED" }, beat);[39m
[31m+         else transitionRuntime(id, { type: "SET_TRASH_SYNC_REQUIRED", required: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         await removeBeatFromLibrary(id);[39m
[31m+         deleted.add(id);[39m
[31m+       } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+         console.error(err);[39m
[31m+         const runtime = beatRuntimeStatesRef.current[id];[39m
[31m+         if (runtime?.sync_state === "deleting") {[39m
[31m+           transitionRuntime(id, { type: "SYNC_FAILED", code: "DELETE_FAILED", message: sanitizeUserVisibleText(runtimeErrorMessage(err), "Cloud operation failed."), retryable: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } finally {[39m
[31m+         deleteInFlightRef.current.delete(id);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (deleted.size > 0) {[39m
[31m+       const next = beats.filter(b => !deleted.has(b.id));[39m
[31m+       setBeats(next);[39m
[31m+       setQueueIds(q => q.filter(id => !deleted.has(id)));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Offline Trash is a reversible local state, not a stale whole-index write.[39m
[31m+       // On reconnect the server will move the CURRENT online beat objects by id.[39m
[31m+       if (connectionState !== "online") {[39m
[31m+         const deletedCloudIds = beats[39m
[31m+           .filter(beat => deleted.has(beat.id) && !!beat.telegram_file_id)[39m
[31m+           .map(beat => beat.id);[39m
[31m+         const intentResults = await Promise.allSettled(deletedCloudIds.map(id => recordOfflineTrashIntent(id)));[39m
[31m+         const failedIntentCount = intentResults.filter(result => result.status === "rejected").length;[39m
[31m+         if (failedIntentCount > 0) {[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({[39m
[31m+             title: "Some Trash changes are local only",[39m
[31m+             message: `${failedIntentCount} beat${failedIntentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} could not be queued for reconnect. Restore those beats before closing BeatGaler, or reconnect and remove them again.`,[39m
[31m+             danger: true,[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         const cloudBacked = next.filter(beat => !!beat.telegram_file_id);[39m
[31m+         cloudLibrarySnapshotRef.current = cloudBacked.map(cloudBeatFingerprint).join("\u001c");[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           await libraryStateManager.commitSnapshot(next, "bulk-remove");[39m
[31m+           for (const id of deleted) forgetRuntimeState(id);[39m
[31m+         } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+           console.warn("Telegram library index refresh after Remove all failed:", error);[39m
[31m+           const message = sanitizeUserVisibleText(runtimeErrorMessage(error), "Cloud operation failed.");[39m
[31m+           for (const id of deleted) {[39m
[31m+             const runtime = beatRuntimeStatesRef.current[id];[39m
[31m+             if (runtime?.sync_state === "deleting") {[39m
[31m+               transitionRuntime(id, { type: "SYNC_FAILED", code: "DELETE_INDEX_SYNC_FAILED", message, retryable: true });[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (deleted.size !== ids.length) {[39m
[31m+       await appAlert({[39m
[31m+         title: "Some beats were not removed",[39m
[31m+         message: "One or more selected beats could not be removed from the library.",[39m
[31m+         danger: true,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     setSelectedIds(new Set());[39m
[31m+     setSelectMode(false);[39m
[31m+     setAnchorIdx(null);[39m
[31m+   }, [selectedIds, beats, connectionState, forgetRuntimeState, transitionRuntime]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const addToQueue = useCallback((beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     setQueueIds((ids) => (ids.includes(beat.id) ? ids : [...ids, beat.id]));[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const addBeats = useCallback((newBeats: Beat[]) => {[39m
[31m+     setBeats(bs => {[39m
[31m+       const existing = new Set(bs.map(b => b.mp3_path));[39m
[31m+       const next = [...newBeats.filter(b => !existing.has(b.mp3_path)), ...bs];[39m
[31m+       beatsLatestRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const waitForCloudSessionWithBackoff = useCallback(async () => {[39m
[31m+     const delays = [0, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 30000, 60000];[39m
[31m+     let lastError: unknown = null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const delay of delays) {[39m
