[31m+               setBackgroundUploadErrors(current => ({ ...current, [original.id]: detail }));[39m
[31m+               setBeats(current => current.map(b =>[39m
[31m+                 b.id === original.id[39m
[31m+                   ? {[39m
[31m+                       ...b,[39m
[31m+                       // If Telegram already has every required slot, expose the[39m
[31m+                       // durable cloud state even when local cleanup/finalization failed.[39m
[31m+                       cloud_status: remoteUploadCompleted ? "CLOUD_ONLY" : "ERROR",[39m
[31m+                     }[39m
[31m+                   : b[39m
[31m+               ));[39m
[31m+             } finally {[39m
[31m+               autoCloudUploadRef.current.delete(original.id);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Yield between beats so React/WebView always gets a render opportunity.[39m
[31m+             await new Promise<void>(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0));[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         } finally {[39m
[31m+           backgroundUploadRunningRef.current = false;[39m
[31m+           if (deferredLibraryReloadRef.current) {[39m
[31m+             deferredLibraryReloadRef.current = false;[39m
[31m+             window.dispatchEvent(new Event("beatgaler:deferred-library-reload"));[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       })();[39m
[31m+     }, 0);[39m
[31m+   }, [transitionRuntime, waitForUploadedBeatPlaybackReady, waitForCloudSessionWithBackoff]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const retryBackgroundUpload = useCallback((beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Retrying an upload")) return;[39m
[31m+     setBackgroundUploadErrors(current => {[39m
[31m+       if (!(beat.id in current)) return current;[39m
[31m+       const next = { ...current };[39m
[31m+       delete next[beat.id];[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     // cloudifyImportedBeats is checkpoint-aware: an existing MASTER/WAV/PROJECT[39m
[31m+     // is detected in Telegram and skipped, so retry resumes at the first missing[39m
[31m+     // stage instead of uploading the whole beat again.[39m
[31m+     cloudifyImportedBeats([{ ...beat, cloud_status: "UPLOADING" }]);[39m
[31m+   }, [cloudifyImportedBeats, rejectOfflineMutation]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const addBeatsAndReview = useCallback((newBeats: Beat[]) => {[39m
[31m+     if (newBeats.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     if (connectionState !== "online") {[39m
[31m+       void appAlert({[39m
[31m+         title: "Internet connection required",[39m
[31m+         message: "BeatGaler does not import new beats while offline. Reconnect and import them again.",[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       void cleanupOrphanedDropStaging(beatsLatestRef.current);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const sanitized = newBeats.map(beat => ({ ...beat, tags: cleanTags(beat.tags || []).tags }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Review candidates are NOT library beats yet.[39m
[31m+     // Keeping them out of `beats` means:[39m
[31m+     // 1) Cancel leaves absolutely nothing behind.[39m
[31m+     // 2) duplicate-name checks compare only against committed library items.[39m
[31m+     // 3) a re-dropped folder can never masquerade as an edit of the existing beat.[39m
[31m+     setShowAdd(false);[39m
[31m+     setReviewQueue({ beats: sanitized, index: 0, total: sanitized.length, batchId: null, preparing: false });[39m
[31m+     // Upload begins only after Review → Save.[39m
[31m+   }, [connectionState]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const skipCurrentReviewBeat = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     setReviewQueue(q => {[39m
[31m+       if (!q) return null;[39m
[31m+       const currentBeat = q.beats[q.index];[39m
[31m+       const sourceKey = currentBeat ? reviewSourceKey(currentBeat) : "";[39m
[31m+       if (sourceKey) skippedReviewSourceKeysRef.current.add(sourceKey);[39m
[31m+       if (platform.capabilities.reviewBeatCloudCommit && currentBeat) platform.importer.releaseBeat(currentBeat.id);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const knownLast = q.total !== null && q.index >= q.total - 1;[39m
[31m+       if (knownLast && !q.preparing) {[39m
[31m+         // Skip means ONLY this beat. The global Cancel Import action is separate.[39m
[31m+         window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+           void cleanupOrphanedDropStaging([[39m
[31m+             ...beatsLatestRef.current,[39m
[31m+             ...backgroundUploadQueueRef.current,[39m
[31m+           ]);[39m
[31m+         }, 0);[39m
[31m+         return null;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       // If discovery is still running, advance into a skeleton for Beat N+1.[39m
[31m+       // The streaming worker will fill that exact slot as soon as it finds it.[39m
[31m+       return { ...q, index: q.index + 1 };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const skipAllReviewQueue = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     importReviewRequestRunRef.current += 1;[39m
[31m+     reviewPreparationRunRef.current += 1;[39m
[31m+     reviewPreparationPromiseRef.current = null;[39m
[31m+     skippedReviewSourceKeysRef.current.clear();[39m
[31m+     setReviewPreparationDone(true);[39m
[31m+     setReviewBootstrap(null);[39m
[31m+     setAudioConflictBatch(null);[39m
[31m+     setDeferredImportBatch(current => {[39m
[31m+       if (current?.batch_id) void discardImportReviewBatch(current.batch_id);[39m
[31m+       return null;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Cancel means cancel the current review batch, not silently "skip" it.[39m
[31m+     // Beats already saved before the current position stay in the library;[39m
[31m+     // the current + remaining unsaved review candidates are removed.[39m
[31m+     setReviewQueue(q => {[39m
[31m+       if (!q) return null;[39m
[31m+       if (platform.capabilities.reviewBeatCloudCommit) {[39m
[31m+         for (const beat of q.beats.slice(q.index)) platform.importer.releaseBeat(beat.id);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (q.batchId) void discardImportReviewBatch(q.batchId);[39m
[31m+       window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+         const protectedBeats = [[39m
[31m+           ...beatsLatestRef.current,[39m
[31m+           ...backgroundUploadQueueRef.current,[39m
[31m+         ];[39m
[31m+         void cleanupOrphanedDropStaging(protectedBeats);[39m
[31m+       }, 0);[39m
[31m+       return null;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleReviewedBeatSaved = useCallback((updated: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     setBeats(bs => {[39m
[31m+       const exists = bs.some(b => b.id === updated.id);[39m
[31m+       const next = exists[39m
[31m+         ? bs.map(b => b.id === updated.id ? updated : b)[39m
[31m+         : [updated, ...bs];[39m
[31m+       beatsLatestRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     setReviewQueue(q => {[39m
[31m+       if (!q) return null;[39m
[31m+       const nextBeats = q.beats.map(b => b.id === updated.id ? updated : b);[39m
[31m+       const knownLast = q.total !== null && q.index >= q.total - 1;[39m
[31m+       if (knownLast && !q.preparing) return null;[39m
[31m+       return { ...q, beats: nextBeats, index: q.index + 1 };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Fire-and-forget. Save/next closes immediately; Telegram work is secondary.[39m
[31m+     cloudifyImportedBeats([updated]);[39m
[31m+   }, [cloudifyImportedBeats]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handleReviewedSaveAll = useCallback(async (currentUpdated: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     const queue = reviewQueueLatestRef.current;[39m
[31m+     if (!queue) return;[39m
[31m+     const startIndex = queue.index;[39m
[31m+     setBulkSaveAllBusy(true);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Save All is a UX command, not a request to wait for Review preparation.[39m
[31m+     // Close Review immediately, commit the current beat, then let the same[39m
[31m+     // sequential worker finish metadata for the remaining beats in background.[39m
[31m+     setReviewQueue(null);[39m
[31m+     setBeats(current => {[39m
[31m+       const exists = current.some(item => item.id === currentUpdated.id);[39m
[31m+       const next = exists[39m
[31m+         ? current.map(item => item.id === currentUpdated.id ? currentUpdated : item)[39m
[31m+         : [currentUpdated, ...current];[39m
[31m+       beatsLatestRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     cloudifyImportedBeats([currentUpdated]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let allPrepared = queue.beats;[39m
[31m+     if (reviewPreparationPromiseRef.current) {[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         allPrepared = await reviewPreparationPromiseRef.current;[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         // The background preparer already surfaces the real error. Save All[39m
[31m+         // must still keep already-prepared beats usable instead of rejecting[39m
[31m+         // the whole batch promise.[39m
[31m+         console.warn("Save All continued with already-prepared beats:", error);[39m
[31m+         allPrepared = reviewQueueLatestRef.current?.beats ?? queue.beats;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const remaining = allPrepared.slice(startIndex + 1);[39m
[31m+     const committed: Beat[] = [];[39m
[31m+     const nameConflicts: Beat[] = [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const queueIds = new Set(allPrepared.map(item => item.id));[39m
[31m+     const reservedNames = new Set([39m
[31m+       beatsLatestRef.current[39m
[31m+         .filter(item => !queueIds.has(item.id) && item.id !== currentUpdated.id)[39m
[31m+         .map(item => item.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase())[39m
[31m+         .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const currentName = currentUpdated.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();[39m
[31m+     if (currentName) reservedNames.add(currentName);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const beat of remaining) {[39m
[31m+       const nameKey = beat.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();[39m
[31m+       if (nameKey && reservedNames.has(nameKey)) {[39m
[31m+         // Duplicate review candidates are not auto-renamed. They are moved to[39m
[31m+         // the end so Save All remains fast and the user can choose a real name.[39m
[31m+         nameConflicts.push(beat);[39m
[31m+         continue;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (nameKey) reservedNames.add(nameKey);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const bpmCheck = validateBpm(beat.bpm);[39m
[31m+         const keyCheck = validateMusicKey(beat.key);[39m
[31m+         if (bpmCheck.valid === false) throw new Error(`${beat.name}: ${bpmCheck.reason}`);[39m
[31m+         if (keyCheck.valid === false) throw new Error(`${beat.name}: ${keyCheck.reason}`);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const cleaned = cleanTags(beat.tags);[39m
[31m+         const normalized: Beat = {[39m
[31m+           ...beat,[39m
[31m+           tags: cleaned.tags,[39m
[31m+           bpm: bpmCheck.normalized,[39m
[31m+           key: keyCheck.normalized,[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const result = await saveBeatMeta({[39m
[31m+           mp3_path: normalized.mp3_path,[39m
[31m+           wav_path: normalized.wav_path,[39m
[31m+           bpm: normalized.bpm,[39m
[31m+           key: normalized.key,[39m
[31m+           tags: normalized.tags,[39m
[31m+           rating: normalized.rating,[39m
[31m+           image_base64: normalized.image_base64,[39m
[31m+           image_preview_base64: normalized.image_preview_base64 ?? null,[39m
[31m+           image_crop: normalized.image_crop ?? null,[39m
[31m+           update_filename: normalized.bpm !== beat.bpm || normalized.key !== beat.key,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         committed.push({[39m
[31m+           ...normalized,[39m
[31m+           mp3_path: result.new_mp3_path || normalized.mp3_path,[39m
[31m+           wav_path: result.new_wav_path ?? normalized.wav_path,[39m
[31m+           playback_path: result.new_mp3_path || normalized.mp3_path || normalized.playback_path,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.warn(`Save All could not commit ${beat.name}:`, error);[39m
[31m+         nameConflicts.push(beat);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Keep WebView responsive even when hundreds of beats are selected.[39m
[31m+       await new Promise<void>(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (committed.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       const committedIds = new Set(committed.map(beat => beat.id));[39m
[31m+       setBeats(current => {[39m
[31m+         const next = [[39m
[31m+           ...committed,[39m
[31m+           ...current.filter(beat => !committedIds.has(beat.id)),[39m
[31m+         ];[39m
[31m+         beatsLatestRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+         return next;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       cloudifyImportedBeats(committed);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     // Local duplicate/validation conflicts are intentionally last and reopen[39m
[31m+     // Review instead of blocking the whole Save All batch.[39m
[31m+     if (nameConflicts.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       setReviewQueue({ beats: nameConflicts, index: 0, total: nameConflicts.length, batchId: queue.batchId, preparing: false });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     setBulkSaveAllBusy(false);[39m
[31m+   }, [cloudifyImportedBeats]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const importDroppedPaths = useCallback(async (paths: string[]) => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Importing beats")) return;[39m
[31m+     const normalized = Array.from(new Set(paths.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean)));[39m
[31m+     if (normalized.length === 0 || dropImporting) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const dropStarted = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     const diagRun = `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;[39m
[31m+     reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} IMPORT_BEGIN path_count=${normalized.length} names=${normalized.map(fileNameFromPath).slice(0, 12).join("|")}`);[39m
[31m+     const requestRunId = ++importReviewRequestRunRef.current;[39m
[31m+     setDropImporting(true);[39m
[31m+     setReviewPreparationDone(false);[39m
[31m+     setDeferredImportBatch(null);[39m
[31m+     setAudioConflictBatch(null);[39m
[31m+     setDropImportBatch(null);[39m
[31m+     skippedReviewSourceKeysRef.current.clear();[39m
[31m+     if (REVIEW_SKELETON_ENABLED) {[39m
[31m+       setReviewBootstrap({ total: null });[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} SKELETON_STATE_REQUESTED elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)}`);[39m
[31m+       requestAnimationFrame(() => reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} SKELETON_FRAME elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)}`));[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     console.info("[review-perf] DROP_RECEIVED 0 ms");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       // IMPORTANT: this creates only a cursor. It does not recursively scan the[39m
[31m+       // batch, count every beat, or inspect projects. That work is streamed by[39m
[31m+       // prepareNextImportReviewBeat one beat at a time.[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} STREAM_INVOKE_START elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)}`);[39m
[31m+       const stream = await startImportReviewStream(normalized);[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} STREAM_INVOKE_END elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} batch=${stream.batch_id}`);[39m
[31m+       if (importReviewRequestRunRef.current !== requestRunId) {[39m
[31m+         void discardImportReviewBatch(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       stagedImportPathsRef.current.set(stream.batch_id, normalized);[39m
[31m+       console.info(`[review-perf] STREAM_READY ${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} ms`);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Critical path: discover only until the FIRST normal playable audio is[39m
[31m+       // found, read its metadata/artwork, and stop. N intentionally remains[39m
[31m+       // unknown until the background worker reaches the end of the tree.[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} FIRST_PREPARE_INVOKE_START elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)}`);[39m
[31m+       const firstStep = await prepareNextImportReviewBeat(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} FIRST_PREPARE_INVOKE_END elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} has_beat=${Boolean(firstStep.beat)} discovery_complete=${firstStep.discovery_complete}`);[39m
[31m+       if (importReviewRequestRunRef.current !== requestRunId) {[39m
[31m+         stagedImportPathsRef.current.delete(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+         void discardImportReviewBatch(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const first = firstStep.beat[39m
[31m+         ? { ...firstStep.beat, tags: cleanTags(firstStep.beat.tags || []).tags }[39m
[31m+         : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (first) {[39m
[31m+         setShowAdd(false);[39m
[31m+         setReviewQueue({[39m
[31m+           beats: [first],[39m
[31m+           index: 0,[39m
[31m+           total: firstStep.total_normal,[39m
[31m+           batchId: stream.batch_id,[39m
[31m+           preparing: !firstStep.discovery_complete,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} FIRST_REVIEW_STATE_SET elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} beat=${first.name}`);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Diagnostic paint barrier: do not let Beat 2..N work begin until the[39m
[31m+         // first Review drawer had a real browser frame. This both proves whether[39m
[31m+         // background preparation was starving the first paint and guarantees the[39m
[31m+         // skeleton hands off directly to the real drawer with no blank flash.[39m
[31m+         await new Promise<void>(resolve => {[39m
[31m+           requestAnimationFrame(() => {[39m
[31m+             reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} FIRST_REVIEW_FRAME elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} beat=${first.name}`);[39m
[31m+             resolve();[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         setReviewBootstrap(null);[39m
[31m+         reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} BACKGROUND_ALLOWED elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)}`);[39m
[31m+         console.info(`[review-perf] FIRST_REVIEW_READY ${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} ms`);[39m
[31m+       } else if (firstStep.discovery_complete) {[39m
[31m+         const summary = await getImportReviewBatchSummary(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+         setDeferredImportBatch(summary);[39m
[31m+         setReviewBootstrap(null);[39m
[31m+         setReviewPreparationDone(true);[39m
[31m+         if (summary.audio_conflicts.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           setAudioConflictBatch(summary);[39m
[31m+         } else if (summary.pending.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           setDropImportBatch(summary);[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           stagedImportPathsRef.current.delete(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+           setDeferredImportBatch(null);[39m
[31m+           await discardImportReviewBatch(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({ title: "Nothing to import", message: "No playable beats were found in the dropped files." });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const runId = ++reviewPreparationRunRef.current;[39m
[31m+       const preparation = (async () => {[39m
[31m+         const prepared: Beat[] = first ? [first] : [];[39m
[31m+         let step = firstStep;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Continue exactly where Rust stopped. Each invoke searches only until[39m
[31m+         // the next normal beat, prepares that beat, then yields to the UI.[39m
[31m+         while (!step.discovery_complete && reviewPreparationRunRef.current === runId && importReviewRequestRunRef.current === requestRunId) {[39m
[31m+           await new Promise<void>(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0));[39m
[31m+           const bgIndex = prepared.length + 1;[39m
[31m+           const bgStarted = performance.now();[39m
[31m+           reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} BACKGROUND_PREPARE_START n=${bgIndex} elapsed_ms=${Math.round(bgStarted - dropStarted)}`);[39m
[31m+           step = await prepareNextImportReviewBeat(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+           reviewPerfMark(`run=${diagRun} BACKGROUND_PREPARE_END n=${bgIndex} step_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - bgStarted)} elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} has_beat=${Boolean(step.beat)} done=${step.discovery_complete}`);[39m
[31m+           if (reviewPreparationRunRef.current !== runId || importReviewRequestRunRef.current !== requestRunId) break;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (step.beat) {[39m
[31m+             const nextBeat = { ...step.beat, tags: cleanTags(step.beat.tags || []).tags };[39m
[31m+             prepared.push(nextBeat);[39m
[31m+             const sourceKey = reviewSourceKey(nextBeat);[39m
[31m+             setReviewQueue(q => {[39m
[31m+               if (!q || q.batchId !== stream.batch_id) return q;[39m
[31m+               if (sourceKey && skippedReviewSourceKeysRef.current.has(sourceKey)) return {[39m
[31m+                 ...q,[39m
[31m+                 total: step.total_normal ?? q.total,[39m
[31m+                 preparing: !step.discovery_complete,[39m
[31m+               };[39m
[31m+               if (sourceKey && q.beats.some(item => reviewSourceKey(item) === sourceKey)) return q;[39m
[31m+               return {[39m
[31m+                 ...q,[39m
[31m+                 beats: [...q.beats, nextBeat],[39m
[31m+                 total: step.total_normal ?? q.total,[39m
[31m+                 preparing: !step.discovery_complete,[39m
[31m+               };[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (reviewPreparationRunRef.current !== runId || importReviewRequestRunRef.current !== requestRunId) {[39m
[31m+           return prepared;[39m
[31m+         }[39m

[31m+         const summary = await getImportReviewBatchSummary(stream.batch_id);[39m
[31m+         setDeferredImportBatch(summary);[39m
[31m+         setReviewPreparationDone(true);[39m
[31m+         console.info(`[review-perf] DISCOVERY_FINISHED ${Math.round(performance.now() - dropStarted)} ms (${summary.normal_count} normal, ${summary.audio_conflicts.length} conflict)`);[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         setReviewQueue(q => {[39m
[31m+           if (!q || q.batchId !== stream.batch_id) return q;[39m
[31m+           // The user may have already Saved/Skipped the last currently-known beat[39m
[31m+           // while discovery was still running. Once N is known, close any cursor[39m
[31m+           // that is already past the end instead of leaving an eternal skeleton.[39m
[31m+           if (q.index >= summary.normal_count) return null;[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+       void preparation.catch(async error => {[39m

[31m+         if (reviewPreparationRunRef.current === runId && importReviewRequestRunRef.current === requestRunId) {[39m
[31m+           setReviewPreparationDone(true);[39m
[31m+           setReviewQueue(q => q && q.batchId === stream.batch_id ? { ...q, preparing: false } : q);[39m
[31m+           setReviewBootstrap(null);[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({ title: "Review preparation failed", message: String(error), danger: true });[39m

[31m+       });[39m

[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m

[31m+   const commitDrawerCloudMutation = useCallback(async ([39m
[31m+     updated: Beat,[39m
[31m+     options: { syncMetadata: boolean; reason: string },[39m
[31m+   ) => {[39m
[31m+     const dedupeMetadata = options.syncMetadata && options.reason === "drawer-metadata-save";[39m
[31m+     const metadataFingerprint = dedupeMetadata ? drawerMetadataCommitFingerprint(updated) : null;[39m
[31m+     if (metadataFingerprint && drawerMetadataCommitVerifiedRef.current.get(updated.id) === metadataFingerprint) {[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`DRAWER_CLOUD_COMMIT_SKIPPED beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason} cause=already-verified`);[39m
[31m+       void diagnosticLog("drawer-save", "CLOUD_COMMIT_SKIPPED", `beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason} cause=already-verified`);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const existing = drawerMetadataCommitInFlightRef.current.get(updated.id);[39m
[31m+     if (metadataFingerprint && existing?.fingerprint === metadataFingerprint) {[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`DRAWER_CLOUD_COMMIT_JOINED beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason}`);[39m
[31m+       await existing.promise;[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const commitPromise = (async () => {[39m
[31m+       const started = performance.now();[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark([39m
[31m+         `DRAWER_CLOUD_COMMIT_BEGIN beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason} sync_metadata=${options.syncMetadata}`,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       if (options.syncMetadata) {[39m
[31m+         await syncBeatMetadataToTelegram(updated);[39m
[31m+         reviewPerfMark(`DRAWER_CLOUD_METADATA_OK beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason}`);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const snapshot = beatsLatestRef.current.map(item => item.id === updated.id ? updated : item);[39m
[31m+       await libraryStateManager.commitSnapshot(snapshot, options.reason);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Seed the explicit transaction snapshots before Drawer publishes its React[39m
[31m+       // state update. Otherwise the metadata observer can mistake that same save[39m
[31m+       // for a second independent transaction and upload/commit it again.[39m
[31m+       if (cloudLibraryTimerRef.current) {[39m
[31m+         window.clearTimeout(cloudLibraryTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+         cloudLibraryTimerRef.current = null;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       cloudLibrarySnapshotRef.current = snapshot[39m
[31m+         .filter(item => !!item.telegram_file_id)[39m
[31m+         .map(cloudBeatFingerprint)[39m
[31m+         .join("\u001c");[39m
[31m+       cloudMetaSnapshotRef.current?.set(updated.id, cloudBeatFingerprint(updated));[39m
[31m+       if (metadataFingerprint) {[39m
[31m+         drawerMetadataCommitVerifiedRef.current.set(updated.id, metadataFingerprint);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       reviewPerfMark([39m
[31m+         `DRAWER_CLOUD_COMMIT_OK beat_id=${updated.id} reason=${options.reason} elapsed_ms=${Math.round(performance.now() - started)}`,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     })();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (metadataFingerprint) {[39m
[31m+       drawerMetadataCommitInFlightRef.current.set(updated.id, { fingerprint: metadataFingerprint, promise: commitPromise });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       await commitPromise;[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       const current = drawerMetadataCommitInFlightRef.current.get(updated.id);[39m
[31m+       if (current?.promise === commitPromise) drawerMetadataCommitInFlightRef.current.delete(updated.id);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+           // object as the metadata/artwork authority and clear only paths owned by[39m
[31m+           // the durable Offline package. Re-loading SQLite here can replace newer[39m
[31m+           // in-memory artwork/metadata with an older or incomplete materialized row.[39m
[31m+           const withoutOfflinePaths = (item: Beat): Beat => ({[39m
[31m+             ...item,[39m
[31m+             offline_available: false,[39m
[31m+             folder_path: "",[39m
[31m+             mp3_path: "",[39m
[31m+             wav_path: null,[39m
[31m+             playback_path: "",[39m
[31m+             stems_path: null,[39m
[31m+             samples_path: null,[39m
[31m+             flp_path: null,[39m
[31m+             als_path: null,[39m
[31m+             other_files: [],[39m
[31m+             loop_path: null,[39m
[31m+           });[39m

[31m+           setBeats(current => current.map(item => item.id === beat.id ? withoutOfflinePaths(item) : item));[39m
[31m+           setDrawer(current => current?.beat.id === beat.id[39m
[31m+             ? { ...current, beat: withoutOfflinePaths(current.beat) }[39m
[31m+             : current);[39m

[31m+           // Re-enter Download Cooking immediately while online. This is only a[39m
[31m+           // lightweight enqueue; it prevents the first post-Remove Play from[39m
[31m+           // racing an old Offline source and restores the normal cloud fast path.[39m
[31m+           if (cloudBeat.telegram_file_id) {[39m
[31m+             void ensureWarmPlaybackUrl(cloudBeat);[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         const offline = await makeBeatAvailableOffline(beat);[39m
[31m+         if (offlineOwnsDownloadState) transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "DOWNLOAD_SUCCEEDED" }, offline);[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SET_OFFLINE_AVAILABLE", available: true }, offline);[39m
[31m+         setBeats(current => current.map(item => item.id === beat.id ? {[39m
[31m+           ...item,[39m
[31m+           offline_available: true,[39m
[31m+           image_base64: item.image_base64 || offline.image_base64,[39m
[31m+           image_preview_base64: item.image_preview_base64 || offline.image_preview_base64,[39m
[31m+         } : item));[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           const audio = new Audio(downloadCompleteWav);[39m
[31m+           audio.volume = 0.68;[39m
[31m+           void audio.play().catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+         } catch {}[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       const message = sanitizeUserVisibleText(runtimeErrorMessage(error), "Cloud operation failed.");[39m
[31m+       if (offlineOwnsDownloadState) {[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "DOWNLOAD_FAILED", code: "OFFLINE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED", message, retryable: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       await appAlert({[39m
[31m+         title: beat.offline_available ? "Could not remove offline copy" : "Offline download failed",[39m
[31m+         message,[39m
[31m+         danger: true,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setOfflineBusyIds(current => {[39m
[31m+         const next = new Set(current);[39m
[31m+         next.delete(beat.id);[39m
[31m+         return next;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [audio.playingId, connectionState, ensureWarmPlaybackUrl, offlineBusyIds, releaseFile, transitionRuntime]);[39m

[31m+   const handleDropArtwork = useCallback(async (beat: Beat, imageBase64: string) => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Changing artwork")) return;[39m

[31m+       wav_path: beat.wav_path,[39m
[31m+       bpm: beat.bpm,[39m
[31m+       key: beat.key,[39m
[31m+       tags: beat.tags,[39m

[31m+       update_filename: false,[39m

[31m+     updateBeat(updated);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (updated.telegram_file_id && connectionState === "online") {[39m

[31m+       if (runtime.sync_state === "synced") transitionRuntime(updated.id, { type: "SYNC_QUEUE_UPDATE" }, updated);[39m
[31m+       transitionRuntime(updated.id, { type: "SYNC_UPDATE_STARTED" }, updated);[39m

[31m+           cloudLibraryTimerRef.current = null;[39m

[31m+           .filter(item => !!item.telegram_file_id)[39m

[31m+   const runBeatCloudUpdate = useCallback((beat: Beat, filePath: string, work: () => Promise<void>) => {[39m
[31m+     if (rejectOfflineMutation("Updating beat files")) {[39m
[31m+       setBeatFileDrop(null);[39m
[31m+       void cleanupStagedDropPaths([filePath]);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     // Once the user chose a destination, the chooser is done. The long Telegram/[39m
[31m+     // ZIP task belongs to the beat card, not to a blocking modal.[39m
[31m+     setBeatFileDrop(null);[39m
[31m+     setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beat.id, true);[39m
[31m+     const before = beatRuntimeStatesRef.current[beat.id] ?? createBeatRuntimeState(beat);[39m
[31m+     if (before.sync_state === "synced") transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_QUEUE_UPDATE" }, beat);[39m
[31m+     transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_UPDATE_STARTED" }, beat);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void (async () => {[39m
[31m+       let succeeded = false;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         await work();[39m
[31m+         transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED" }, beat);[39m
[31m+         succeeded = true;[39m
[31m+         setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beat.id, false, true);[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           const audio = new Audio(uploadCompleteWav);[39m
[31m+           audio.volume = 0.72;[39m
[31m+           void audio.play().catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+         } catch {}[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.error(error);[39m
[31m+         const message = sanitizeUserVisibleText(runtimeErrorMessage(error), "Cloud operation failed.");[39m
[31m+         if (isRuntimeConflictError(error)) transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_CONFLICT", message }, beat);[39m
[31m+         else transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_FAILED", code: "BEAT_UPDATE_FAILED", message, retryable: true }, beat);[39m
[31m+         setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beat.id, false, false);[39m
[31m+         await appAlert({ title: "Beat update failed", message, danger: true });[39m
[31m+       } finally {[39m
[31m+         // Drag/drop roots are private staging copies. The user can keep working[39m
[31m+         // while the task runs, then the staging is reclaimed regardless of outcome.[39m
[31m+         await cleanupStagedDropPaths([filePath]).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+         if (!succeeded) setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beat.id, false, false);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })();[39m
[31m+   }, [rejectOfflineMutation, transitionRuntime]);[39m

[31m+   const handleAutoProjectDrop = useCallback(async (beat: Beat, filePath: string): Promise<AutoProjectDropResult> => {[39m

[31m+         danger: true,[39m

[31m+       if (!replace) {[39m

[31m+       }[39m

[31m+   const handleBrowserBeatFileDrop = useCallback(async (beatId: string, files: File[]): Promise<boolean> => {[39m
[31m+     const beat = beatsLatestRef.current.find(item => item.id === beatId);[39m
[31m+     if (!beat) throw new Error(`Dropped file target beat was not found: ${beatId}`);[39m
[31m+     if (files.length !== 1) {[39m

[31m+         message: `Replace the current MASTER for "${beat.name}" with ${file.name}?`,[39m
[31m+         confirmLabel: "Replace",[39m
[31m+         cancelLabel: "Cancel",[39m
[31m+         danger: true,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       if (!replace) return false;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     transitionRuntime(beat.id, { type: "SYNC_QUEUE_UPDATE" }, beat);[39m

[31m+       setBeats(current => {[39m
[31m+         const next = current.map(item => item.id === committed.id ? committed : item);[39m
[31m+         beatsLatestRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+         return next;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       setDrawer(current => current?.beat.id === committed.id ? { ...current, beat: committed } : current);[39m

[31m+       return false;[39m

[31m+       throw error;[39m

[31m+   // Browser/Pinterest controller. Windows desktop keeps the existing single native[39m

[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     // On Windows desktop, WRY/Tauri owns the external drop. Explorer gives us[39m

[31m+       setGlobalDropActive: setDropActive,[39m

[31m+           // provide a CDN URL AND a virtual File; whichever representation works[39m
[31m+           // first wins. A failed cloud URL fetch therefore cannot kill a usable[39m
[31m+           // virtual-file drop, and vice versa.[39m
[31m+           for (const source of sources) {[39m
[31m+             try {[39m
[31m+               const candidate = source.kind === "remote"[39m
[31m+                 ? (/^data:image\//i.test(source.url) ? source.url : await fetchInternetArtworkDataUrl(source.url))[39m
[31m+                 : await artworkFileToDataUrl(source.file);[39m
[31m+               if (!/^data:image\//i.test(candidate) || candidate.length < 32) {[39m
[31m+                 throw new Error("Artwork source returned an invalid/empty image payload.");[39m
[31m+               }[39m

[31m+           setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beat.id, false);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       onBeatFileDrop: async (beatId, roots) => {[39m
[31m+         const beat = beatsLatestRef.current.find(item => item.id === beatId);[39m
[31m+         if (!beat) return;[39m
[31m+         if (roots.length > 1) {[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({[39m
[31m+             title: "Drop one file at a time",[39m
[31m+             message: "Drop a single file or folder on a beat so BeatGaler can assign it to the correct slot.",[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+           return false;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         const root = roots[0];[39m
[31m+         if (isBackupFolderPath(root.path)) {[39m
[31m+           await cleanupStagedDropPaths([root.path]).catch(() => {});[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({[39m
[31m+             title: "Backup folder skipped",[39m
[31m+             message: "BeatGaler keeps Backup/Backups folders out of PROJECT.zip so old project copies are not uploaded.",[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+           return false;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Project files and PROJECT ZIPs have exactly one sensible destination,[39m
[31m+         // so do not make the user answer a redundant "What are you adding?" page.[39m
[31m+         // The card is already in its loading state while WebView2 stages/inspects[39m
[31m+         // the drop, so large ZIPs never look like the app ignored them.[39m
[31m+         const autoResult = await handleAutoProjectDrop(beat, root.path);[39m
[31m+         if (autoResult === "started") return true;[39m
[31m+         if (autoResult === "handled") return false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         setBeatFileDrop({ beat, filePath: root.path, kind: root.kind });[39m
[31m+         return false;[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       onBeatFileStagingChange: (beatId, active) => {[39m
[31m+         setBeatCloudUpdateBusy(beatId, active, false);[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       onLibraryFileStagingChange: active => {[39m
[31m+         if (!REVIEW_SKELETON_ENABLED) return;[39m
[31m+         setLibraryDropStaging(active);[39m
[31m+       },[39m

[31m+       onBrowserLibraryFileDrop: platform.capabilities.browserFileImport ? importDroppedBrowserFiles : undefined,[39m
[31m+       onLibraryFileDrop: async roots => {[39m
[31m+         await importDroppedPaths(roots.map(root => root.path));[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       onEmptyFileDrop: async () => {[39m

[31m+           title: "Nothing to import",[39m
[31m+           message: "The desktop drag source reported files, but the app could not access any usable file or folder paths.",[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       },[39m

[31m+     const elementAtNativePosition = (position: { x?: number; y?: number } | null | undefined): HTMLElement | null => {[39m

[31m+       const candidates: Array<[number, number]> = [[position.x, position.y]];[39m
[31m+       if (scale !== 1) candidates.push([position.x / scale, position.y / scale]);[39m
[31m+       for (const [x, y] of candidates) {[39m

[31m+         if (el) return el;[39m
[31m+       }[39m

[31m+     const handleNativeDrop = async (payload: NativeFsPayload) => {[39m
[31m+       // Reserved external-image sentinels are intercepted in onDragDropEvent[39m
[31m+       // before this local-filesystem router can ever be called.[39m

[31m+       const card = target?.closest?.("[data-beat-card-id]") as HTMLElement | null;[39m
[31m+       const library = target?.closest?.('[data-library-scroll="true"]') as HTMLElement | null;[39m
[31m+       const drawerArtwork = target?.closest?.("[data-artwork-drop]") as HTMLElement | null;[39m
[31m+       const drawerFileRow = target?.closest?.("[data-filerole]") as HTMLElement | null;[39m

[31m+       reviewPerfMark(`TAURI_NATIVE_DROP path_count=${payload.paths.length} target=${drawerTarget ?? (artworkBeatId ? "card-artwork" : cardBeatId ? "beat-card" : library ? "library" : "none")} names=${payload.paths.map(fileNameFromPath).slice(0, 12).join("|")}`);[39m

[31m+       if (payload.paths.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+         if (drawerTarget || artworkBeatId || cardBeatId || library) {[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({[39m
[31m+             title: "Drop could not be read",[39m

[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (drawerTarget) {[39m
[31m+         if (payload.paths.length !== 1) {[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({ title: "Drop one file", message: "Choose one file for this field." });[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (drawerTarget === "artwork" && !isImagePath(payload.paths[0])) {[39m
[31m+           await appAlert({ title: "Artwork must be an image", message: "Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, or AVIF image." });[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("beatgaler:drawer-native-path", {[39m
[31m+           detail: { target: drawerTarget, path: payload.paths[0] },[39m
[31m+         }));[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (cardBeatId || library) claimNativeLibraryDrop();[39m
[31m+       if (payload.paths.length > MAX_NATIVE_DROP_ITEMS) {[39m
[31m+         await appAlert({[39m
[31m+           title: "Too many items",[39m
[31m+           message: `Drop up to ${MAX_NATIVE_DROP_ITEMS} files/folders at a time. A parent folder still counts as one item.`,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (artworkBeatId && payload.paths.length === 1 && isImagePath(payload.paths[0])) {[39m
[31m+         await resolveNativeArtwork(artworkBeatId, payload.paths[0]);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cardBeatId) {[39m
[31m+         await handleNativeBeatDrop(cardBeatId, payload.paths);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!library) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       // Native fast path: Tauri gives us the original Finder/Explorer paths. No[39m

[31m+   const reloadLibrary = useCallback(async () => {[39m
[31m+     // Pre-Direct BeatGaler reload used a full loading state and then replaced the[39m
[31m+     // rendered library from the durable source. Keep that authoritative behavior,[39m
[31m+     // but never let Reload race an active import: until the batch INDEX commit[39m
[31m+     // finishes, Telegram intentionally does not contain those optimistic beats.[39m
[31m+     const refreshStarted = performance.now();[39m
[31m+     setLibraryRefreshing(true);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const finishRefreshAnimation = async () => {[39m
[31m+       const elapsed = performance.now() - refreshStarted;[39m
[31m+       if (elapsed < 320) await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 320 - elapsed));[39m
[31m+       setLibraryRefreshing(false);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const uploadInFlight = backgroundUploadRunningRef.current || autoCloudUploadRef.current.size > 0;[39m
[31m+       if (uploadInFlight) {[39m
[31m+         // Critical safety rule: restoreLibraryFromTelegram reconciles SQLite to the[39m
[31m+         // committed INDEX. During an import that INDEX is intentionally older, so[39m
[31m+         // applying it would make the beats being uploaded disappear. Defer instead.[39m
[31m+         deferredLibraryReloadRef.current = true;[39m
[31m+         console.info(`[library-refresh] DEFERRED active_uploads=${autoCloudUploadRef.current.size}`);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       try { localStorage.removeItem(LIBRARY_CACHE_KEY); } catch {}[39m
[31m+       const browserOffline = typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine === false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (settings?.telegram_cloud_connected && !browserOffline) {[39m
[31m+         let lastError: unknown = null;[39m
[31m+         for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 4; attempt += 1) {[39m
[31m+           try {[39m
[31m+             // Reload is also an integrity pass: if an INDEX entry points at a[39m
[31m+             // MASTER message Telegram definitively says no longer exists, repair[39m
[31m+             // the INDEX first and then apply the repaired authority to SQLite/UI.[39m
[31m+             const repaired = await repairStaleCloudLibraryRefs().catch(error => {[39m
[31m+               console.warn("Reload integrity probe deferred safely:", error);[39m
[31m+               return 0;[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+             if (repaired > 0) console.warn(`[library-refresh] stale_refs_repaired=${repaired}`);[39m
[31m+             const restored = await libraryStateManager.reloadAuthoritative();[39m
[31m+             cloudMetaSnapshotRef.current = new Map([39m
[31m+               restored.filter(beat => !!beat.telegram_file_id).map(beat => [beat.id, cloudBeatFingerprint(beat)])[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+             cloudLibrarySnapshotRef.current = restored[39m
[31m+               .filter(beat => !!beat.telegram_file_id)[39m
[31m+               .map(cloudBeatFingerprint)[39m
[31m+               .join("\u001c");[39m
[31m+             setConnectionState("online");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // Reload replaces committed library state, just like the functional[39m
[31m+             // pre-Direct version, while preserving already-decoded artwork.[39m
[31m+             const visible = preserveLoadedArtwork(restored, beatsLatestRef.current);[39m
[31m+             beatsLatestRef.current = visible;[39m
[31m+             setBeats(visible);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             startupCookingResolvedRef.current = true;[39m
[31m+             startupPipelineStartedRef.current = false;[39m
[31m+             progressiveRevealRunRef.current += 1;[39m
[31m+             setRevealedBeatIds(current => {[39m
[31m+               const next = new Set(current);[39m
[31m+               for (const beat of visible) next.add(beat.id);[39m
[31m+               return next;[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+             setStartupCookingGate(false);[39m
[31m+             setCloudSessionVerified(true);[39m
[31m+             console.info(`[library-refresh] APPLIED beats=${visible.length} attempt=${attempt}`);[39m
[31m+             return;[39m
[31m+           } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+             lastError = error;[39m
[31m+             if (attempt < 4) await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 450 * attempt));[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         console.warn("Telegram library refresh failed after retries; preserving verified gallery:", lastError);[39m
[31m+         setConnectionState("poor");[39m
[31m+         setCloudSessionVerified(false);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const offline = await loadOfflineLibrary();[39m
[31m+       if (browserOffline) {[39m
[31m+         setConnectionState("offline");[39m
[31m+         setCloudSessionVerified(false);[39m
[31m+         if (beatsLatestRef.current.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+           beatsLatestRef.current = offline;[39m
[31m+           setBeats(offline);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!settings?.telegram_cloud_connected) {[39m
[31m+         setCloudSessionVerified(false);[39m
[31m+         beatsLatestRef.current = offline;[39m
[31m+         setBeats(offline);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } catch (err) {[39m

[31m+       setConnectionState(typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine === false ? "offline" : "poor");[39m
[31m+       setCloudSessionVerified(false);[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       await finishRefreshAnimation();[39m

[31m+   }, [settings?.telegram_cloud_connected]);[39m

[31m+   const deleteBeat = useCallback(async (beat: Beat) => {[39m
[31m+     const approved = await appConfirm({[39m
[31m+       title: "Remove beat?",[39m
[31m+       message: beat.telegram_file_id[39m

[31m+   // Global tag usage, normalized and counted once per beat. This is only a[39m
[31m+   // presentation ranking: the order stored in ID3 metadata is left untouched.[39m
[31m+   const tagFrequency = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const freq = new Map<string, number>();[39m
[31m+     for (const beat of beats) {[39m
[31m+       const uniqueTags = new Set([39m
[31m+         beat.tags.map(tag => tag.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       for (const tag of uniqueTags) {[39m
[31m+         freq.set(tag, (freq.get(tag) ?? 0) + 1);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return freq;[39m
[31m+   }, [beats]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const allTags = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const displayByNormalized = new Map<string, string>();[39m
[31m+     for (const beat of beats) {[39m
[31m+       for (const rawTag of beat.tags) {[39m
[31m+         const normalized = rawTag.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+         if (normalized && !displayByNormalized.has(normalized)) {[39m
[31m+           displayByNormalized.set(normalized, rawTag.trim());[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return [...displayByNormalized.entries()][39m
[31m+       .sort(([a], [b]) =>[39m
[31m+         (tagFrequency.get(b) ?? 0) - (tagFrequency.get(a) ?? 0) || a.localeCompare(b)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       .map(([, display]) => display);[39m
[31m+   }, [beats, tagFrequency]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const tagSuggestions = useMemo(() => {[39m

[31m+     for (const beat of beats) {[39m
[31m+       for (const tag of beat.tags) {[39m
[31m+         const normalized = tag.trim().toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+         if (!normalized) continue;[39m
[31m+         freq.set(normalized, (freq.get(normalized) ?? 0) + 1);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return [...freq.entries()][39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))[39m
[31m+       .map(([tag]) => tag);[39m
[31m+   }, [beats]);[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+         return (manualOrderIndex.get(a.id) ?? 0) - (manualOrderIndex.get(b.id) ?? 0);[39m

[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m

[31m+   // The player/queue must never outlive the authoritative gallery. This also[39m

[31m+     setQueueIds(ids => ids.filter(id => liveIds.has(id)));[39m

[31m+       setQueueIds((ids) => ids.slice(1));[39m
[31m+       if (nextBeat) {[39m
[31m+         handlePlay(nextBeat);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (playbackQueue.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     if (currentQueueIndex === -1) {[39m
[31m+       playFromQueueIndex(0);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     if (fromEnded && repeatMode === "one") {[39m
[31m+       playFromQueueIndex(currentQueueIndex);[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (shuffleEnabled) {[39m
[31m+       if (playbackQueue.length === 1) {[39m
[31m+         if (!fromEnded || repeatMode !== "off") playFromQueueIndex(0);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       let nextIndex = currentQueueIndex;[39m
[31m+       while (nextIndex === currentQueueIndex) {[39m
[31m+         nextIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playbackQueue.length);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       playFromQueueIndex(nextIndex);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let nextIndex = currentQueueIndex + 1;[39m
[31m+     if (nextIndex >= playbackQueue.length) {[39m
[31m+       if (fromEnded && repeatMode === "off") return;[39m
[31m+       nextIndex = 0;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     playFromQueueIndex(nextIndex);[39m
[31m+   }, [queueIds, beats, handlePlay, playbackQueue, currentQueueIndex, repeatMode, shuffleEnabled, playFromQueueIndex]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const handlePrev = useCallback(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (beats.length === 0 || playbackQueue.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     if (audio.progress > 0.05) {[39m
[31m+       seek(0);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m

[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       playFromQueueIndex(prevIndex);[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (currentQueueIndex <= 0) {[39m
[31m+       playFromQueueIndex(playbackQueue.length - 1);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     playFromQueueIndex(currentQueueIndex - 1);[39m
[31m+   }, [playbackQueue, audio.progress, seek, shuffleEnabled, currentQueueIndex, playFromQueueIndex]);[39m

[31m+     handleNext(true);[39m
[31m+   }, [audio.endedSeq, handleNext]);[39m

These are the relevant files:%0A+    * >  - [`chat_helpers/stickers_dice_pack.cpp`](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/blob/dev/Telegram/SourceFiles/chat_helpers/stickers_dice_pack.cpp)%0A+    * >  - [`history/view/media/history_view_slot_machine.cpp`](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop/blob/dev/Telegram/SourceFiles/history/view/media/history_view_slot_machine.cpp)%0A+    *%0A+    * Unlike other animated dices, this does not have%0A+    * all the possible combinations in the sticker set.%0A+    * Instead, `value` is a specially encoded integer that contains%0A+    * the information about the indexes.%0A+    *%0A+    * There are some base parts of the animations:%0A+    *  - 0th sticker is the base background of the machine%0A+    *  - 1st sticker is the background of the machine for the "winning" state (i.e. `777`)%0A+    *  - 2nd sticker is the frame of the machine, including the handle%0A+    *  - 8th sticker is the "idle" state for the left slot%0A+    *  - 14th sticker is the "idle" state for the middle slot%0A+    *  - 20th sticker is the "idle" state for the right slot%0A+    *%0A+    * The machine result is encoded as 3 concatenated two-bit integers,%0A+    * and the resulting integer is incremented by one.%0A+    *%0A+    * So, to decode the value to its parts, you can use this code:%0A+    * ```typescript%0A+    * const computePartValue = (val: number, idx: number) => ((val - 1) >> (idx * 2)) & 0x03; // 0..3%0A+    * const parts = [%0A+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 0),%0A+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 1),%0A+    *   computePartValue(msg.media.value, 2),%0A+    * ]%0A+    * ```%0A+    *%0A+    * Each part of the value corresponds to a particular slot (i.e. part 0 is left slot,%0A+    * part 1 is middle, part 2 is right). The slot values are as follows:%0A+    *  - 0: BAR (displayed as a *BAR* sign on a black background)%0A+    *  - 1: BERRIES (displayed as berries, similar to emoji 🍇)%0A+    *  - 2: LEMON (displayed as a lemon, similar to emoji 🍋)%0A+    *  - 3: SEVEN (displayed as a red digit 7)%0A+    *%0A+    * Therefore, the winning value (i.e. `777`) is represented as `(3 << 4 | 3 << 2 | 3 << 0) + 1 = 64`%0A+    *%0A+    * To determine the needed animation parts, you'll need to apply some shifts.%0A+    * These are the offsets for the individual symbols:%0A+    *  - WIN_SEVEN: 0%0A+    *  - SEVEN: 1%0A+    *  - BAR: 2%0A+    *  - BERRIES: 3%0A+    *  - LEMON: 4%0A+    *%0A+    * And these are the shifts for each slot:%0A+    *  - LEFT: 3%0A+    *  - MIDDLE: 9%0A+    *  - RIGHT: 15%0A+    *%0A+    * > WIN_SEVEN is the same as SEVEN, but only used if the machine result is `777` (i.e. `value = 64`),%0A+    * > as it contains additional "blinking" animation.%0A+    *%0A+    * The sticker index sticker set is used for the machine: [SlotMachineAnimated](https://t.me/addstickers/SlotMachineAnimated)%0A+    */%0A+   static TYPE_SLOTS = "\u{1F3B0}";%0A+   /**%0A+    * An emoji which was
